label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: AZALEA POKéMON GYM$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: AZALEA TOWN POKéMON GYM\pBUGSY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyIntro
source:
I'm BUGSY!\pI never lose when it comes
to bug POKéMON.\pMy research is going to make me the
authority on bug POKéMON!\pLet me demonstrate all I've
learned from my studies.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyBeaten
source:
Whoa, amazing! You're an
expert on POKéMON!\pMy research isn't complete
yet.\pOK, you win. Take this
BADGE.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedHiveBadge
source: {PLAYER} received HIVEBADGE.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_HiveBadgeSpeech
source:
Do you know the benefits
of HIVEBADGE?\pIf you have it, POKéMON up
to L30 will obey you,\leven traded ones.\pPOKéMON that know CUT will be able
to use it outside of battle too.\pHere, I also want you to
have this.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_FuryCutterSpeech
source: TM89 contains U-TURN.\pU-TURN lets you do damage and\nswitch your POKéMON in the same\lturn!\pIsn't that great?\nI discovered it!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyAdvice
source: Bug POKéMON are deep. There are\nmany mysteries to be explored.\pStudy your favorites thoroughly.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyRematch
source: Wow, you're the JOHTO CHAMPION now!\pYour skills are truly impressive!\pI've been busy with my research.\pI'm ready to show you my new\nfindings.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugsyRematchDefeat
source: Wow, you must be an expert trainer.\nMy research must not be complete...$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennySeen
source: Bug POKéMON evolve young. So they\nget stronger that much faster.$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennyBeaten
source: Just evolving isn't enough!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherBennyAfter
source: POKéMON become stronger\nif they evolve. Really!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlSeen
source: Bug POKéMON are cool and tough!\nI'll prove it to you!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlBeaten
source: You proved how tough you are…$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherAlAfter
source: They're so cool, but most girls\ndon't like bug POKéMON.\pI don't know why…$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshSeen
source: You saved all the SLOWPOKE?\nWhew, you're mighty!\pBut my grown-up POKéMON are\npretty tough too!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshBeaten
source: Urrgggh!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_BugCatcherJoshAfter
source: I guess I should teach them\nbetter moves…$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1Seen
source: AMY: Hi! Are you challenging\nthe LEADER? No way!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1Beaten
source: AMY & MAY: Oh, double\ngoodness!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay1After
source: AMY: You're really strong!\pBut BUGSY's even stronger!\nHis SCYTHER's CUT almost\lalways makes critical hits!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2Seen
source: MAY: You want to see the\nLEADER? Good luck!\pBUGSY is so strong!\nHis SCYTHER's CUT always\lseems to crit!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2Beaten
source: AMY & MAY: Oh, double\ngoodness!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_TwinsAmyMay2After
source: MAY: Our bug POKéMON lost!\nOh, what a shame.\pBUGSY's won't lose though!\pHis PINECO makes short work\nof ROCK-type POKéMON!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymGuide
source:
Yo, challenger!\pBUGSY's young, but his knowledge
of bug POKéMON is for real.\pIt's going to be tough
without my advice.\pLet's see… BUGSY's bagworm POKéMON
knows a move that covers its\lROCK-type weakness.\pOh, and don't forget about those
nasty critical hits! Good luck!$

label: AzaleaTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin
source: Well done! That was a great\nclash of talented young trainers.\pWith people like you, the\nfuture of POKéMON is bright!$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalBefore
source:
…Tell me something.\pIs it true that TEAM ROCKET
has returned?\pWhat? You beat them? Hah! Quit
lying.\pYou're not joking?
Then let's see how good you are.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalWin
source: …Humph! Useless POKéMON!\pListen, you. You only won because\nmy POKéMON were weak.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalAfter
source:
I hate the weak.\pPOKéMON, trainers. It doesn't
matter who or what.\pI'm going to be strong and wipe
out the weak.\pThat goes for TEAM ROCKET too.\pThey act big and tough in a group.\pBut get them alone, and they're weak.
I hate them all.\pYou stay out of my way. A weakling
like you is only a distraction.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_RivalLoss
source: …Humph! I knew you were lying.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Rocket1
source: It's unsafe to go in there,\nso I'm standing guard.\pAren't I a good Samaritan?$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Rocket2
source: Do you know about SLOWPOKETAIL?\nI heard it's tasty!\pAren't you glad I told you that?$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GrampsBefore
source: The SLOWPOKE have disappeared\nfrom town…\pI heard their TAILS are being\nsold somewhere.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GrampsAfter
source: The SLOWPOKE have returned.\pKnowing them, they could've just\nbeen goofing off somewhere.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Teacher
source: Did you come to get KURT to make\nsome BALLS?\pA lot of people do just that.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Youngster
source:
Cut through AZALEA and you'll be
in ILEX FOREST.\pBut these skinny trees make it
impossible to get through.\pThe CHARCOAL MAN's POKéMON
can CUT down trees.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt1
source: ILEX FOREST is restless!\pWhat is going on?$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt2
source: {PLAYER}, here's your GS BALL back!$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Kurt3
source: Could you go see why ILEX FOREST\nis so restless?$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_Sign
source: AZALEA TOWN\nWhere People and POKéMON Live in\lHappy Harmony.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_KurtsHouseSign
source: KURT'S HOUSE$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_GymSign
source: AZALEA TOWN\nPOKéMON GYM\pLEADER: BUGSY\pThe Walking Bug POKéMON\nEncyclopedia$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_SlowpokeWellSign
source: SLOWPOKE WELL\pAlso known as the RAINMAKER WELL.\pLocals believe that a SLOWPOKE's\nyawn summons rain.\pRecords show that a SLOWPOKE's\nyawn ended a drought 400 years ago.$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_CharcoalKilnSign
source: CHARCOAL KILN$

label: AzaleaTown_Text_IlexForestSign
source: ILEX FOREST\pEnter through the gate.$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss1
source:
All the SLOWPOKE have disappeared
from the town.\pThe forest's protector may be
angry with us…\pIt may be a bad omen. We should
stay in.$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss2
source: The SLOWPOKE have returned…$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss3
source: The SLOWPOKE have returned…\pBut my APPRENTICE hasn't come back\nfrom ILEX FOREST.\pWhere in the world is that lazy guy?$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Boss4
source: You chased off TEAM ROCKET and\nwent to ILEX FOREST alone?\pThat takes guts! I like that.\nCome train with us.$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice1
source: Where have all the SLOWPOKE gone?\pAre they out playing somewhere?$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice2
source: The SLOWPOKE came back!$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice3
source: I'm sorry--I forgot to thank you.\pThis is CHARCOAL that I made.\pFIRE-type POKéMON would be happy\nto hold that.$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Apprentice4
source: The SLOWPOKE came back, and you even\nfound FARFETCH'D.\pYou're the coolest, man!$

label: CharcoalKiln_Text_Farfetchd
source: FARFETCH'D: Kwaa!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_BallAnyway
source: Anyway, can I make you some BALLS?$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtGetStarted
source: KURT: I'll get started right now!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtMakingBallsMustWait
source:
Hm? Who are you?\p{PLAYER}, eh? You want me to make
some BALLS?\pSorry, but that'll have to wait.\pDo you know TEAM ROCKET?
Ah, don't worry.\pI'll tell you anyhow.\pTEAM ROCKET's an evil gang that
uses POKéMON for their dirty work.\pThey're supposed to have disbanded
three years ago.\pAnyway, they're at the WELL,
cutting off SLOWPOKETAILS to sell!\pSo I'm going to go give them a
lesson in pain!\pHang on, SLOWPOKE! Old KURT
is on his way!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtHonoredToMakeBalls
source:
KURT: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pYou handled yourself like a
real hero at the WELL.\pI like your style!\pI would be honored to make
BALLS for a trainer like you.\pThis is all I have now, 
but take it.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtBallsFromApricorns
source: KURT: I make BALLS from BERRIES.\pCollect them from trees and bring\n'em to me.\pI'll make POKé BALLS out of them.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtAskYouHaveAnApricorn
source: KURT: You have BERRIES for me?\pFine! I'll turn them into POKé BALLS.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtThatsALetdown
source: KURT: I don't see any {STR_VAR_1}s!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtFinishedPlural
source: KURT: {PLAYER}!\nYour {STR_VAR_1}s are done. Here!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtObtainedPlural
source: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_2} {STR_VAR_1}s!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtFinishedSingular
source: KURT: {PLAYER}!\nYour {STR_VAR_1} is done. Here!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtObtainedSingular
source: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtTurnedOutGreat
source: KURT: That turned out great.\pTry catching POKéMON with it.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtWhatIsThat
source: Wh-what is that?\pI've never seen one before.\pIt looks a like a POKé BALL, but\nit appears to be something else.\pLet me check it for you.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtImCheckingItNow
source: I'm checking it now.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtAhHaISee
source: Ah-ha! I see! So…$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_KurtThisBallStartedToShake
source: {PLAYER}!\pThis BALL started to shake\nwhile I was checking it.\pThere must be something to this!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_Kurt_Whatwasthat
source: What was that sound?!\pLet's go outside to investigate!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSlowpokeGone
source: The SLOWPOKE are gone… \nWere they taken away by bad people?$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterLonely
source: Grandpa's gone… I'm so lonely…$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSlowpokeBack
source: The SLOWPOKE my dad gave me came back!\pIts TAIL is growing back too!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterDad
source: Dad works at SILPH where\nhe studies POKé BALLS.\pI have to stay home\nwith Grandpa and SLOWPOKE.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterHelp
source: I get to help Grandpa now!\pWe'll make good BALLS\nfor you, so please wait!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterFun
source: It's fun to make BALLS!$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_GranddaughterSound
source: Did that sound come from\nILEX FOREST????$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_Forest
source: Did you check ILEX FOREST yet?\nIt sounds very restless.$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_Slowpoke
source: SLOWPOKE: … Yawn?$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_OakPhoto
source: …A young PROF. OAK?$

label: KurtsHouse_Text_CelebiStatue
source: It's a statue of the forest's\nprotector.$

label: AzaleaMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source:
Are you able to buy a GREAT BALL?
All I can buy are POKé BALLS.\pI heard that more items become
available to buy when you earn\lGYM BADGES!\pI wish KURT would make me some
of his custom BALLS.$

label: AzaleaMart_Text_BugCatcher
source: A GREAT BALL is better for catch-\ning POKéMON than a POKé BALL.\pBut KURT's might be better some-\ntimes.$

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_Gentleman
source: Do your POKéMON know HM moves?\pThose moves can be used even if\nyour POKéMON has fainted.$

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_UnusedPCExplanation
source: This BILL guy created the system\nfor storing POKéMON in a PC.\pBILL's PC can store up to 30\nPOKéMON per BOX.$

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_FishingGuru
source: BILL's PC can store up to 30\nPOKéMON per BOX.$

label: AzaleaPokecenter_Text_PokefanF
source: Do you know about BERRIES?\pCrack one open, hollow it out and\nfit it with a special device.\pThen you can catch POKéMON with it.\pBefore POKé BALLS were invented,\neveryone used BERRIES.$

source: Would you like to record your last\nbattle on your FRONTIER PASS?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_NowFaceTycoon_hns
source: My dear challenger!\pYour skill level is truly astounding!\pWe now would like you to face our\nleader, the ARENA TYCOON!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_PreparedForTycoon_hns
source: A battle with the ARENA TYCOON!\nAre you prepared?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForGreta_hns
source: REFEREE: The ARENA TYCOON!\nMake way for GRETA!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger_hns
source: GRETA: Hey!\nHowdy!\p…Wait, are you the challenger?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IsThatRight_hns
source: Is that right? Hmm…\nHmhm…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy_hns
source: I don't know how to say it, but…\nTo put it bluntly, you look pretty weak.\lAre you sure you're up for me?\pHmm…\pWell, all right!\nWe'll take things easy to start with!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IgniteMyPassionForBattle_hns
source: Okay! Let's see you ignite my passion\nfor battle!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll_hns
source: GRETA: Ow, wait a second!\nYou are tough after all!\pI like you!\nLet's see your FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedGutsSymbol_hns
source: The Guts Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime_hns
source: Hmm…\pIt's going to be fun the next time!\nI'm looking forward to it!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain_hns
source: GRETA: Hey! Howdy!\nYou finally won your way up to me!\pI was getting worried waiting for you!\nI was really looking forward to seeing\lyou again!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SoAreYouReady_hns
source: … … …\nSo, are you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge_hns
source:
In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.\pThe three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.\pDuring battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules_hns
source:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.\pFirst, one battle lasts only
three turns.\pIf the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.\pThe REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.\pAlso, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules_hns
source: The first judging factor is “Mind.”\nThis factor evaluates how aggressive\lthe battlers were.\pThe judging is based on how often\nthe TRAINERS ordered the use of\loffensive moves.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules_hns
source:
The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively\lPOKéMON moves were used.\pIf a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.\pIf a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.\pIf it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super\leffective” and goes down if it was\l“not very effective.”\pThe Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.\pIf the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to\lhit with a move, its Skill rating will not\lgo down.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules_hns
source: The third judging factor is “Body.”\nThis factor is based on how much HP\lremained at the end of a battle.\pThe rating takes into account how much\nHP a POKéMON had at the start of\lbattle, and what remained at the end.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainTourneyTree_hns
source:

the “Tree,” is available for viewing\lin the Waiting Room from any guide.\pThe Tournament Tree will provide
several kinds of data.\pThe data on view includes the previous
tournament's results, the POKéMON held\lby TRAINERS, and the battle styles of\lTRAINERS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleKORules_hns

source: Hey, hey!\nGet a move on!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead_hns
source:
Hey, my name's NOLAND!
I'm basically in charge of this place,\lwhich is why I'm the FACTORY HEAD!\pI had a look at your Battle Swap data.\pYou seem to have the right idea,
but you're still square in your head!\pListen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only
about reading books or doing desk work.\pJust doing that sort of thing…
It may as well be useless!\pYou have to experience things with
your heart and your body, understand?\pI'll take you on under the same
conditions as you.\pI'll be using rental POKéMON, too!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ShakeOutKnowledgeBringItOn_hns
source: Shake out every last bit of your\nknowledge and bring it on!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedKnowledgeSymbol_hns
source: The Knowledge Symbol was embossed\non the FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred_hns
source: Heh…\nYou're a pretty bright spark…\pNext time, I'll come after you hard.\nNo holds barred, understand?\pYou keep up your studies!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime_hns
source:
NOLAND: Hey, hey! How's it going?
You keeping up with your studies?\p…Oh?\pYou've taken on a harder look than
the last time I saw you.\pNow, this should be fun!
I'm getting excited, hey!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_AllRightBringItOn_hns
source: All right!\nBring it on!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_OutOfMyLeagueLetsSeePass_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle_hns
source: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS\nis put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!\pI am your guide to the Battle Swap\nSingle Tournament.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to take the Battle\nSwap Single challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge_hns
source:
The Battle Swap Single Tournament
is a SINGLE BATTLE competition using\lonly rental POKéMON.\pFirst, you will be loaned three
POKéMON specifically for this event.\pUsing the supplied rental POKéMON,
you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.\pIf you win, you are permitted to trade
one of your rental POKéMON.\pRepeat this cycle of battling and
trading--if you win seven times in\la row, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will be
disqualified from your challenge.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit_hns
source: We look forward to your next visit.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode_hns
source: Which level do you wish to challenge?\nLevel 50 or Open Level?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WillHoldMonsForSafekeeping_hns
source: Okay, I will hold your POKéMON for\nsafekeeping while you compete.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_StepThisWay_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMons_hnsSaveResults_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves_hns
source:
Hi!
You, there!\pAre you thinking that the events here
are easy since you don't need to have\la raised team of POKéMON?\pI wouldn't be too sure about winning
that easily.\pIf you don't have thorough knowledge
about POKéMON and their moves,\lit will be tough to keep winning.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_SwappedForWeakMon_hns
source: I swapped for a weak POKéMON…\nI thought it was a good kind to have…\pThey wiped the floor with us…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentsMons_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CantFigureOutStaffHints_hns
source: You know how the staff here give you\na few hints about your next opponent?\pWell, I'm a full-grown man, but I have\ntrouble figuring out their hints.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RentalMonsAreVaried_hns
source: Like, I'm really tough, but I get bored\nreally easily, so I just kept swapping\land battling over and over.\pSo anyway, when I kept entering\nBattle Swap events, I noticed they\lvaried the rental POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules_hns
source: In a Battle Swap event, you may use\nonly three POKéMON.\pWhether you are renting or swapping,\nyour team may not have two or more\lof the same POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules_hns
source: You may swap POKéMON only with\nthe TRAINER you have just defeated.\pYou may swap for only those POKéMON\nused by the beaten TRAINER.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules_hns
source: After every battle you win, you may\nswap for one of your defeated\lopponent's POKéMON.\pYou will not be able to swap POKéMON\nwith the seventh TRAINER in the event.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules_hns
source:
There are two key points to be aware
of when swapping POKéMON.\pFirst, when swapping, you can't check
the stats of the POKéMON you are\labout to receive.\pSecond, the POKéMON on your team
are lined up in sequence, depending on\lthe order in which you rented them.\pThis sequence remains unchanged
even when swaps are made.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro_hns

POKéMON always!\pMy heart beats as one with
POKéMON always!\pYoung one of a TRAINER!
Do you believe in your POKéMON?\pCan you believe them through
and through?\pIf your bonds of trust are frail,
you will never beat my brethren!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack_hns
source:
SPENSER: Gwahahah!
You've battled your way up again?\pYou must have developed a truly
formidable bond with your POKéMON.\pSo be it!\pThis time, I won't bluster or hold back.
This time, there's no fooling around.\pReady now?
Prepare to lose!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_Kaaah_hns
source: … … …Kaaah!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserYourTeamIsAdmirable_hns
source: SPENSER: Well, that was some display!\nEven fully unleashed, my brethren\lcould not overpower you.\pYour team spirit is truly admirable!\pHere!\nBring me that thing, will you?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_HurryWithFrontierPass_hns
source: My, my, if only you could maintain\na certain level of decorum…\pGaaah, here!\nHurry with that FRONTIER PASS, you!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpiritsSymbolTookGoldenShine_hns
source: The Spirits Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserComeSeeMeAgain_hns
source: SPENSER: Gwahahah!\pCome see me time and again!\nMy brethren and I will be waiting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_PeopleAndMonAreSame_hns
source: People and POKéMON, they are but\nthe same…\pTheir individual nature makes them\ngood at certain things, and not good\lat others.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_LetMonDoWhatItLikes_hns
source: Rather than trying to make a POKéMON\ndo what it dislikes, try to let it do\lwhat it likes and is good at doing.\pPut yourself in the POKéMON's position\nand consider what moves it would like.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_MonDifferentWhenCornered_hns
source: A POKéMON's nature is a remarkable\nthing…\pSome POKéMON behave in a completely\ndifferent way when they are cornered.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_BeginningToUnderstandNature_hns
source: Are you beginning to understand how\na POKéMON's nature makes it behave?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceCorridor_Text_HeartfeltBondBetweenYouAndMons_hns
source: Ah… I see a strong, heartfelt bond\nbetween you and your POKéMON…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThese POKéMON must all be of
Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle_hns
source: Where the hearts of TRAINERS\nare put to the test.\pI welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.\pI accept challenges to the SINGLE\nBATTLE HALLS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeSingleBattleChallenge_hns
source: Do you wish to take\nthe SINGLE BATTLE HALL challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge_hns
source:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for SINGLE BATTLES\lthat are named SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.\pThe SINGLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial\lrule that must be obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReturnWhenFortified_hns
source: When you have fortified your heart\nand POKéMON, you must return.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhichChallenge_hns
source: There are two BATTLE HALLS,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice of a challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50_hns
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThese POKéMON must all be of
Level 50 or lower.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd_hns
source: Come back when you have made\nyour preparations.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen_hns
source:
Sigh…\pYou do not have the three POKéMON
required for the challenge.\pTo enter, you must provide three
different kinds of POKéMON.\pThey also must not be holding
the same kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NowSelectThreeMons_hns
source: Good. Now, you must select your\nthree POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge_hns2_hns
source: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FollowMe_hns
source: Good.\nNow, follow me.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded_hns
source: I feel privileged for having seen\nyour POKéMON's exploits.\pThe results will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak_hns
source: To achieve a 7-win streak…\pThe bonds that bind your heart with\nyour POKéMON seem firm and true.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded_hns
source: Your feat will be recorded.\nI must ask you to briefly wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_BattlePointsFor7WinStreak_hns
source: For the feat of your 7-win streak,\nwe present you with Battle Point(s).$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NoSpaceForPrize_hns
source: You seem to have no space for\nour prize.\pYou should return when you have\norganized your BAG.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WeHaveBeenWaiting_hns
source: We have been waiting for you…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge_hns
source: I must save before I show you to\nthe BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge_hns
source: Sigh…\pYou failed to save before you ended\nyour challenge the last time.\pAs a result, your challenge has been\ndisqualified. It is most unfortunate.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize_hns
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink_hns
source:
For a hardy fellow like me,
hardy POKéMON are the best.\pOffense is the best defense!
A relentless attack is the ultimate!\pBut that's not what I wanted to chat
about.\pEvery so often a really cute lady
swings by here.\pShe says that she can tell what
POKéMON are thinking.\pI don't know about that part,
but she is really cute.\pHuh?
Why are you looking at me like that?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere_hns
source:
Hmm…\pIt appears that the nature of POKéMON
and the moves that they have been\ltaught are the keys to battle here.\pTo be more precise, it's how well
the moves match the nature of\lthe POKéMON.\pIf your POKéMON is in trouble and
unable to live up to its potential,\lyou may need to examine how well\lits moves match its nature.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms_hns
source: My POKéMON is usually very docile.\pBut when it's in a BATTLE HALL,\nit sometimes seems to become\ltransformed into something wicked!\pIt becomes totally intimidating.\nIt's shocking, even.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway_hns
source: I wonder what sort of nature a POKéMON\nwould have if it favored enfeebling its\lopponents and chipping away slowly.\pI'd be surprised if it was a LAX nature.\pBut, nah, that can't be right.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle_hns
source: Where the hearts of TRAINERS\nare put to the test.\pI welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.\pI accept challenges to the DOUBLE\nBATTLE HALLS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeDoubleBattleChallenge_hns
source: Do you wish to take\nthe DOUBLE BATTLE HALL challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge_hns
source:
In the BATTLE PALACE, there are
several auditoriums for DOUBLE BATTLES\lthat are named DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLES are conducted in
the usual way, except with one crucial\lrule that must be obeyed.\pTRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.\pTRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,\lwe will present you with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ToDefeatMavenAnd7Trainers_hns
source: To defeat the PALACE MAVEN\nand seven TRAINERS in a row…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_PresentYouWithBattlePoints_hns
source: In honor of the bond you share with\nyour POKéMON, we present you with\lthese Battle Point(s).$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LikeToRecordMatch_hns
source: Would you like to record your latest\nBATTLE PALACE match on your\lFRONTIER PASS?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_RulesAreListed_hns
source: The BATTLE HALL rules are listed.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading_hns
source: Which heading do you want to read?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics_hns
source: Here, POKéMON are required to think\nand battle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, POKéMON that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature_hns
source:
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDue to its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves_hns
source:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPOKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered_hns
source:
When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger_hns
source: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a POKéMON begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeCorridor_Text_YourChallengeHasBegun_hns
source: Your Battle Choice challenge\nhas now begun…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePike_hns
source: Where the luck of TRAINERS\nis put to the test…\pWelcome to the BATTLE PIKE…\pI am your guide to the BATTLE PIKE…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_TakeChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to take the Battle\nChoice challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike_hns
source:
Here we conduct an event we call
the Battle Choice.\pThe Battle Choice rules are very
simple…\pChoose one of three paths and make
your way to the goal room at the end\lof the BATTLE PIKE. It's that simple.\pHowever, what happens on the chosen
path depends entirely on the luck\lof the challenger…\pIf you reach the goal, you will be
rewarded with Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please have a word with\lour staff in the big rooms on the way.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_LookForwardToSeeingYou_hns
source: We look forward to seeing you\non another occasion…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WhichChallengeMode_hns
source: You have the choice of two courses,\nLevel 50 and Open Level.\lWhich will you challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50_hns
source:
I beg your pardon, but…\pYou do not have three eligible
POKéMON for the Battle Choice event.\pYou must have three different POKéMON
of Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd_hns
source: Please come see me when\nyou are ready…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen_hns
source:
I beg your pardon, but…\pYou do not have three eligible
POKéMON for the Battle Choice event.\pYou must have three different
POKéMON to enter.\pThey also must be holding different
kinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_PleaseChooseThreeMons_hns
source: Please choose the three POKéMON\nyou wish to enter in the challenge…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_SaveBeforeChallenge_hns
source: Before starting your Battle Choice\nchallenge, I must save the game.\lIs that acceptable?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_StepThisWay_hns
source: Please step this way…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ChallengeEndedRecordResults_hns
source: Your challenge has ended…\pI shall record your results.\nPlease wait…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_PossessLuckInAbundance_hns
source: You have completed the challenge…\pI must say… You seem to possess luck\nin abundance…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ShallRecordResults_hns
source: I shall record your results.\nPlease wait…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_AwardYouTheseBattlePoints_hns2_hns
source: To commemorate your completion of\nthe Battle Choice challenge, we award\lyou these Battle Point(s)…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ReachedBattlePointLimit_hns
source: You appear to have reached the limit\nfor Battle Points…\pPlease exchange some Battle Points\nfor prizes, then return…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeQuitting_hns
source: I beg your pardon, but…\pYou failed to save before you quit\nyour challenge the last time.\pBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. I am sorry…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_SnatchedVictoryFromQueen_hns
source: Congratulations…\pYou have snatched victory from the\nPIKE QUEEN and cleared the event…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_AwardYouTheseBattlePoints_hns
source: In recognition of your amazing luck,\nwe award you these Battle Point(s)…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_OneRoomAwayFromGoal_hns
source: Arrgh! I blew my chance!\nI was one room away from the goal!\pIn this place, you'd better watch out\nfor poison, freezing, and so on.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NeverHadToBattleTrainer_hns
source: I've completed the challenge 10 times\nnow, but I've never had to battle\la TRAINER once.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ThinkAbilitiesUsefulHere_hns
source: Listen! Listen!\pDon't you think that the special\nabilities of POKéMON will be useful\lhere?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_TrainersWhicheverPathIChoose_hns
source: What is this weird place?\nI can't figure it out at all!\pI've taken the challenge a bunch\nof times, but all I ever do is run into\lTRAINERS whichever path I choose.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_RulesAreListed_hns
source: The Battle Choice's rules are listed.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading_hns
source: Which heading do you want to read?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainPokenavBagRules_hns
source: The BAG and POKéNAV may not be used\nduring a Battle Choice challenge.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainHeldItemRules_hns
source: During a Battle Choice challenge,\nany BERRY or HERB held by POKéMON\lwill be effective only once.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainMonOrderRules_hns
source: During a Battle Choice challenge,\nthe sequence of POKéMON cannot be\lchanged.\pThe sequence must be set before\nstarting your challenge.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomFinal_Text_CongratsThisWayPlease_hns
source: Congratulations…\nNow, this way, please…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WatchOut
source: Oh, my!\pWatch out!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForKirlia
source: I must apologize to you…\pMy KIRLIA has a TIMID nature…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForDusclops
source: I must apologize to you…\pMy DUSCLOPS has a TIMID nature…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreToFullHealth_hns
source: Welcome…\nYou must be commended for your luck…\pYour POKéMON shall be restored\nto full health…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_EnjoyRestOfChallenge_hns
source: I urge you to enjoy the rest of your\nBattle Choice challenge…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreOneMon_hns
source: Ah, you're a lucky one.\nI'm in somewhat-good spirits now.\pI will restore one of your POKéMON\nto full health.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BestOfLuckFarewell_hns
source: The best of luck to you.\nFarewell.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_CareForBattleWillRestoreMons_hns
source: Excuse me…\pWould you care for a battle?\nI'll restore your POKéMON if you win.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_NowShallWe_hns
source: Very well…\nNow, shall we?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_HowUnsportingOfYou_hns
source: I see…\nHow unsporting of you…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreMonsAsPromised_hns
source: Magnificent…\pAs promised, I shall restore your\nPOKéMON to full health.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BestOfLuckFarewell_hns2_hns
source: The best of luck to you.\nFarewell.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WatchOut_hns
source: Oh, my!\pWatch out!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaStop_hns
source: Now, now!\nKIRLIA, stop that!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_DusclopsStop_hns
source: Now, now!\nDUSCLOPS, stop that!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedToxic_hns
source: KIRLIA used TOXIC!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedHypnosis_hns
source: KIRLIA used HYPNOSIS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedThunderWave_hns
source: KIRLIA used THUNDER WAVE!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedWillOWisp_hns
source: KIRLIA used WILL-O-WISP!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_DusclopsUsedWillOWisp_hns
source: DUSCLOPS used WILL-O-WISP!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_DusclopsUsedIceBeam_hns
source: DUSCLOPS used ICE BEAM!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ThatsEnough_hns
source: Look here!\nThat's quite enough!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForKirlia_hns
source: I must apologize to you…\pMy KIRLIA has a TIMID nature…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForDusclops_hns
source: I must apologize to you…\pMy DUSCLOPS has a TIMID nature…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AttacksWhenStartled_hns
source: It attacks without warning if it is\nstartled by another person…\pAre you and your POKéMON all right?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeHopeMonsAreFine_hns
source: I do apologize for what happened…\nI do hope your POKéMON are fine.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BattleSomewhatToughTrainer_hns
source: Welcome…\pHere, we will have you battle\na somewhat-tough TRAINER…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_RestoreToFullHealth_hns
source: How wonderful…\pTo honor your victory, your POKéMON\nshall be restored to full health…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_EnjoyRestOfChallenge_hns2_hns
source: I urge you to enjoy the rest of your\nBattle Choice challenge…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ImThePikeQueen_hns
source:
I am LUCY…
I am the law here…\lFor I am the PIKE QUEEN…\pYou already know it, but to advance,
you must defeat me…\p…I'm not one for idle chatter.
Hurry. Come on…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_HopeYouDidntUseUpLuck_hns
source: Your luck…\nI hope you didn't use it all up here…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyShowMeFrontierPass_hns
source: LUCY: … … … … … …\nShow me your FRONTIER PASS…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ReceivedLuckSymbol_hns
source: The Luck Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AllThereIsDisappear_hns
source: …That's all there is…\nDisappear already…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain_hns
source:
LUCY: …You again…\p… … … … … …\p…I've trampled flowers and braved
storms to get to where I am…\pI don't feel any compulsion to keep
losing to the same opponent…\p… … … … … …
Fine… I'll do it…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_NowComeOn_hns
source: Now!\nCome on!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyFrontierPass_hns
source: LUCY: … … … … … …\p…FRONTIER PASS…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LuckSymbolTookGoldenShine_hns
source: The Luck Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_IWontForget_hns
source: …You, I won't forget…\n…Ever…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomNoHeal_hns
source: I welcome you…\pGiggle…\nYou seem to be bereft of luck…\pIf only you hadn't chosen this room,\nyour POKéMON could have been healed…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealOne_hns
source: I welcome you…\pSince you have chosen this room, I will\nrestore one POKéMON to full health…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealTwo_hns
source: I welcome you…\pSince you have chosen this room, I will\nrestore two POKéMON to full health…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreAllMons_hns
source: I welcome you…\pGiggle…\nYou should thank your lucky stars…\pSince you have chosen this room,\nall your POKéMON will be restored…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ShallFetchOurMaster_hns
source: I shall go fetch our master…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreTwoMons_hns
source: Ah, you're a lucky one!\nI'm in good spirits now.\pI will restore two of your POKéMON\nto full health!$

source: You are currently in\nthe 1st room…$

source: You are currently in\nthe 3rd room…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom5_hns
source: You are currently in\nthe 5th room…$

source: You are currently in\nthe 9th room…$

source: You are currently in\nthe 11th room…$

source: You are currently in\nthe 13th room…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid_hns
source:
The Battle Quest is a battling
event in which you must explore\lthe PYRAMID and try to reach the top.\pIn the PYRAMID are seven floors of
mazes, all of them filled with not only\lskilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.\pYou must enter with three POKéMON,
none of them holding an item.\pOn your ascent, you will be provided
with a BATTLE BAG for items.\pIf you fail in your challenge, any item
placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, you must select “REST”\land save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode_hns

source:
A slight problem, adventurer!\pYou seem to not have the three
POKéMON qualified for the challenge.\pThe three POKéMON must be different
and each no higher than Level 50.\pPlease also remember to take all
items from your POKéMON.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

source: Please pick the items you'll keep in the\nBATTLE BAG, and with your POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReturnedEverythingMonsHeld_hns
source: {PLAYER} returned everything that\nthe POKéMON held.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_UsedBattleBagWillBeKept_hns
source: The BATTLE BAG you used will be kept\nin readiness for your next challenge.\p{PLAYER} turned the BATTLE BAG over\nfor the BAG's return.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RecordResultsWait_hns
source: I must record your results.\nPlease wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ForConqueringPyramidTakeThis_hns
source: As a memento for conquering\nthe BATTLE PYRAMID, please take this.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReceivedPrizeItem_hns
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BagIsFull_hns
source: …Ah…\nYour BAG appears to be filled.\pPlease return after you've organized\nyour BAG's contents.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_DisappointingHereIsBag_hns
source: How disappointing for you…\pHere is the BAG we've been holding\nfor you.\p{PLAYER} got the BAG back.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextChallenge_hns
source: We look forward to your\nnext challenge!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HereIsPrize_hns
source: We have been looking forward to\nyour arrival!\pHere is your prize for conquering\nthe PYRAMID.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TellYouWhatMisfortunesAwait_hns
source: Welcome…\pI shall be pleased to tell you what\nmisfortunes await in the PYRAMID…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintParalysis_hns
source: I see a shower of sparks…\p…And in it, I see your POKéMON\nstruggling with paralysis…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPoison_hns
source: I see poison…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom the effects of poison…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBurn_hns
source: I see bright red flames…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom burns…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPPWaste_hns
source: I sense the tremendous pressure of\nunrequited anger…\pIt is a curse…\p…And, I see your POKéMON drained of\nPower Points and having no recourse\lbut to use STRUGGLE…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintLevitate_hns
source: I see POKéMON loftily airborne…\p…And, I see your POKéMON frustrated\nby powerless GROUND-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintTrapAbility_hns
source: I sense terrific energy rising from\nthe ground below…\p…And, I see your POKéMON unable to\nescape the power's clutches…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintIce_hns
source: I see ICE-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON fighting\nthe freezing effects of ice…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintExplosion_hns
source: I see a flurry of moves that imperil\nthe user…\p…And, I see your POKéMON falling\nto them…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintPsychic_hns
source: I see PSYCHIC-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON in torment\nfrom PSYCHIC moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintRock_hns
source: I see ROCK-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom ROCK moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFighting_hns
source: I see FIGHTING-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON pummeled\nby FIGHTING moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWeather_hns
source:
RAIN DANCE… SUNNY DAY…
SANDSTORM… HAIL…\pI see POKéMON that become stronger
with the weather…\p…And, I see your POKéMON confounded
by different types of moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintBug_hns
source: I see BUG-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom different kinds of attacks…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintDark_hns
source: I see DARK-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom DARK-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintWater_hns
source: I see WATER-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom WATER-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintGhost_hns
source: I see GHOST-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom GHOST-type moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintSteel_hns
source: I see STEEL-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom enormously powerful moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFlyingDragon_hns
source: I see flying POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom enormously powerful moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve_hns
source:
I see those that have evolved from
the power of stones…\pI also sense fire, water,
and electricity…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering
from those three powers…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintNormal_hns
source: I see NORMAL-type POKéMON…\p…And, I see your POKéMON suffering\nfrom enormously powerful moves…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BelieveMyFortunesOrNot_hns
source: Whether you believe my fortunes\nor not, the choice is yours…\pThe future can be changed anytime…\nI wish you safe passage…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning_hns
source: Did you know?\pIf you run fast, TRAINERS may notice\nand come after you for a battle.\pSo, if you want to avoid TRAINERS,\ndon't catch their eyes, but sneak\lcautiously and quietly past them.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems_hns
source: Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!\pI had a whole lot of items, but I lost\nthem all when I lost!\pAwaaaaaaarrrrgh!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing_hns
source: Welcome back!\nYou've done the unthinkable!\pYou've defeated the PYRAMID KING\nand conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_GiveYouTheseBattlePoints_hns
source: Young explorer!\nIn commendation of your courage,\lwe give you these Battle Point(s)!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RulesAreListed_hns
source: The Battle Quest rules are listed.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading_hns
source: Which heading do you want to read?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules_hns
source: When the PYRAMID is conquered,\nthe wild POKéMON that appear in it\lare replaced by different kinds.\pExplore, observe, and learn what kinds\nof wild POKéMON you may encounter.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules_hns
source:
TRAINERS are lying in wait for you
inside the PYRAMID.\pOn each floor, there are up to
eight TRAINERS.\pWhen you defeat a TRAINER, you will
get a helpful hint for your adventure.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules_hns
source:
The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange
themselves every time you enter it.\pThe mazes are poorly lit.
You must advance with caution.\pThe light grows brighter whenever you
defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules_hns
source:
The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG
while in the PYRAMID.\pThere are two separate BATTLE BAGS--
one each for the Level 50 and\lOpen Level adventures.\pThey each can hold up to 99 pieces
of ten kinds of items.\pThe contents of the BATTLE BAG are
lost if you fail in your quest.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReachedSummitUpYouGo_hns
source:
It is a delight to see you here!
You have reached the summit of\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID!\pAbove here is the PYRAMID's
lookout point.\pIt is a place open only to those
who have conquered the PYRAMID.\pNow, please!
Up you go!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_PlayerConqueredPyramid_hns
source: The PYRAMID's new conqueror!\nLet the name {PLAYER} be known!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ChiefBeatYouHere_hns
source:
It is a delight to see you here!\pUnfortunately, you were second by
a mere fraction of time!\pOur chief has already conquered
the PYRAMID ahead of you.\pHowever, my young explorer…
You are a TRAINER!\pAssert your power and take the glory
of the pinnacle from our chief!\pNow, please! When you are ready,
take one more step of courage!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ExplorationsAreGrandestAdventure_hns
source: Young adventurer…\pWouldn't you agree that explorations\nare the grandest of adventures?\pYour own wits!\pYour own strength!\pYour own POKéMON!\pAnd, above all, only your own courage\nto lead you through unknown worlds…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ImPyramidKingBrandon_hns
source:
Aah, yes, indeed this life is grand!
Grand, it is! Eh?\pI'm BRANDON!\pI'm the PYRAMID KING, which means
I'm in charge here.\pMost people call me the chief!\pYou coming here means you have
that much confidence in yourself,\lam I right?\pHahahah!
This should be exciting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BringCourageToOurBattle_hns
source: Now, then!\nBring your courage to our battle!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonFrontierPassPlease_hns
source: BRANDON: Hahahah! Grand it was!\nGrand, yes, indeed!\pWell done! You've earned recognition!\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_ReceivedBraveSymbol_hns
source: The Brave Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_LookForwardToNextMeeting_hns
source: Young explorer!\nI look forward to our next meeting!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonYouveReturned_hns
source:
BRANDON: …You've finally returned,
young explorer…\pYour love of adventure seems to come
deep from within your heart…\pYes… You are exactly as I was in
my own youth…\p… … …Ah…\pThe passionate!\pThe dangerous!\pThe desperate!\pThose days of death-defying,
life-affirming adventures are back…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_MyCourageIsOffMeter_hns
source: Now, then!\pI sense my own courage is off\nthe meter!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_EverythingYouHave_hns
source: Everything you have!\nI'm braced for it all!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BrandonRemarkableHaveThis_hns
source: BRANDON: Hahahah!\nRemarkable!\lYes, it's grand, indeed!\pYoung explorer!\pYou've bested me through and through!\nHere! I want you to have this!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_BraveSymbolTookGoldenShine_hns
source: The Brave Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_FarewellForNow_hns
source: Ah, yes! It just goes to show that\nI have much to learn still!\pMay our paths cross again!\nFarewell for now, young explorer!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidTop_Text_StepForwardWhenReady_hns
source: Now, when you are ready, take courage\nand step forward.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth_hns
source: We will restore your POKéMON to\nfull health.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForOpponent_hns
source: You will be facing opponent no. {STR_VAR_1}.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent_hns
source: You will be facing opponent no. 2.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent_hns
source: You will be facing opponent no. 3.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent_hns
source: You will be facing opponent no. 4.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent_hns
source: You will be facing opponent no. 5.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent_hns
source: You will be facing opponent no. 6.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent_hns
source: You will be facing opponent no. 7.\nAre you ready?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordYourBattle_hns
source: Record your battle on your\nFRONTIER PASS?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BattleRecordedOnPass_hns
source: {PLAYER}'s battle was recorded\non the FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame_hns
source: Would you like to save and\nquit the game?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait_hns
source: Saving your battle data.\nPlease wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_CancelYourChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to cancel your BATTLE\nROOM challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordCouldntBeSaved_hns
source: There was an error of some sort.\nYour record could not be saved.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SalonMaidenOnHerWay_hns
source: Excuse me, but…\pOur leader, the SALON MAIDEN, is on\nher way here in hopes of battling you.\pShe should be arriving very shortly.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSalonMaiden_hns
source: You will be facing the SALON MAIDEN.\nAre you prepared?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel_hns
source:
Greetings…
My name is ANABEL.\pI am the SALON MAIDEN, and I am in
charge of running the BATTLE TOWER…\pI have heard several rumors
about you…\pIn all honesty, what I have heard does
not seem attractive in any way…\pThe reason I've come to see you…
Well, there is but one reason…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetMeSeeYourTalent_hns
source: Let me see your talent in\nits entirety…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelTalentShallBeRecognized_hns
source: ANABEL: Fufufu, nicely done…\pYour FRONTIER PASS, please…\nYour talent shall be recognized.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedAbilitySymbol_hns
source: The Ability Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_UntilNextTime_hns
source:
… … … … … …\pYou have confidence in your POKéMON
battling talent, don't you?\pI urge you to keep battling and
keep on winning.\pI will be waiting for you.
Until the next time we meet…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelYouCameBack_hns
source:
ANABEL: You really did come back to
see me…\p… … … … … …\pYou've won straight matches to see me…
I won't have to hold back against you…\pIt's been too long now…\pToo long since I've been able to battle
without thinking about anything…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetsBeginShallWe_hns
source: Let's begin, shall we?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelCongratsYourPassPlease_hns
source: ANABEL: Fufu, congratulations…\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AbilitySymbolTookGoldenShine_hns
source: The Ability Symbol took on\na golden shine!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_WishICouldBattleYouAgain_hns
source: That was fun…\pI have never had a POKéMON battle\nso enjoyable before…\pI wish I could battle with you again…$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DirectYouToBattleRoom_hns
source: I'll direct you to your BATTLE ROOM now.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou didn't save before you quit your\nchallenge last time.\pBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. Sorry!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CongratsBeatenSeven_hns
source: Congratulations!\nYou've beaten all seven TRAINERS!\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_EarnedFabulousPrize_hns
source: For beating seven TRAINERS in a row,\nyou have earned this fabulous prize!\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize_hns
source: {PLAYER} received the prize\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BagFullMakeRoom_hns
source: Oh, your BAG appears to be full.\pPlease make room in your BAG, then come\nsee me.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThankYouForPlaying_hns
source: Thank you for playing!\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordWillBeSaved_hns
source: Your record will be saved.\nPlease wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou_hns
source: We've been waiting for you!\p$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ProgressWillBeSaved_hns
source: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress will be saved. Please wait.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AboutToFace50thTrainer_hns
source: You're finally about to face the\n50th TRAINER.\pFrom here on, every time you beat seven\nTRAINERS in a row, your POKéMON will\lreceive a commemorative RIBBON.\pGood luck!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HereAreSomeRibbons_hns
source: Here are some RIBBONS for beating\nseven tough TRAINERS in a row.\p{PLAYER} received some RIBBONS!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PutRibbonOnMons_hns
source: {PLAYER} put the RIBBONS on\nthe challenger POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeFeelingsAboutBattleTower_hns
source: Excuse me, do you have a moment?\pCan you describe your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a BATTLE TOWER\lmatch, or when you've either won or\llost a match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouBegin_hns
source: Okay, what are your feelings when\nyou're about to begin a match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveWon_hns
source: What do you feel when you've won\na match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FeelWhatWhenYouveLost_hns
source: Can I hear about your feelings when\nyou have lost a match?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DontThinkMuchAboutIt_hns
source: Oh, so you don't think much about it?\nYou're one cool customer.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChangedYourMind_hns
source: Hunh? You changed your mind?\nI guess you're fickle.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsHowYouFeel_hns
source: Okay, so that's how you feel?\nThat's quite original.\pThanks!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WinsInRowRecorded_hns
source: The number of matches you win in a row\nis recorded.\pI'd better not get beaten in\nan embarrassing way!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CanLeaveUntilLossOrSevenWins_hns
source: Once you've entered the BATTLE TOWER,\nyou can't leave until you either lose\lor you beat seven TRAINERS in a row.\pYou'd best be certain that you're up\nto the challenge.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DoubleBattleRoomConstruction_hns
source:
Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER
DOUBLE BATTLE CORNER!\pUnfortunately, the BATTLE ROOMS
are still under construction.\pPlease come back when the work
is completed.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_MultiBattleRoomConstruction_hns
source:
Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER
MULTI BATTLE CORNER!\pUnfortunately, the BATTLE ROOMS
are still under construction.\pPlease come back when the work
is completed.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LookForwardToAnotherChallenge_hns
source: We look forward to seeing you on\nanother challenge!$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode_hns
source: The BATTLE ROOM offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.\lWhich is your choice?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectMons_hns
source: Please select the POKéMON you wish\nto enter.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeEntering_hns
source: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress must be saved. Is that okay?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ShowYouToBattleRoom_hns
source: I will now show you to the\n{STR_VAR_1} BATTLE ROOM.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch_hns
source: Shall I record your last BATTLE TOWER\nmatch on your FRONTIER PASS?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have {STR_VAR_2} eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have {STR_VAR_2} different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsEnd_hns
source: Please come see me when you are ready.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have {STR_VAR_2} eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have {STR_VAR_2} different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50_hnsSingles_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have three different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen_hnsSingles_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have three different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50_hnsDoubles_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have four eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have four different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen_hnsDoubles_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have four eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have four different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50_hnsMultis_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have two eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have two different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen_hnsMultis_hns
source: Excuse me!\pYou don't have two eligible POKéMON.\pYou must have two different POKéMON\nto enter.\pThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\pEGGS{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomSingleBattle_hns
source: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the SINGLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge_hns
source: Would you like to take the SINGLE\nBATTLE ROOM challenge?$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge_hns
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's SINGLE BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lSINGLE BATTLES with three POKéMON.\pThere are many SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS,
seven TRAINERS await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven,
you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons_hns
source: Now please select the three POKéMON\nthat are to be entered.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeDoubleBattle_hns
source: Where the talents of TRAINERS\nare put to the test!\pWelcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\pI am your guide to the DOUBLE\nBATTLE ROOMS.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge_hns

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge_hns
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's DOUBLE BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lDOUBLE BATTLES with four POKéMON.\pThere are many DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn each of the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS,

you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultisChallenge_hns
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES.\pFor MULTI BATTLES, you must partner
with a TRAINER in the TOWER and enter\lwith two POKéMON each.\pInside the TOWER is a room named
the BATTLE SALON where you may meet\lother TRAINERS.\pThere, you must find a TRAINER to act
as your partner in MULTI BATTLES.\pOnce you have partnered up, you will
be shown to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM.\pIn the MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven
tag teams await your challenge.\pIf you manage to defeat all seven
teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge_hns
source:
The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE
ROOMS are facilities for conducting\lMULTI BATTLES with a friend.\pYou must link with your friend using
Wireless Adapters or a Game Boy\lAdvance Game Link cable.\pYou must partner with your friend and
enter two different kinds of POKéMON.\pThere are many MULTI BATTLE ROOMS
in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.\pIn a MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven

teams, you will earn Battle Points.\pPlease beware that unlike other ROOMS,
you may not interrupt your challenge.\pOnce you start, you must battle seven

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules_hns
source:
The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where
four types of battles are waged--\lSINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI\lBATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE.\pFor each of these types, there are
separate BATTLE ROOMS.\pPlease speak with a guide offering
the type of battle you wish to enter.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules_hns
source:
Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are
entering, you will be required to take\la certain number of POKéMON.\pThe SINGLE BATTLE mode requires
three POKéMON.\pThe DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four,
and the MULTI modes both require two.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules_hns
source:
The BATTLE SALON is where you must
find a partner to form a tag team for\lthe MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge.\pChoose the best partner for you by
examining other TRAINERS'\lPOKéMON and their moves.\pYou may choose a new tag partner
after winning seven straight matches.$

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules_hns
source:
The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two
friends to mount a challenge together.\pYou and your friend must be linked with
Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link\lcable.\pYou must choose two POKéMON at
the registration counter.\pThese POKéMON must be different
from those of your friend.\pYou may not interrupt this challenge
in the middle, unlike other modes.$

who's taking that facility's challenge,\land bet with our Battle Points.\pThe guy who bet on the TRAINER with
the best record takes all the Battle\lPoints in the pool.\pSounds simple, huh?
So, anyway…$

You don't believe me.\pI'm not like that blowhard woman over

I can teach your POKéMON special and\lyet cute moves.\pBut my lessons don't come free.

abilities.\pIn fact, their POKéMON moves have

source: Recovers up to\nhalf the user's\nmaximum HP.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossDesc_hns
source: Inflicts damage\nidentical to the\nuser's level.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDesc_hns
source: Recovers half the\ndamage inflicted\non a sleeping foe.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDesc_hns
source: A strong punch\nthrown with\nincredible power.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc_hns
source: An extremely\npowerful kick with\nintense force.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc_hns
source: A full-body slam\nthat may cause\nparalysis.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDesc_hns
source: Large boulders\nare hurled. May\ncause flinching.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc_hns
source: Retaliates any\nphysical hit with\ndouble the power.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc_hns
source: A weak jolt of\nelectricity that\nparalyzes the foe.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc_hns
source: A fighting dance\nthat sharply\nraises ATTACK.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc_hns
source: Curls up to con-\nceal weak spots\nand raise DEFENSE.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc_hns
source: A loud attack\nthat can be used\nonly while asleep.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc_hns
source: Hurls mud in the\nfoe's face to re-\nduce its accuracy.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc_hns
source: Sprays star-\nshaped rays\nthat never miss.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc_hns
source: A chilling attack\nthat lowers the\nfoe's SPEED.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc_hns
source: Endures any at-\ntack for 1 turn,\nleaving 1HP.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc_hns
source: Copies the foe's\neffect(s) and\ngives to the user.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc_hns
source: An icy punch\nthat may\nfreeze the foe.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunchDesc_hns
source: An electrified\npunch that may\nparalyze the foe.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDesc_hns
source: A fiery punch\nthat may burn\nthe foe.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ElementalTutorIntro
source: Zzzzzz…\pWhat, how, what?\pOh, sorry, I was snoozing a bit.\pI'm the ELEMENTAL TUTOR.\pI have the power to teach the most\npowerful moves to GRASS, FIRE and\lWATER TYPE POKéMON.\pDid you come to learn such a strong\npower?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ElementalTutorWelcomeBack
source: Zzzzzz…\pWhat, how, what, who?\pOh, did you come to learn the\npower of my strongest moves?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMoveElemental
source: Which move do you think is suitable\nfor your POKéMON?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_StrongElementalMoveDesc
source: Powerful, but\nleaves the user\nimmobile one turn.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds_hns
source:
What a TRAINER needs…\pKnowledge…
Strategy…\lLuck…\lGuts…\lSpirit…\lBravery…\lAnd ability…\pWell, I'm all set in every way!
I'll be unstoppable at every building!\pHuh? POKéMON?
What's that?$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains_hns
source: Do you know about the FRONTIER\nBRAINS?\pThat's what SCOTT calls the seven\nspecial TRAINERS that run the seven\lfacilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling_hns
source: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl\ntold me that I have a lot of talent\lfor battling!\pI like POKéMON CONTESTS more!\pBut I'm no good at CONTESTS!\pI guess having talent and liking\nsomething aren't the same.$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandson_hns
source: We came here to chaperon our\ngrandson.\pBut since we're here, we thought\nwe should get some souvenirs.$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNiceGift_hns
source: Dear, what do you think of this?\nWouldn't this make a nice gift?\pIt's…PRO…TE…IN?\nIt sounds delicious, doesn't it?$

label: BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontAllowItems_hns
source: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's\nfacilities don't allow the use of items\lduring battles.\pThat rule makes things tougher than\nthey already are!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE TOWER!\nKeep the win streak as the toughest\lTRAINER!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE PALACE!\nKeep your eyes on POKéMON battles!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE ARENA!\nLet the toughest teams gather!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!\nAdvance through the Battle Quest!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign_hns
source: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL\nSet your sights on new records!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign_hns
source: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER\nExchange your Battle Points!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial_hns
source: Wow!\nIt's huge!\pThe BATTLE TOWER feels special.\nIt's different from the others.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier_hns
source: My grand ambition is to conquer both\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON\lLEAGUE.\pAnd if my dream comes true…\pI… I'm going to ask MIMI next door\nif she will be friends with me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh_hns
