source: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, maybe I can\nclimb the outside…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness_hns
source: I thrive in darkness…\nYes… What is worthy of me?\lNone other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…\pWhat say you to wandering in darkness\nand in utter and total desperation?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam_hns
source: I didn't sleep for a week, but then\nI put together the ultimate team!\pI can't see myself losing, no joke.\nWe're storming the BATTLE ARENA!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere_hns
source:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?\pIt sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…\pI've never seen him battling in person
ever.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy_hns
source: ZIGG!\nI believe in you, little buddy!\pI'll make my little ZIGG any favorite\ntasty treats you like if you win!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant_hns
source: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody_hns
source:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.\pYour hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!\lOops, it's almost dinnertime!\pI don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader_hns
source: I may not look that impressive now,\nbut I once beat a GYM LEADER.\pWho knows, maybe I should give it\nanother shot at glory.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles_hns
source: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for\nthe way I battle, too.\pI win matches in the blink of\nan eye!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon_hns
source: I'm better than my daddy\nat POKéMON.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy_hns
source: Go on, my baby sweetie!\nGo rack up some wins for Daddy!\pYou're just like your mother,\nso you'll be dominating!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena_hns
source:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout\lpretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.\pInstead of her, do you know what
I found?\pA whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere_hns
source: I sometimes see this really important-\nlooking old man going in there.\pHe has these really awesome POKéMON.\nHe seems really nice, though.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid_hns
source:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?\pWhen there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,\lthere shall appear a man among men.\pDon't know that legend?
Well, of course not!\lI just made it up!\pWhat's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut_hns
source:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!\pBut I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!\pAnd then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower_hns
source: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll_hns
source: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere_hns
source: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou_hns
source: With you by my side, I can do anything.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome_hns
source:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers_hns
source:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle_hns
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere_hns
source: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you a good memory?\pI have this feeling there once was\nan odd tree past here.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail_hns
source:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
source:
Crunch, munch…\pA while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.\pShe had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.\pCrunch, munch…\pShe got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.\pIt was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.\pCrunch, munch…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE DOME!\nYour path to the invincible superstar!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE FACTORY!\nSeek out the toughest POKéMON!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign_hns
source: This is the BATTLE PIKE!\nChoose one of three paths!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower_hns
source: This is the BATTLE TOWER.\pTRAINERS bring their best-raised\nPOKéMON for elimination-style matches.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket_hns
source: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard_hns
source: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…\pI'm terribly sorry.\pYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo_hns
source: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.\pPerfect! That's all you need!\pAnd where would you like to go?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs_hns
source: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs_hns
source: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime_hns
source: Please sail with us another time!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry_hns
source: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo_hns
source: Then, where would you like to go?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends_hns
source: I'm the best out of all my friends.\nBut here…\lI've been useless!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower_hns
source: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER,\nbut I can't find it even though I have\la map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis place is just too big!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere_hns
source: I wanted to take a challenge as soon\nas I arrived here.\pBut on the way, I got seasick…\nUrrrrp…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere_hns
source:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?\pOnly those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.\pThat's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons_hns
source: Hey, bro…\pAre you sure we can make challenges\neven if we don't have any POKéMON?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons_hns
source: Uh…\nI'm sure it'll be okay.\pI think…\pBut remember that big scary guy?\nHe said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons_hns
source: That's the BATTLE FACTORY.\nYou can rent strong POKéMON there.\pBut it makes me wonder.\nWho's raising those rental POKéMON?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper_hns
source: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE\nPIKE because of SEVIPER…\pB-but I came all the way here, so I will\ntry to conquer everything!\l…Shudder…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors_hns
source: Let's play rock, paper, scissors!\nOne, two, three!\p… … … … … …$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge_hns
source: Yay! I won!\nI will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge_hns
source: Oh, no…\nI lost.\pI guess I'm not very lucky today.\nI'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge\luntil tomorrow.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling_hns
source: I believe I'm the only person here who,\nfor some unknown reason, would choose\lfishing over battling.\pHuh? You can't catch anything here?\nThat's disappointing…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol_hns
source: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no\nmatter what, until I get a Symbol.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome_hns
source: Oh? You're off to challenge\nthe BATTLE DOME?\pI'll wish you the best of luck.\nLet us both win our way up and meet\lin challenges.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa_hns
source: Grandpa, over here!\nThe BATTLE DOME is here!\lGo get 'em, Grandpa!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe_hns
source: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?\nI won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!\pBut where is the entrance?$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo_hns
source: There used to be nothing here not all\nthat long ago.\pBut, now look at this place! Amazing!\nI'll bring my mother out to see this.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier_hns
source: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER!\pI'm sure to grab attention with\nmy looks and ability!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople_hns
source: Munch, munch…\pIt looks like this square's filled with\ntough people.\pMunch, munch…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike_hns
source:
Crunch, munch…\pA while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.\pShe had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.\pCrunch, munch…\pShe got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.\pIt was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.\pCrunch, munch…$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet_hns
source: Huh? Will you listen to yourself?\nThat's nothing!\pWhy, the last time I cheered for him,\nour eyes met and sparks flew!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering_hns
source:
Whaaaaaat?!
Pfft!\pThat only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!\pThe DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine_hns
source:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!\pYou fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!\pThe DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers_hns
source:
Those people squabbling over there…\pIt's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.\pThey used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.\pBut they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.\pThey were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.\pNow they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the\lBATTLE DOME every day now.$

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier_hns
source: I heard a rumor that someone saw\na POKéMON with an unusually long tail\lsomewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pIt must be adorable. I'm sure of it…\pOh, challenges can wait. I feel driven\nto find the delightful creature!$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeverSeenPokemon_hns
source:
There was someone here using a 
POKéMON I've never seen before.\pI never learned about it at
TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.\pI wonder where you can catch POKéMON
like that.$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NextStopBattleArena_hns
source: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA!\nI'd better get the right POKéMON from\lthe PC Storage System.$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoingThroughEveryChallenge_hns
source: Giggle… I'm going to go through every\nchallenge with just this baby!$

label: BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Skitty_hns
source: SKITTY: Mya myaaah!$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall_hns
source: This is the RANKING HALL.\pThis is where we recognize the immortal\nTRAINERS who left great records in\lBATTLE FRONTIER events.$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePikeFactoryRecords_hns
source: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE,\nand BATTLE FACTORY Records$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceArenaPyramidRecords_hns
source: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA,\nand BATTLE PYRAMID Records$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNameOnThisList_hns
source: Hi, is your name on this list?$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThatsSuper_hns
source: Wow, that's super!\nI'll have to try harder, too!$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName_hns
source: Oh, is that right?\pIf you saw your friend's name up here,\nI bet it would make you work harder!$

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere_hns
source: Hmm…\nMy name's not up there…\pWell, it's only natural since I haven't\ntaken any challenges yet.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstTimeHereThisWay_hns
source: Is it your first time here?\nPlease step this way!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier_hns
source: The front lines of POKéMON battling!\nWelcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass_hns
source: For a first-time visitor, we issue\nthe FRONTIER PASS.\pIt's for use at all the facilities\nin the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pHere you are!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ObtainedFrontierPass_hns
source: {PLAYER} obtained\nthe FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_PlacedTrainerCardInFrontierPass_hns
source: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD\nin the FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyBattleFrontier_hns
source: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE\nFRONTIER has to offer!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIsntPlayerYouCame_hns
source: ???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nYou came out here!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrScottGoodDay_hns
source: GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir!\nGood day to you, sir!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere_hns
source:
SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!\pI hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.\pNaturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.\pI also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFacilities_hns
source: I'm your guide to the various facilities\nhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich2_hns
source: Which would you like to learn about?$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo_hns
source: It is the gigantic tower considered\nto be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.\pThere are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS\nin the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,\land LINK MULTI BATTLES.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo_hns
source:
The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.\pEvents named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.\pThe Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo_hns
source: The BATTLE PALACE is the red building\non the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThere are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS\nfor SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo_hns
source: The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like\nbuilding at the center-right of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Set KO Tourney\ntakes place at the BATTLE ARENA.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo_hns
source:
The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.\pAn event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.\pThe Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE\lBATTLES.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo_hns
source: The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped\nlike a POKéMON at the center-left of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.\pAn event called the Battle Choice\nis conducted there.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo_hns
source: The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous\npyramid.\pAn event called the Battle Quest\nis conducted there.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo_hns
source: The RANKING HALL is located near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThere, you may see the most fantastic\nrecords left by the TRAINERS that\ltook on the many challenges of\lthe BATTLE FRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo_hns
source: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near\nthe BATTLE TOWER.\pThe Battle Points you have earned in\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged\lfor fabulous prizes there.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToRules_hns
source: I'm your guide to the basic rules that\nare common to all the challenges\loffered by the facilities in the BATTLE\lFRONTIER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhat_hns
source: What would you like to learn about?$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelModeInfo_hns
source: All the challenges at the BATTLE\nFRONTIER's facilities come in\ltwo courses--Level 50 and Open Level.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info_hns
source:
The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.\pPlease keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any\lPOKéMON below Level 50.\pThis course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTo begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo_hns
source:
The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering\lchallenges.\pThe levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of\lyour POKéMON.\pHowever, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo_hns
source:
Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.\pEGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.\pThe numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.\pAt all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not\lpermitted.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo_hns
source: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE\nFRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not\lbe holding the same kind of item.\pPlease make sure that all POKéMON\nentering a challenge are holding\ldifferent items.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFrontierPass_hns
source: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich1_hns
source: Which would you like to learn about?$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo_hns
source:
There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pTRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with\lsymbols from each of the facilities.\pTo earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,\land may need to win events repeatedly.\pIt's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo_hns
source:
It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.\pYou may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.\pOr you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding\lmatches at the BATTLE PIKE or\lthe BATTLE PYRAMID.\pYou may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.$

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo_hns
source: Battle Points are rewards given to\nTRAINERS who battled outstandingly\lat the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pYou may trade in your Battle Points\nfor prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE\lCORNER.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier_hns
source:
SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome!
Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.\pAnyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally
welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.\pThis is my dream come true.
It took me years and years, but I've\lfinally given shape to my dream.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal_hns
source:
On reflection, it was a terribly long
journey…\pI left home alone on a quest to find
strong TRAINERS.\pNo one can imagine how much effort
or time it took to make this real.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing_hns
source:
But that's all in the past.
No point dwelling on that!\pAll I want for you is to enjoy battling
to your heart's content here.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this
as a memento for all the time our\lpaths crossed on our journeys.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints_hns
source: {PLAYER} obtained\n{STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints_hns
source:
SCOTT: You can check your Battle
Points on your FRONTIER PASS.\pThe more success you have here at
the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle\lPoints you will collect.\pUse your Battle Points the way you
see fit, like trading them for items.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingGreatThings_hns
source: I'm expecting great things from you!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers_hns
source:
SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual.
They all lead lives of their own.\pBut when they're in a battle,
it doesn't matter who they are.\pThey're all the same!\pI love the purity of battle,
where everyone is equal.\pThat's why I go everywhere seeking
TRAINERS who are serious about\lbattling, and invite them here.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain_hns
source:
SCOTT: Have you met any of
the FRONTIER BRAINS?\pBetter yet, have you obtained any
symbols from them?\pI handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS
as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.\pBut I'm sure that seeing how tough
you are will startle even them!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier_hns
source:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?\pI think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.\pWell, guess what?\pYou may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…\lFufufu!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols_hns
source:
SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?\p…Wait a second…
Oh!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set\lof silver symbols!\pThat's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!\pNormally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!\pI want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols_hns
source:
SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!\pYour FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set\lof gold symbols!\pThat's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!\p… … … … … …\p{PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!\pI think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere_hns
source: I must say I have the gift of knowing\na good TRAINER when I see one.\pI'm so glad I had the foresight to\nbring you here!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPocketStuffed_hns
source: Your BERRY POCKET seems to\nbe stuffed.$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow_hns
source: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!\nHow you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's fantastic!\nI want you to have this!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow_hns
source: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!\nHow you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!\lYou beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?\pThat's ridiculously spectacular!\nYou've got to have this!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingToHearEvenGreaterThings_hns
source: I'll be expecting to hear even greater\nthings about you now!$

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBackForThisLater_hns
source: Oops, well, if you have too much\nstuff, come back for this later.$

label: BellchimeTrail_Text_Morty
source:
MORTY: The legendary POKéMON
did not choose me...\pBut that does not mean that I
have lost out on my future.\pI will continue my training until I
I discover a new future for me.\pIf you seek another battle, find
me at the FIGHTING DOJO.$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairIntroText
source: I am CLAIR.\pThe world's best dragon master.\pI can hold my own against even the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's ELITE FOUR.\pDo you still want to take me on?\p…Fine. Let's do it!\pAs a GYM LEADER, I will use my full\npower against any opponent!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairWinText
source: I lost?\pI don't believe it. There must be\nsome mistake…$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_GoToDragonsDen
source:
I won't admit this.\pI may have lost, but you're still
not ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI know. You should take the dragon-
user challenge.\pBehind this GYM is a place called
DRAGON'S DEN.\pThere is a small shrine at its
center. Go there.\pIf you can prove that you've lost
your lazy ideals, I will recognize\lyou as a trainer worthy of a GYM\lBADGE!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_TooMuchToExpect
source: What's the matter?\pIs it too much to expect of you?$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_YouKeptMeWaiting
source: You've kept me waiting!\pHere! Take this!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_DescribeTM
source: That contains DRAGON CLAW.\pYou can figure out what it does.$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairText_League
source:
What's the matter?\pAren't you headed to the POKéMON
LEAGUE?\pDon't you know where it is?\pFrom here, go to NEW BARK TOWN.\pThen SURF east. The route there is
very tough.\pDon't you dare lose at the POKéMON
LEAGUE!\pIf you do, I'll feel even worse
about having lost to you!\pGive it everything you've got.$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairAfterLeague
source: You did it, huh?\pYou are now the JOHTO CHAMP.$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairRematchText
source: You did it, huh?\pYou are now the JOHTO CHAMP.\pYou've proven your strength but can\nyou handle me again?\pAs a Dragon Master, I won't hold\nback.\pNot this time.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_ClairRematchDefeatText
source: I lost?\pAgain?\pI don't believe it. There must be\nsome mistake…$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermCodySeenText
source: I just got access to use DRAGON-\ntype POKéMON!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermCodyBeatenText
source: Rats! If only I had a DRAGONITE!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermCodyAfterBattleText
source: Members of our dragon-user clan\ncan use dragon POKéMON only after\lour MASTER allows it.$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfFranSeenText
source: I can't allow a nameless trainer\npast me!\pCLAIR would be livid if I did!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfFranBeatenText
source: Awww… I lost…$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfFranAfterBattleText
source: Uh-oh… CLAIR is going to be mad…$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermPaulSeenText
source: Your first battle against dragons?\pI'll show you how tough they are!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermPaulBeatenText
source: My dragon POKéMON lost?$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermPaulAfterBattleText
source: LANCE told you that he'd like to\nsee you again?\pNot a chance!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermMikeSeenText
source: My chance of losing? Not even one\npercent!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermMikeBeatenText
source: That's odd.$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainermMikeAfterBattleText
source: I know my short-comings now.\pThanks for showing me!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfLolaSeenText
source: Dragons are sacred POKéMON.\pThey are full of life energy.\pIf you're not serious, you won't\nbe able to beat them.$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfLolaBeatenText
source: Way to go!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_CooltrainerfLolaAfterBattleText
source: Dragons are weak against DRAGON-\ntype moves.$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GuideText
source:
Yo! CHAMP in making!\pIt's been a long journey, but we
are almost done! Count on me!\pWhile CLAIR looks up to the Dragon
Master, LANCE, she's managed to\lcreate her own identity with a\lteam consisting of dragons from\lthe sea.\pDragons are supposed to be
weak against ICE-type moves,\lbut you'll need some DRAGON-type\lor FAIRY-type moves of your own if\lyou want to win.$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GuideText
source: You got this!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GuideGotoDragonsDen
source: You were great to beat CLAIR!\pShe can be a bit of a sore loser,\nthough\pSounds like you need to head to the\nDRAGON'S DEN if you want that GYM BADGE!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GuideWinText
source: You were great to beat CLAIR!\pAll that's left is the POKéMON\nLEAGUE challenge.\pYou're on the way to becoming the\nPOKéMON CHAMPION!$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GymStatue
source: BLACKTHORN CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: BlackthornGym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: BLACKTHORN CITY POKéMON GYM\pCLAIR'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ElmName
source: 空木博士$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_BaobaCall
source: WARDEN BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pI'm calling to tell you that\nthe SAFARI ZONE has expanded!\pPlease come visit!$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ElmCall
source: PROF.ELM: Hello, {PLAYER}?\pI have something here for you.\nCould you swing by my LAB?\pSee you later!$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ClairNotReady
source: CLAIR, our GYM LEADER, has been\nfollowing your progress.\pHowever, she only battles trainers\nwho already have 7 badges.$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ClairIsIn
source: CLAIR, our GYM LEADER, is waiting\nfor you.\pHowever, it would be impossible for\na run-of-the-mill trainer to win.$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_ClairIsBeaten
source: You defeated CLAIR?\pThat's amazing!\pI've never heard of her losing to\nanyone other than LANCE.$

label: BlackthornGrampsRefusesEntryText
source: No. Only chosen trainers may train\nhere.\pPlease leave.$

label: BlackthornGrampsGrantsEntryText
source: If CLAIR allows it, her grand-\nfather--our MASTER--will also.\pYou may enter.$

label: BlackBeltText_VoicesInMyHead
source: Arooo! Voices in my head!\pHuh? I'm listening to my radio!$

label: BlackthornCooltrainerF1Text
source: Are you going to make your POKéMON\nremember some moves?$

label: BlackthornYoungsterText
source: Dragon masters all come from the city\nof BLACKTHORN.$

label: BlackthornCity_MeetSantosText
source: SANTOS: …\pI'm SANTOS of the weekday family.\pTake a guess.$

label: BlackthornCity_SantosGivesGiftText
source: You can have this…$

label: BlackthornCity_SantosGaveGiftText
source: SANTOS: …\pSPELL TAG…\pGHOST-type moves get stronger…\pIt will frighten you…$

label: BlackthornCity_SantosSaturdayText
source: SANTOS: …\pSee you again on another Saturday…\pI won't have any more gifts…$

label: BlackthornCity_SantosNopeText
source: SANTOS: No.$

label: BlackthornCooltrainerF2Text
source: Wow, you came through the ICE PATH?\pYou must be a real hotshot trainer!$

label: BlackthornCitySignText
source: BLACKTHORN CITY\pA Quiet Mountain Retreat$

label: BlackthornGymSignText
source: BLACKTHORN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: CLAIR\pThe Blessed User of Dragon POKéMON$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign
source: MOVE BROS' HOUSE$

label: BlackthornCity_Text_DragonDenSign
source: DRAGON'S DEN AHEAD$

label: BlackthornCity_House1_Text_Granny
source: A clan of trainers who can freely\ncommand dragons live right here in\lBLACKTHORN.\pAs a result, there are many legends\nabout dragons in this town.$

label: BlackthornCity_House1_Text_Dratini
source: DRATINI: Draa!$

label: BlackthornCity_House2_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
source: I collect POKéMON!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$

label: BlackthornCity_House2_Text_MonYouTakeCare
source: Yay! I got myself {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$

label: BlackthornCity_House2_Text_ThisIsntAMon
source: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: BlackthornCity_House2_Text_YouWontTradeMe
source: You don't want to trade? Aww...$

label: BlackthornCity_House2_Text_After
source: Hi, how's my old MR MIME doing?$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
source: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their moves.\pWould you like me to do that?$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMonShouldForget
source: Which POKéMON should forget a move?$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
source: Which move should be forgotten?$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
source: {STR_VAR_1} knows only one move\nso it can't be forgotten…$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
source: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}?\nThat move should be forgotten?$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
source: It worked to perfection!\p{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten\n{STR_VAR_2} completely.$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ComeAgain
source: Come again if there are moves that\nneed to be forgotten.$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_EggCantForgetMoves
source: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
source: Hm!\pYour {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing\nto forget SURF.$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_SorryCantHelp
source: Sorry, I can't help you.$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ImTheMoveTutor
source:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\pI know all the moves that POKéMON
learn--every one of them--and I can\lteach POKéMON those moves.\pI can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.\pI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ThatsAHeartScaleWantMeToTeachMove
source: Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\pLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TutorWhichMon
source: Which POKéMON needs tutoring?$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_TeachWhichMove
source: Which move should I teach?$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_DontHaveMoveToTeachPokemon
source: Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that POKéMON.$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_HandedOverHeartScale
source: {PLAYER} handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_ComeBackWithHeartScale
source: If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.$

label: BlackthornCity_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_CantTeachEgg
source: Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.$

label: BlackthornMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: You can't buy MAX REVIVE, but it\nfully restores a fainted POKéMON.\pBeware--it won't restore PP, the\nPOWER POINTS needed for moves.$

label: BlackthornMart_Text_BlackBelt
source: MAX REPEL keeps weak POKéMON away\nfrom you.\pIt's the longest lasting of the\nREPEL sprays.$

label: BlackthornCity_PokemonCenter1FGentlemanText
source: Deep inside far-off INDIGO\nPLATEAU is the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI hear the best trainers gather\nthere from around the country.$

label: BlackthornCity_PokemonCenter1FTwinText
source: There was this move I just had\nto teach my POKéMON.\pSo I got the MOVE DELETER to make\nit forget an HM move.$

label: BurnedTower_1FEusineIntroText
source: EUSINE: My name's EUSINE.\pI'm on the trail of a POKéMON\ncalled SUICUNE.\pAnd you are...?\p{PLAYER}? Glad to meet you!\pI heard SUICUNE might be in\nthis BURNED TOWER, so I came\lto check it out.\pBut where exactly could it be?$

label: BurnedTower_1FEusineText
source: EUSINE: I heard SUICUNE might\nbe in this BURNED TOWER, so I\lcame to check it out.\pBut where exactly could it be?$

label: BurnedTower_1FMortyText
source: MORTY: ECRUTEAK's GYM LEADER\nhas to study what are said to\lbe the legendary POKéMON--\lSUICUNE, ENTEI and RAIKOU.\pEUSINE is here, so I've\ndecided to investigate the\lTOWER with him.$

label: BurnedTowerSilver_BeforeText
source: ..............................\p...Oh, it's you.\pI came looking for some\nlegendary POKéMON they say\lroost here.\pBut there's nothing here!\pNothing, after all the effort\nof coming to this dump?\lNo way!\pIt's all your fault!$

label: BurnedTowerSilver_WinText
source: ...Humph!\pI only lost because my\nPOKéMON are incredibly weak.\pHow pathetic.$

label: BurnedTowerSilver_AfterText1
source: ...Aw, whatever.\pYou'd never be able to catch\na legendary POKéMON anyway.$

label: BurnedTowerSilver_LossText
source: ...Humph!\pThis is why I hate battling\nwimps. It's a waste of time.$

label: BurnedTowerSilver_AfterText2
source: Humph!\pWhat are you doing falling\ninto a hole? Some genius!\pServes you right!$

label: BurnedTower_Text_NardSeen
source: Don't worry!\pWe fire-breathers know the true\npower of fire better than anyone!$

label: BurnedTower_Text_NardBeaten
source: Thanks for such a heated battle!$

label: BurnedTower_Text_NardAfter
source: The reason this tower's burned is\nthat it was hit by lightning.\pThe fire I'm breathing is tiny\nin comparison...$

label: BurnedTower_Text_RichardoSeen
source: I'm practicing my stealing in the\nBURNED TOWER! Don't try\lthis at home!$

label: BurnedTower_Text_RichardoBeaten
source: Pfffffffffffffff.$

label: BurnedTower_Text_RichardoAfter
source: Maybe a life of crime isn't for\nme...$

label: BurnedTowerB1FEusineText
source:
EUSINE: I'm shocked!\pSUICUNE raced by like a blur,
right in front of my eyes!\pFor ten years I chased
SUICUNE, and I finally got to\lsee it.\pI'm all choked up!\p{PLAYER}, I owe this all to you!\pThank you!\pI heard that the legendary
POKéMON of ECRUTEAK test\lchosen humans by allowing them\lto get close.\pI'm going to track SUICUNE.\p{PLAYER}, let's meet again!\pFarewell!$

label: CeladonMansion_Text_Manager
source: My dear POKéMON keep me company,\nso I don't ever feel lonely.\pMEOWTH even brings money home.$

label: CeladonMansion_Text_ManagersSuiteSign
source: CELADON MANSION MANAGER'S SUITE$

label: CeladonMansion2F_Text_Computer
source:
{PLAYER} turned on the PC.\p…\pSomeone was in the middle of
composing an e-mail.\p…I hope you'll come visit KANTO.\pI think you'll be surprised at
how much things have changed here.\pYou'll also see many POKéMON that
aren't native to JOHTO.\pTo the PRODUCER\p…$

label: CeladonMansion2F_Text_DevOfficeSign
source: HEART & SOUL DEVELOPMENT OFFICE$

label: CeladonMansion2F_Text_LilDill
source:
Hi all, Patch 15--\pSorry, I mean...\pHi there, I'm the GAME DIRECTOR!\pI built the maps, the tilesets, the
the scripts, and much more.\pBut I couldn't have done it without
the other devs and the playtesters.\pThank you for playing! I hope you've
enjoyed POKéMON HEART & SOUL.$

label: CeladonMansion2F_Text_InfiniteBacon
source: We're working to rebuild this game\nin pokeemerald expansion!$

label: CeladonMansion2F_Text_TixoRebel
source: Have you heard of THE EGGENING?\nIt was a bug from the playtest\lthat randomly changed POKéMON into\lEGGs!\pI developed the fix for it!$

label: CeladonMansion2F_Text_Phant
source: I love DEMAKES!\pHave you played SWORD AND SHIELD\nULTIMATE PLUS - ENGLISH?\lI translated it!\pFor my next DEMAKE, I think I'll\ndo ALOLA!$

label: CeladonMansion2F_Text_Exclsior
source: I implemented the unique surfing\nsurfing sprites for each POKéMON!\pSince the project is OPEN SOURCE,\nyou can add your own features too!$

label: CeladonMansion2F_Text_DaniRaibow
source:
Hi!\pI am pretty good at finding problems,
and can fix little ones.\pWanna hear a joke?\pLance tried to teach DRAGONITE the
move DRAGON BREATH.\pHowever, DRAGONITE was moving too
fast from EXTREMESPEED; it couldn't\lcatch it!$

label: GameFreak_Text_GameDesigner
source: Is that right?\pI'm the GAME DESIGNER!\pFilling up your POKéDEX is tough,\nbut don't give up!$

label: GameFreak_Text_GameDesignerCompletedPokedex
source: Wow! Excellent! You completed\nyour POKéDEX!\pCongratulations!$

label: GameFreak_Text_GraphicArtist
source: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST.\pI drew you!$

label: GameFreak_Text_GraphicArtistPrintDiploma
source: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST.\pOh, you completed your POKéDEX?\pWant me to print out your\nDIPLOMA?$

label: GameFreak_Text_GraphicArtistRefused
source: Give me a shout if you want your\nDIPLOMA printed.$

label: GameFreak_Text_GraphicArtistError
source: Something's wrong. I'll have to\ncancel printing.$

label: GameFreak_Text_Programmer
source: Who, me? I'm the PROGRAMMER.\pPlay the slot machines!$

label: GameFreak_Text_CharacterDesigner
source: Aren't the TWINS adorable?\pJASMINE's pretty too.\pOh, I love them!$

label: CeladonMansion3F_Text_DevRoomSign
source: GAME FREAK DEVELOPMENT ROOM$

label: CeladonMansion3F_Text_Drawing
source: It's a detailed drawing of a\npretty girl.$

label: CeladonMansion3F_Text_GameProgram
source: It's the game program. Messing\nwith it could put a bug in the\ngame!$

label: CeladonMansion3F_Text_ReferenceMaterial
source: It's crammed with reference\nmaterials. There's even a\nPOKé DOLL.$

label: CeladonMansionRoof_Text_Fisher
source: High places--I do love them so!\pI'd say the only thing that loves\nheights as much as me is smoke!$

label: CeladonMansionRoof_Text_Graffiti
source: There's graffiti on the wall…\p{PLAYER} added a moustache!$

label: CeladonMansionRoofHouse_Text_PharmacistIntro
source: Let me recount a terrifying tale…$

label: CeladonMansionRoofHouse_Text_PharmacistNotNight
source: Then again, it's not as scary\nwhile it's still light outside.\pCome back after sunset, OK?$

label: CeladonMansionRoofHouse_Text_PharmacistStory
source:
Once upon a time, there was a
little boy who was given a new\lBICYCLE…\pHe wanted to try it right away…\pHe was having so much fun that
he didn't notice the sun had set…\pWhile riding home in the pitch-
black night, the bike suddenly\lslowed!\pThe pedals became heavy!\pWhen he stopped pedaling, the
bike began slipping backwards!\pIt was as if the bike were cursed
and trying to drag him into\loblivion!\p…\p…\pSHRIEEEEK!\pThe boy had been riding uphill on
CYCLING ROAD!\p…
Ba-dum ba-dum!\pFor listening so patiently, you
may take this--TM82!$

label: CeladonMansionRoofHouse_Text_PharmacistCurse
source: TM82 is SLEEP TALK.\pIt will allow your POKéMON to use\na random move while asleep.\pBut good luck sleeping after that\nterrifying tale!$

label: CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_BoxIsFull
source: ポケモンが　いっぱいだ\nボックスを　かえて　きなさい$

label: CeladonDeptStore_Text_1FReceptionist
source: Hello! Welcome to CELADON DEPT.\nSTORE!\pThe directory is on the wall.$

label: CeladonDeptStore_Text_1FGentleman
source: This DEPT.STORE is part of the same\nchain as the one in GOLDENROD CITY.\pThey were both renovated at the same\ntime.$

label: CeladonDeptStore_Text_1FTeacher
source: This is my first time here.\pIt's so big…\pI'm afraid I'll get lost.$

label: CeladonDeptStore_Text_1FDirectory
source: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET\p3F: TM SHOP\p4F: WISEMAN GIFTS\p5F: DRUG STORE\p6F: ROOFTOP SQUARE$

label: CeladonDeptStore2F_Text_PokefanM
source: I just recently became a trainer.\pMy son encouraged me to do it.\pI'm impressed by the selection of\nconvenient items.$

label: CeladonDeptStore2F_Text_Youngster
source: My dad's having a hard time\nlearning the names of items and\lhow they are supposed to be used…$

label: CeladonDeptStore2F_Text_Directory
source: Top Grade Items for Trainers!\p2F: TRAINER'S MARKET$

label: CeladonDeptStore3F_Text_Youngster
source: I can't decide which POKéMON I\nshould use this TM on…$

label: CeladonDeptStore3F_Text_GameboyKid1
source: Uh-oh! I traded my POKéMON without\nremoving the UPGRADE from it.$

label: CeladonDeptStore3F_Text_GameboyKid2
source:
Yeah! I'm finally getting a
PORYGON!\pI'm no good at the slots, so I
could never get enough coins…\p…Huh?\pThe traded PORYGON turned into a
different POKéMON!$

label: CeladonDeptStore3F_Text_SuperNerd
source: The TM SHOP sells some rare moves.$

label: CeladonDeptStore3F_Text_Directory
source: 3F: TM SHOP\pMake Your POKéMON Stronger!$

label: CeladonDeptStore4F_Text_SuperNerd
source: I'm here to buy SURF MAIL to send\nto my girlfriend.\pWait, they're out of stock?$

label: CeladonDeptStore4F_Text_Youngster
source: This is the only place where you\ncan buy LOVELY MAIL.\pAt least it was. They are saying\nthey are out of stock.$

label: CeladonDeptStore4F_Text_Directory
source: Express Yourself With Gifts!\p4F: WISEMAN GIFTS$

label: CeladonDeptStore_Text_5FReceptionistOhYourMon
source: Hello. Oh, your POKéMON…$

label: CeladonDeptStore_Text_5FReceptionistWait
source: Wait, I already gave you that TM!$

label: CeladonDeptStore_Text_5FReceptionistPutInSomeMoreEffort
source: Hmm…\nIt's not bad, but it's also not good.\pYou, as the TRAINER, need to put in\nsome more effort.$

label: CeladonDeptStore_Text_5FReceptionistItLooksEvilHowAboutThisTM
source: It looks evil. How about this TM\nfor it?$

label: CeladonDeptStore5_Text_Falkner
source:
{PLAYER}. I didn't expect to see
you here.\pI'm picking up gear for my
bird POKéMON.\pIf you want to face me again, I'll
be at the DOJO in SAFFRON CITY.$

label: CeladonDeptStore5F_Text_Gentleman
source: I want to buy some items that\nraise POKéMON stats, but I don't\lhave enough money…$

label: CeladonDeptStore5F_Text_Sailor
source: I want PP UP, so I can raise the\nPP of moves. But you can't buy it…$

label: CeladonDeptStore5F_Text_Teacher
source: Using items on them makes POKéMON\nhappy.\pThey hate certain items, though…$

label: CeladonDeptStore5F_Text_Directory
source: 5F: DRUG STORE$

label: CeladonDeptStore6F_Text_Vending
source: A vending machine! Here's the menu.$

label: CeladonDeptStore6F_Text_Clang
source: Clang!\p{STRING} popped out.$

label: CeladonDeptStore6F_Text_VendingNoMoney
source: Oops, not enough money…$

label: CeladonDeptStore6F_Text_VendingNoSpace
source: There's no more room for stuff…$

label: CeladonDeptStore6F_Text_SuperNerd
source: A vending machine with a prize\nroulette…\pYou never see those anymore.$

label: CeladonDeptStore6F_Text_Youngster
source: Aww! There's no games here!\pI wanted to play…$

label: CeladonDeptStore6F_Text_Directory
source: 6F: ROOFTOP SQUARE VENDING\nMACHINES$

label: CeladonGameCorner_Text_PokefanM
source: The slot machines are all state\nof the art.$

label: CeladonGameCorner_Text_Teacher
source: It's this machine I want.\pIt cleaned me out yesterday, so it\nshould pay out today.$

label: CeladonGameCorner_Text_FishingGuru
source: I think this slot machine will pay\nout…\pThe odds vary among machines.$

label: CeladonGameCorner_Text_Fisher1
source: Gahahaha!\pThe coins just keep coming in!\pHm? What, kid? You want to play?\pI'll share my luck with you!$

label: CeladonGameCorner_Text_Fisher2
source: Gahahaha!\pIt makes me feel good to do nice\nthings for other people!$

label: CeladonGameCorner_Text_GymGuide
source: Hey! CHAMP in making!\pAre you playing the slots too?\pI'm trying to get enough coins for\na prize POKéMON.\pBut I don't have enough coins yet…$

label: CeladonGameCorner_Text_PokefanF
source: Roulette…\pI prefer it over the slots because\nit's easier to figure the odds.\pBut the payout is much lower.$

label: CeladonGameCorner_Text_Gramps
source: Hmmm… The odds are surely\nbetter putting it all on blue,\lbut… what to do?$

label: CeladonGameCorner_Text_Woman
source: I can't stop winning!$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_HereYouGo
source: はい どうぞ$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_OopsNotEnoughRoom
source: おきゃくさん もう もてないよ$

label: CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_OhFineThen
source: あっ そう$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaIntro
source:
Hello…
Lovely weather, isn't it?\lIt's so pleasant…\p…Oh, dear…
I must have dozed off. Welcome.\pMy name is ERIKA.
I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.\pI am a student of the art of
flower arranging.\pMy POKéMON are solely of the
GRASS type.\p…Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that
you wished to challenge me.\pVery well, but I shall not lose.{PLAY_BGM MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaBeforeBattle
source:
ERIKA: Hello… Lovely weather,
isn't it? It's so pleasant…\p…I'm afraid I may doze off…\pMy name is ERIKA. I am the LEADER
of CELADON GYM.\p…Oh? All the way from JOHTO, you
say? How nice…\pOh. I'm sorry, I didn't realize
that you wished to challenge me.\pVery well, but I shall not lose.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaBeaten
source: ERIKA: Oh! I concede defeat…\pYou are remarkably strong…\pI shall give you RAINBOWBADGE…$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_PlayerReceivedRainbowBadge
source: {PLAYER} received RAINBOWBADGE.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_Erika_GiveTM
source: ERIKA: That was a delightful\nmatch.\pI felt inspired. Please, I wish\nyou to have this TM.$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_Erika_ExplainTM
source: It is GIGA DRAIN.\pIt is a wonderful move that\ndrains half the damage it inflicts\lto heal your POKéMON.\pPlease use it if it pleases you…$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaAfterBattle
source: ERIKA: Losing leaves a bitter\naftertaste…\pBut knowing that there are strong\ntrainers spurs me to do better…$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaRematch
source: ERIKA: Oh, hello.\pWhat a surprise, KANTO CHAMPION!\pIt's so lovely to see you again.\pYour journey must have been so\nexciting.\pEven champions enjoy a challenge.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaRematchDefeat
source: ERIKA: Losing still leaves a\nbitter aftertaste…\pBut knowing that there are strong\ntrainers spurs me to do better…$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LassMichelleSeen
source: Do you think a girls-only GYM is\nrare?$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LassMichelleBeaten
source: Oh, bleah!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LassMichelleAfter
source: I just got careless, that's all!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_PicnickerTanyaSeen
source: Oh, a battle? That's kind of scary,\nbut OK!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_PicnickerTanyaBeaten
source: Oh, that's it?$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_PicnickerTanyaAfter
source: Oh, look at all your BADGES. No\nwonder I couldn't win!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BeautyJuliaSeen
source: Were you looking at these flowers\nor at me?$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BeautyJuliaBeaten
source: How annoying!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BeautyJuliaAfter
source: How do I go about becoming\nladylike like ERIKA?$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TwinsJoAndZoe1Seen
source: We'll show you POKéMON moves that\nERIKA taught us!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TwinsJoAndZoe1Beaten
source: Oh… We lost…$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TwinsJoAndZoe1After
source: ERIKA will get you back for us!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TwinsJoAndZoe2Seen
source: We're going to protect ERIKA!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TwinsJoAndZoe2Beaten
source: We couldn't win…$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TwinsJoAndZoe2After
source: ERIKA is much, much stronger!$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$

label: CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CELADON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Erika
source: Oh, {PLAYER}.\nIsn't the fountain lovely today?\pIf you wish for another battle,\nI'll be at the FIGHTING DOJO.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Fisher
source: This POLIWRATH is my partner.\pI wonder if it'll ever evolve\ninto a frog POKéMON.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Poliwrath
source: POLIWRATH: Croak!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Teacher1
source: I lost at the slot machines again…\pWe girls also play the slots now.\pYou should check them out too.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Gramps1
source: GRIMER have been appearing lately.\pSee that pond out in front of the\nhouse? GRIMER live there now.\pWhere did they come from? This is\na serious problem…$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Gramps2
source: Nihihi! This GYM is great! Only\ngirls are allowed here!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Youngster1
source: Want to know a secret?\pCELADON MANSION has a hidden back\ndoor.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Youngster2
source: They're holding an eating contest\nat the restaurant.\pJust watching them go at it makes\nme feel bloated…$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Teacher2
source: CELADON DEPT.STORE has the biggest\nand best selection of merchandise.\pIf you can't get it there, you\ncan't get it anywhere.\pGee… I sound like a sales clerk.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Lass
source: Looking at the ground while I was\nwalking made me dizzy.$

label: CeladonCity_Text_Sign
source: CELADON CITY\pThe City of Rainbow Dreams$

label: CeladonGym_Text_Sign
source: CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER:\nERIKA\pThe Nature-Loving Princess$

label: CeladonCity_Text_DeptStoreSign
source: Find What You Need at CELADON\nDEPT.STORE!$

label: CeladonCity_Text_MansionSign
source: CELADON MANSION$

label: CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerSign
source: The Playground for Everybody--\nCELADON GAME CORNER$

label: CeladonCity_Text_TrainerTips
source: TRAINER TIPS\pGUARD SPEC. protects POKéMON\nagainst SPECIAL attacks such as\lFLAMETHROWER and SURF.\pGet your items at CELADON DEPT.\nSTORE!$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_ChefEatathon
source: Hi!\pWe're holding an eatathon contest.\pWe can't serve you right now.\nSorry.$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_Fisher1Snarfle
source: …Snarfle, chew…$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_Fisher1Concentration
source: Don't talk to me!\pYou'll break my concentration!$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_Fisher2GulpChew
source: …Gulp… Chew…$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_Fisher2Quantity
source: I take quantity over quality!\pI'm happy when I'm full!$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_Fisher3MunchMunch
source: Munch, munch…$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_Fisher3GoldenrodIsBest
source: The food is good here, but\nGOLDENROD has the best food\lanywhere.$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_TeacherCrunchCrunch
source: Crunch… Crunch…$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_TeacherNoCoinCase
source: Nobody here will give you a COIN\nCASE. You should look in JOHTO.$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_TeacherKeepEating
source: Crunch… Crunch…\pI can keep eating!\pMore, CHEF!$

label: CeladonCity_House1_Text_EatathonContestPoster
source: Eatathon Contest! No time limit!\pA battle without end! The biggest\nmuncher gets it all for free!$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_CooltrainerF
source: ERIKA is a master of grass\nPOKéMON.\pShe'll make you pay if you don't\nwatch yourself.$

label: CeladonCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Pharmacist
source: TEAM ROCKET's hideout is in the\nbasement of the GAME CORNER.\pOh, wait. That was three years\nago.$

label: Celadon_Text_Eusine1
source: EUSINE: Hi!\pI'm back visiting my hometown.\pIt's been quite a while.$

label: Celadon_Text_EusineLeaves
source:
{PLAYER}, have you heard?\pThere have been fresh rumors of a
rainbow-colored POKéMON
appearing at TIN TOWER.\pI've just had my party healed,
so now I'm headed to ECRUTEAK.\pI'll be seeing you, {PLAYER}!$

label: Celadon_Text_NoBeasts
source: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}.\pHave you caught the legendary\nPOKéMON RAIKOU and ENTEI?\p<……><……><……>\pOkay…\pIf you catch even one, I hope\nthat you'll inform me.\pI'm counting on you, {PLAYER}!$

label: CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_GermanFoldableBicyleFinallyOnMarket
source: ついに　はつばい！\pドイツ　せい　さいこうきゅう\nおりたたみ　じてんしゃ！$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$

label: CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: CERULEAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_Note
source: Sorry, I'll be out for a while.\nMISTY, GYM LEADER\pSince MISTY's out, we'll be away\ntoo.\lGYM TRAINERS$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GruntIntro
source: Oops! I so sorry! You not hurt,\nokay?\pI very busy. No time for talking\nwith you. Not good for me if\lseen by somebody.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GruntBigMistake
source: Oh no! You seen me already!\nI make big mistake!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GruntBye
source: Hey, you! Forget you see me,\nokay?\pYou see, hear, know nothing,\pokay? Bye, kid! Nothing!\pBye-bye a go-go!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_Note1
source: Sorry, I'll be out for a while.\nMISTY, GYM LEADER\pSince MISTY's out, we'll be away\ntoo. GYM TRAINERS$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyIntro
source:
MISTY: I was expecting you, you
pest!\pYou may have a lot of JOHTO GYM
BADGES, but you'd better not\ltake me too lightly.\pMy WATER-type POKéMON are
tough!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyWinLoss
source: MISTY: You really are good…\pI'll admit that you are skilled…\pHere you go. It's CASCADEBADGE.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_ReceivedBadge
source: {PLAYER} received CASCADEBADGE.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyFightDone
source: MISTY: Are there many strong\ntrainers in JOHTO? Like you, I\lmean.\pI'm going to travel one day, so\nI can battle some skilled\ltrainers.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyRematch
source: MISTY: Wow, you're the KANTO\nCHAMPION now!\pThat's amazing! You've come a\nlong way, {PLAYER}.\pBut I'm not backing down.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_MistyRematchDefeat
source: MISTY: You really are good…$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfDianaSeen
source: Sorry about being away. Let's get\non with it!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfDianaBeaten
source: I give up! You're the winner!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfDianaAfter
source: I'll be swimming quietly.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfBrianaSeen
source: Don't let my elegant swimming\nunnerve you.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfBrianaBeaten
source: Ooh, you calmly disposed of me…$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmerfBrianaAfter
source: Don't be too smug about beating\nme.\pMISTY will destroy you if you get\ncomplacent.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmermParkerSeen
source: Glub…\pI'm first! Come and get me!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmermParkerBeaten
source: This can't be…$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_SwimmermParkerAfter
source: MISTY has gotten much better in\nthe past few years.\pDon't let your guard down, or\nyou'll be crushed!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GuideIntro
source: Yo! CHAMP in making!\pSince MISTY was away, I went out\pfor some fun too. He-he-he.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_GuideWin
source: Hoo, you showed me how tough you\nare.\pAs always, that was one heck of a\ngreat battle!$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_Misty_GiveTM
source: Here, take this too.$

label: CeruleanGym_Text_Misty_ExplainTM
source: It's the WATER PULSE TM.\pIt causes damage and sometimes\ncauses confusion as well!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave
source:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the KANTO POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CooltrainerM1
source: KANTO's POWER PLANT?\pIt's near the end of ROUTE 9, the\nroad that heads east from here.\pI think there was an accident of\nsome sort there.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CooltrainerM2
source: You're collecting every single\nkind of POKéMON?\pThat must be quite a challenge,\nbut it sounds fun too.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_SuperNerd
source: The CAPE in the north is a good\nplace for dates.\pGirls like it!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Slowbro
source: SLOWBRO: Yarah?$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CooltrainerF1
source: My SLOWBRO and I make an awesome\ncombination!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CooltrainerF2
source: SLOWBRO, show me your CONFUSION!$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Fisher
source: I'm a huge fan of CERULEAN GYM's\nMISTY.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Fisher_RocketTip
source: I saw this shady guy go off toward\nCERULEAN's CAPE.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Youngster1
source: The cave north of town has\nhorribly powerful POKéMON in it.$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Youngster2
source: Ayuh?\pMy ITEMFINDER is responding…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_Sign
source: CERULEAN CITY\pA Mysterious Blue Aura Surrounds It$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign
source: CERULEAN CITY\nPOKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pThe Tomboyish Mermaid$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign
source: There's a notice here…\pThe BIKE SHOP has moved to\nGOLDENROD CITY in JOHTO…$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_PoliceSign
source: There's a notice here…\pStamp out thievery and make the\ncity a friendlier, more cheerful\lplace!\pCERULEAN POLICE$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_CapeSign
source: CERULEAN CAPE\nAHEAD$

label: CeruleanCity_Text_LockedDoor
source: It's locked…$

label: CeruleanHouse1_Text_PokefanM
source: Are you collecting KANTO GYM\nBADGES?$

label: CeruleanPolice_Text_FishingGuru
source: I heard that some shady character\nis skulking about.\pI won't stand for it if he turns out\nto be a thief.$

label: CeruleanPolice_Text_PokefanF
source: We were held up by robbers before.$

label: CeruleanPolice_Text_Diglett
source: DIGLETT: Dug dug.$

label: CeruleanHouse_Text_Granny
source: My husband lives happily with\nPOKéMON he got through trades.$

label: CeruleanHouse_Text_Gramps
source: Ah… I'm so happy…$

label: CeruleanHouse_Text_Kangaskhan
source: KANGASKHAN: Garu garuu.$

label: CeruleanHouse_Text_Zubat
source: ZUBAT: Zuba zubaa.$

label: CeruleanMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: You'll run into many trainers on\nthe way to CERULEAN's CAPE.\pThey want to see how they stack\nup against other trainers.$

label: CeruleanMart_Text_CooltrainerF
source: MISTY is about the only person in\ntown who can beat the trainers at\lCERULEAN's CAPE.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_SuperNerd
source: For battles, I'd much rather use\nPOKéMON I've been raising, even if\pthey're weaker than some newly\ncaught POKéMON.$

label: CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_GymGuide
source: The MAGNET TRAIN travels at over\n340 mph. It goes between KANTO and\lJOHTO in almost no time at all.\pIt really makes JOHTO accessible.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentIntro
source:
You're a rookie trainer,
aren't you? I can tell!\pThat's OK! Everyone is a
rookie at some point!\pIf you'd like, I can teach
you a few things.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentTourStart
source: OK, then!\nFollow me!$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentPokecenter
source: This is a POKéMON CENTER.\pThey heal your POKéMON in no\ntime at all.\pYou'll be relying on them a lot,\nso you better learn about them.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentMart
source: This is a POKéMON MART.\pThey sell BALLS for catching wild\nPOKéMON and other useful items.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentRoute30
source: ROUTE 30 is out this way.\pTrainers will be battling\ntheir prized POKéMON there.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentSea
source: This is the sea, as you can see.\pSome POKéMON are found only in\nin water.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentMap
source: Here…\pIt's my house! Thanks for\nyour company.\pOh, and if you're ever lost, check\nthe MAP on your POKéGEAR!\pI wish you luck on your journey!$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentDecline
source: Oh… It's something I enjoy\ndoing…\pFine. Come see me whenever\nyou like.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_RivalSeen
source: … … … … … … … …\pYou got a POKéMON at the LAB.\pWhat a waste.\nA wimp like you.\p… … … … … … … …\pDon't you get what I'm saying?\nWell, I too, have a good POKéMON.\pI'll show you what I mean!$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_SilverWin
source: Humph. Are you happy you won?$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_RivalAfter
source: … … … … … … … …\pDo you want to know who I am?\pI'm going to be the world's\ngreatest POKéMON trainer.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_RivalID
source: Give it back!\nThat's my TRAINER CARD!\pOh no!\nYou saw my name...$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_TeacherHaveMapCard
source: When you're with POKéMON,\ngoing anywhere is fun.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_YoungsterNoPokedex
source: MR. POKéMON's house is still\nfarther up ahead.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_YoungsterHavePokedex
source: I battled the trainers on the\nroad.\pMy POKéMON lost. They're a\nmess! I must take them to a\lPOKéMON CENTER.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_MysticWaterGuyBefore
source: A POKéMON I caught had an\nitem.\pI think it's MYSTIC WATER.\pI don't need it, so do you\nwant it?$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_MysticWaterGuyAfter
source: Back to fishing for me, then.$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_CitySign
source: CHERRYGROVE CITY\pThe City of Cute, Fragrant\nFlowers$

label: CherrygroveCity_Text_GuideGentsHouseSign
source: GUIDE GENT'S HOUSE$

label: CherryGroveCity_Text_Staryu
source: STARYU: Yuuuuuuuu.$

label: CherryGroveCity_Text_Corsola
source: CORSOLA: Corsola! La!$

label: CherryGroveCity_Text_Krabby
source: KRABBY: KOOOOKEEE!$

label: CherrygroveCity_GymSpeechHouse_Text_PokefanM
source: You're trying to see how good\nyou are as a POKéMON trainer?\pYou better visit the POKéMON\nGYMS all over JOHTO and collect\lBADGES.$

label: CherrygroveCity_GymSpeechHouse_Text_BugCatcher
source: When I get older, I'm going to\nbe a GYM LEADER!\pI make my POKéMON battle with\nmy friend's to make them\ltougher!$

label: CherrygroveCity_GuideHouse_Text_GuideGent
source: When I was a wee lad, I was a\nhotshot trainer!\pHere's a word of advice:\nCatch lots of POKéMON!\pTreat them all with kindness!$

label: CherrygroveCity_EvolutionHouse_Text_Youngster
source: POKéMON gain experience in\nbattle and change their form.$

label: CherrygroveCity_EvolutionHouse_Text_Lass
source: POKéMON change?\pI would be shocked if one did\nthat!$

label: Cherrygrove_Pokemart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: They're fresh out of POKé BALLS!\pWhen will they get more of them?$

label: Cherrygrove_Pokemart_Text_CooltrainerM_PokeBallsInStock
source: POKé BALLS are in stock!\nNow I can catch POKéMON!$

label: Cherrygrove_Pokemart_Text_Youngster
source:
When I was walking in the grass, a
bug POKéMON poisoned my POKéMON!\pI just kept going, but then my
POKéMON fainted.\pYou should keep an ANTIDOTE
with you.$

label: CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Fisher
source: It's great. I can store any number\nof POKéMON, and it's all free.$

label: CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Gentleman
source: That PC is free for any\ntrainer to use.$

label: CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Lass
source: They say a watched pot never\nboils. But watching the clock\lin the POKéCENTER makes time fly!$

label: CherryGrove_Pokecenter_Text_Chansey
source: CHANSEY: Chaan! Sii!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeEasierToFly
source: You crossed the sea to get here?\pThat must have been hard.\pIt would be much easier if your\nPOKéMON knew how to FLY...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeBeatChuck
source: But you can't use FLY without this\ncity's GYM BADGE.\pIf you beat the GYM LEADER here,\ncome see me.\pI'll have a nice gift for you.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeGiveHM
source: That's CIANWOOD's GYM BADGE!\pThen you should take this HM.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeFlySpeech
source: Teach FLY to your POKéMON.\pYou will be able to FLY instantly\nto anywhere you have visited.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ChucksWifeChubby
source: My husband lost to you, so he needs\nto train harder.\pThat's good, since he was getting\na little chubby.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Youngster
source: If you use FLY, you can get back\nto OLIVINE instantly.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PokefanM
source: Boulders to the north of town can\nbe crushed.\pThey may be hiding something.\pYour POKéMON could use ROCK SMASH\nto break them.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Lass
source: CHUCK, the GYM LEADER, spars with\nhis fighting POKéMON.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_EusineSuicune
source:
EUSINE: Yo, {PLAYER}.\pWasn't that SUICUNE just now?\pI only caught a quick glimpse, but
I thought I saw SUICUNE running on\lthe waves.\pSUICUNE is beautiful and grand.\pAnd it races through towns and
roads at simply awesome speeds.\pIt's wonderful…\pI want to see SUICUNE up close…\pI've decided.\pI'll battle you as a trainer to
earn SUICUNE's respect!\pCome on, {PLAYER}. Let's battle now!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_EusineBeaten
source: I hate to admit it, but you win.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_EusineAfter
source: You're amazing, {PLAYER}!\pNo wonder POKéMON gravitate to you.\pI get it now.\pI'm going to keep searching for\nSUICUNE.\pI'm sure we'll see each other again.\pSee you around!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Sign
source: CIANWOOD CITY\pA Port Surrounded by Rough Seas$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_GymSign
source: CIANWOOD CITY POKéMON GYM\pLEADER: CHUCK\pHis Roaring Fists Do the Talking$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PharmacySign
source: 500 Years of Tradition\pCIANWOOD CITY PHARMACY\pWe Await Your Medicinal Queries$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Safari
source: CLIFF EDGE CAVE\nRoad to the SAFARI ZONE.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_Engineer
source: This path is under construction.\nWe're getting the new SAFARI ZONE\lup and running!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_GymStatue
source: CIANWOOD CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: CIANWOOD CITY POKéMON GYM\pCHUCK'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckGotoDojo
source: WAHAHAHA {PLAYER}!\nI'm in the middle of my training!\pIf you want another match, come to\nthe FIGHTING DOJO in SAFFRON!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckAtDojo
source: I will see you at the DOJO!\nWAHAHAHAHAHA$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckIntro1
source: WAHAHAH!\pSo you've come this far!\pLet me tell you, I'm tough!\pMy POKéMON will crush stones and\nshatter bones!\pWatch this!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckIntro2
source: CHUCK: Urggh!\n…\pOooarrgh!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckIntro3
source: There! Scared now, are you?\pWhat? It has nothing to do with\nPOKéMON?\pThat's true!\pCome on. We shall do battle!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckLoss
source: Wha? Huh? I lost?\pHow about that!\nYou're worthy of STORMBADGE!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_GetStormBadge
source: {PLAYER} received STORMBADGE.$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckBadgeSpeech
source: STORMBADGE makes all POKéMON up to\nL70 obey, even traded ones.\pIt also lets your POKéMON use FLY\nwhen you're not in a battle.\pHere, take this too!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckTMSpeech
source: That is FOCUS PUNCH.\pIt moves slow but deals huge\ndamage. Just don't get hit first!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckAfter
source: WAHAHAH! I enjoyed battling you!\pBut a loss is a loss!\pFrom now on, I'm going to train\n24 hours a day!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckRematch
source: WAHAHAH! JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYou've come back for more!\pI see your skills have improved!\pReady to see who's stronger?$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_ChuckRematchDefeat
source: Wha? Huh? I lost?\nAgain?$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltYoshiSeen
source: My POKéMON and I are bound togeth-\ner by friendship.\pOur bond will never be broken!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltYoshiBeaten
source: This isn't real!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltYoshiAfter
source: You seem to have a strong bond\nwith your POKéMON too!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLaoSeen
source: We martial artists fear nothing!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLaoBeaten
source: That's shocking!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLaoAfter
source: Fighting POKéMON are afraid of\npsychics…$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltNobSeen
source: Words are useless.\nLet your fists do the talking!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltNobAfter
source: I lost! I'm speechless!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLungSeen
source: My raging fists will shatter your\nPOKéMON!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLungBeaten
source: I got shattered!$

label: CianwoodGym_Text_BlackbeltLungAfter
source: My POKéMON lost…\nMy… my pride is shattered…$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_OldManIntro
source:
I don't remember the last time
someone came to visit me.\pWhen I was young, I was a
POKéMON Trainer, too.\lI tried to reach the tower and\ldive into the ocean.\pI put a lot of effort into many
things.\pWell, I take things easy now,
listening to the waves and winds\lon this beach.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_BellTowerStory
source:
Have you heard of the TIN TOWER
in ECRUTEAK?\pThere are what they call Clear Bells
on top of the tower.\pThey don't make a single noise
in strong winds.\pThere is only one way to make them
ring.\pIt is to obtain another CLEAR BELL
just like the ones at the top of the\ltower.\pI went after it when I was young.
But I never got one...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_WhirlIslandsStory
source:
Have you heard of WHIRL ISLANDS?\pThere are what they call Tidal Bells
at its waterfall basin.\pThey don't make a single noise
in crashing waves.\pThere is only one way to make them
ring.\pIt is to obtain another Tidal Bell
just like the ones at the waterfall\lbasin.\pI went after it when I was young.
But I never got one...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ClearBellReaction
source:
Oh! You've managed to get a
CLEAR BELL?\pThe old-time dream of mine...
I see...\pYou've done it...
...\l...I can hear it!\pThe chime of the bells on the wind
coming from the direction of the\lTIN TOWER...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_TidalBellReaction
source:
Oh! You've managed to get a
Tidal Bell?\pThe old-time dream of mine...
I see...\pYou've done it...
...\l...I can hear it!\pThe chime of the bells on the sea
breeze coming from the direction of\lthe WHIRL ISLANDS...$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_LugiaHouseTeacher
source: You came from OLIVINE?\pDo you remember the four islands\nalong the way?\pI heard that a mythical sea crea-\nture is hiding in them.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_LugiaHouseLass
source: I heard that you can only see it\nif you have a SILVER WING.\pIt must have the same scent as\nthe creature.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_LugiaHouseTwin
source: I've heard that the whirlpools\naround the islands are caused by\lthe sea creature.\pYou might need a special move\nto get past them.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacAskShuckle
source:
I, I'm in shock!\pA guy about your age with piercing
eyes and long hair came in.\pHe scared me into giving him my
prized POKéMON!\pI still have one left, but what if
he comes back?\pYou look strong. Could you look
after my POKéMON for a while?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacTakeCareShuckle
source: Oh, thank you!\pTake good care of it, please!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacGotShuckle
source: {PLAYER} received a POKéMON.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacPartyFull
source: Your POKéMON party is full.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacIfHeComesBack
source: Oh, no… What'll I do if he comes\nback?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacHowsdoing
source: Hi! How's my POKéMON?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacAskReturn
source: Hi! How's my POKéMON?\pI think I'm safe now, so may I\nhave it back?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacThankYou
source: Thank you!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacShuckleNotThere
source: Hey, you don't have my POKéMON\nwith you.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacShuckleLikesYou
source: My POKéMON has come to like you.\pAll right, you should keep it.\pBut promise to be good to it!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacRobbed
source: Huh, something's not right.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacRobbed2
source: Oh, no, no… That's the same as\nbeing robbed.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacHappinessSpeech
source: For POKéMON, happiness is being\nwith a person who treats them well.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacLastMon
source: If I take my POKéMON back,\nwhat are you going to use\nin battle?$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ManiacReturnedMon
source: {PLAYER} returned SHUCKIE.$

label: CianwoodPokemoncenter_Text_Fisher1
source: As far as water POKéMON go,\nTENTACOOL is the best by a\lnautical mile!$

label: CianwoodPokemoncenter_Text_Fisher2
source: You seem like you need a water\nPOKéMON.\pHere, take this one, I have plenty.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PokecenterLass
source: Did you meet the POKéMANIAC?\pHe's always bragging about his\nrare POKéMON.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_GymGuide
source:
The POKéMON GYM trainers here are
macho bullies.\pIf I stick around, they might
come after me.\pHere's some advice: the GYM LEADER
uses the FIGHTING-type.\pSo you should confound him with
psychic POKéMON.\pWipe out his POKéMON before they
can use their physical strength.\pAnd those boulders in the middle
of the GYM?\pIf you don't move them correctly,
you won't reach the GYM LEADER.\pIf you get stuck, go outside.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_GymGuideWin
source: {PLAYER}! You won!\nI could tell by looking at you!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PokecenterSuperNerd
source: I love showing off the POKéMON\nthat I've raised.\pDon't you?\pI'm going to get into a bunch of\nbattles, and show off my POKéMON!$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PharmacistGivePotion
source: Your POKéMON appear to be fine.\pIs something worrying you?\p…\pThe LIGHTHOUSE POKéMON is in\ntrouble?\pI got it!\pThis ought to do the trick.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_ReceivedSecretpotion
source: {PLAYER} received SECRET POTION.$

label: CianwoodCity_Text_PharmacistDescribePotion
source: My SECRET POTION is a tad too\nstrong, so I only offer it in an\lemergency.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_IfYouHaveTriPassYouCanGoAgain
source:
Hey, wasn't that a long cruise?\pMy buddy CELIO seemed to enjoy
your company.\pI'm sure he'd welcome you if you
were to visit him again.\pIf you have a TRI-PASS, you can
always take a ferry there from\lVERMILION PORT.\pAll right, thanks for your company!$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_Blaine
source: BLAINE: I'll never give up\nuntil the day I've rebuilt\lCINNABAR GYM!\pI'll be at the FIGHTING DOJO\nuntil then.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_BlueBefore
source:
Who are you?\pWell, it's plain to see that you're
a trainer…\pMy name's BLUE.\pI was once the CHAMPION, although
it was for only a short time…\pThat meddling RED did me in…\pAnyway, what do you want? You want
to challenge me or something?\p…I hate to say it, but I'm not in
the mood for a battle now.\pTake a good look around you…\pA volcano erupts, and just like
that, a whole town disappears.\pWe can go on winning and losing in
POKéMON. But if nature so much as\ltwitches, we can lose in a second.\p…\pThat's the way it is…\pBut, anyway, I'm still a trainer.\pIf I see a strong opponent, it
makes me want to battle.\pIf you want to battle me, you'll
need 15 badges first.\pI'll take you on then.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_Blue
source:
Who are you?\pWell, it's plain to see that you're
a trainer…\pMy name's BLUE.\pI was once the CHAMPION, although
it was for only a short time…\pThat meddling RED did me in…\pAnyway, what do you want? You want
to challenge me or something?\p…I hate to say it, but I'm not in
the mood for a battle now.\pTake a good look around you…\pA volcano erupts, and just like
