that, a whole town disappears.\pWe can go on winning and losing in
POKéMON. But if nature so much as\ltwitches, we can lose in a second.\p…\pThat's the way it is…\pBut, anyway, I'm still a trainer.\pIf I see a strong opponent, it
makes me want to battle.\pIf you want to battle me, come to
the VIRIDIAN GYM.\pI'll take you on then.$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign
source: There's a notice here…\pCINNABAR GYM has relocated to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS.\pBLAINE$

label: CinnabarIsland_Text_Sign
source: CINNABAR ISLAND\pThe Fiery Town of Burning Desire$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter1F_Text_CooltrainerF
source: CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE apparently\nlives alone in the SEAFOAM ISLANDS\lcave…$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Fisher
source: It's been a year since the volcano\nerupted.$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_TakesTimeGoForWalkJP
source: ちょっと　じかん　かかるよ！\pそこらへんを　すこし\nブラブラ　してくると　よろしー！$

label: CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom_Text_NoRoomForPokemon
source: ポケモン　いっぱいで　もてないね！$

label: CliffEdgeCave_Text_Baldman
source: If you see a fork in the road\ninside a cave, most likely one\lway is right and the other leads\lto a dead end.\pBut people can't help trying both.$

label: CliffEdgeGate_Text_IntroOpen
source:
Did you know? There's a SAFARI ZONE
just around the corner.\pIt's really fun!
You will see many different kinds of\lPOKéMON, and it's all you can catch!\pThere is no reason not to go, right?
Just around the corner.$

label: CliffEdgeGate_Text_Expectations
source: I appreciate that everybody is looking\nforward to it.\pBut the lady at the reception seems\na bit too dramatic...\pDon't get your expectations too high!$

label: CliffEdgeGate_Text_SignOpen
source: Everything Is Thrilling!\nExplore to Find Wild POKéMON!\lWarden BAOBA's SAFARI ZONE\lUp and Running!$

label: DarkCave2_Text_Nerd
source:
Whoa! You startled me there!\pI had my BLACK-GLASSES on, so I
didn't notice you at all.\pWhat am I doing here?\pHey, don't you worry about it.\pI'll give you a pair of BLACK-
GLASSES, so forget you saw me,
OK?$

label: DarkCave2_Text_Nerd2
source: BLACK-GLASSES ups the power of\nDARK-type moves.$

label: DiglettsCave_EntranceNorth_Text_Brock
source: BROCK: Small spaces surrounded by\nrocks make you feel peaceful,\ldon't you agree?\pIf you want another match, I'll be\nat the FIGHTING DOJO.$

label: DragonsDen_Text_Clair
source: {PLAYER}… So you're here.\pIf you think you can keep up,\nwith me, come to the FIGHTING\lDOJO in SAFFRON.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_Clair_GiveTM
source: CLAIR: WAIT!\pI'm sorry about this.\nHere, take this as my apology.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_Clair_ExplainTM
source: DRAGON PULSE is a kind of er...\nnever mind!\pIt's a huge energy of some kind.\pIf you don't want it, you don't have\nto take it.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_ClairWhatsTheMatter
source:
What's the matter? Aren't
you going on to the POKéMON\lLEAGUE?\pAfter you become CHAMPION, you
can rematch any GYM LEADER you\lwant.\pGo to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pDo you know how to get there?\pFrom here, go to NEW BARK TOWN.\pThen SURF east to POKéMON LEAGUE.\pThe route there is very tough.\pDon't you dare lose at the POKéMON
LEAGUE!\pIf you do, I'll feel even worse
about having lost to you!\pGive it everything you've got.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_DragonShrineSign
source: DRAGON SHRINE\pA shrine honoring the dragon\nPOKéMON\psaid to have lived in DRAGON'S\nDEN.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_SilverTraining1
source:
…
What? {PLAYER}?\p…No, I won't battle you now…\pMy POKéMON aren't ready to beat
you.\pI can't push them too hard now.\pI have to be disciplined to become
the greatest POKéMON trainer…$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_SilverTraining2
source: …\pWhew…\pLearn to stay out of my way…$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainermDarinSeen
source: You! How dare you enter\nuninvited!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainermDarinBeaten
source: S-strong!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainermDarinAfter
source: The SHRINE ahead is home to the\nMASTER of our dragon-user clan.\pYou're not allowed to just go in!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainerfCaraSeen
source: You shouldn't be in here!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainerfCaraBeaten
source: Oh yikes, I lost!$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_CooltrainerfCaraAfter
source: Soon I'm going to get permission\nfrom our MASTER to use dragons.\pWhen I do, I'm going to become an\nadmirable dragon trainer and gain\lour MASTER's approval.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia1Seen
source: It's a stranger we don't know.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia1Beaten
source: Ouchies.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia1After
source: It was like having to battle\nLANCE.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia2Seen
source: Who are you?$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia2Beaten
source: Meanie.$

label: DragonsDen_Cavern_Text_TwinsLeaandPia2After
source: We'll tell on you.\pMASTER will be angry with you.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ElderGreeting
source:
Hm… Good to see you here.\pNo need to explain why you came.
CLAIR sent you here, didn't she?\pThat girl is a handful…
I am sorry, but I must test you.\pNot to worry, you are to answer
only a few questions.\lReady?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question1
source: What are POKéMON to you?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question2
source: What helps you to win battles?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question3
source: What kind of trainer do you wish\nto battle?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question4
source: What is most important for\nraising POKéMON?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Question5
source: Strong POKéMON. Weak POKéMON.\nWhich is more important?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_WrongAnswer1
source: Hah? I didn't quite catch that…$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_WrongAnswer2
source: What was it you said?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_RightAnswer
source: Oh, I understand…$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_PassedTest
source: Hm… I see…\pYou care deeply for POKéMON.\pVery commendable.\pThat conviction is what is\nimportant!\p{PLAYER}, don't lose that belief.\pIt will see you through at the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairYouPassed
source: So how did it go?\pI guess there's no point\nin asking. You did fail?\p..................................\p…What? You passed?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairThatCantBe
source: That can't be!$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairYoureLying
source: You're lying!\pEven I haven't been approved!$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_MustIInformLance
source: CLAIR!\pThis child is impeccable,\nin skill and spirit!\pAdmit defeat and confer the\nRISINGBADGE!\p…Or must I inform LANCE of this?$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_IUnderstand
source: I-I understand…$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_HereRisingBadge
source: Here, this is the RISINGBADGE…\pHurry up! Take it!$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_PlayerReceivedRisingBadge
source: {PLAYER} received RISINGBADGE.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_RisingBadgeExplanation
source: RISINGBADGE will enable your\nPOKéMON to use the move for\lclimbing waterfalls.\pAlso, all POKéMON will recognize\nyou as a trainer and obey your\levery command without question.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ElderScoldsClair
source: CLAIR…\pReflect upon what it is that you\nlack and this child has.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ComeAgain
source: Come again, if you so desire.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_SilverIsInTraining
source: A boy close to your age is in\ntraining here.\pHe is much like CLAIR when she was\nyounger. It is a little worrisome…$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Elder2
source: It's been quite some time since a\ntrainer has gained our MASTER's\lrare approval.\pIn fact, not since Master LANCE.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_Elder3
source: You know young Master LANCE?\pHe looks so much like our MASTER\ndid in his youth.\pIt's in their blood.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_TakeThisDratini
source: Hm… Good to see you here.\pYour arrival is most fortunate.\pI have something for you.\pTake this DRATINI as proof that I\nhave recognized your worth.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_SymbolicDragon
source: Dragon POKéMON are symbolic of our\nclan.\pYou have shown that you can be\nentrusted with one.$

label: DragonsDen_Shrine_Text_ClairsGrandfather
source: CLAIR appears to have learned an\ninvaluable lesson from you.\pI thank you as her grandfather.$

label: EcruteakCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: ECRUTEAK CITY POKéMON GYM$

label: EcruteakCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: ECRUTEAK CITY POKéMON GYM\pMORTY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: MortyIntroText
source:
Good of you to have come.\pHere in ECRUTEAK, POKéMON have
always been revered.\pIt's said that a rainbow-colored
POKéMON will come down to\lappear before a true Trainer.\pI believed that tale, so I've
trained here in secret.\pAs a result, I can now see what
others cannot.\pJust a bit more...\pWith a little more, I could see
a future where I meet the\lrainbow-colored POKéMON.\pYou're going to help me reach
that level!$

label: MortyWinLossText
source: I'm not good enough yet...\pAll right. This BADGE is yours.$

label: Text_ReceivedFogBadge
source: {PLAYER} received the FOGBADGE.$

label: MortyText_FogBadgeSpeech
source: With the FOGBADGE, POKéMON up\nto Level 50 will obey you.\pAlso, any POKéMON that knows\nSURF will be able to use it\lanytime.\pI want you to have this too.$

label: MortyText_ShadowBallSpeech
source: That's SHADOW BALL.\nIt causes damage and may\llower SP. DEF.\pUse it if it suits you.$

label: MortyFightDoneText
source: I see...\pYour journey has taken you to\nfar-off places.\pYou've witnessed more than I\never have.\pI envy you for that...$

label: MortyRematchText
source:
Ah, the JOHTO CHAMPION!
Good of you to come.\pYou've shown strength and skill,
but have you grown since we\llast battled?\pI've trained with my GHOST-type
POKéMON ever since.\pLet's see if you can overcome
the shadows again.\pWant to have a rematch?$

label: Morty_RematchDefeatText
source: I'm not good enough yet...\pYou've witnessed more than I\never have.\pI envy you for that...$

label: SageJeffreySeenText
source: I spent the spring with my\nPOKéMON.\pThen summer, fall, and winter...\pThen spring came again.\nWe've been together a long time.$

label: SageJeffreyBeatenText
source: Wins and losses--I've known\nthem both.$

label: SageJeffreyAfterBattleText
source: Where did POKéMON come from?$

label: SagePingSeenText
source: Can you inflict any damage\non our POKéMON?$

label: SagePingBeatenText
source: Ah! Well done!$

label: SagePingAfterBattleText
source: We use GHOST-type POKéMON.\pNo NORMAL-type attacks can\nharm them!$

label: MediumMarthaSeenText
source: I shall win!$

label: MediumMarthaBeatenText
source: I... I... I lost!$

label: MediumMarthaAfterBattleText
source: The one who wants to win the\nmost is the one who will!$

label: MediumGraceSeenText
source: Stumped by our dark corridors?\nDefeat me if you want a hint!$

label: MediumGraceBeatenText
source: Wha-what?$

label: MediumGraceAfterBattleText
source: Fine. I'll tell you the secret\nof the shadows.\pThe path is right in front of\nyour eyes!$

label: EcruteakCity_GymGuideText
source:
Hey CHAMP! You're almost
halfway there!\pTrainers here use GHOST and
DARK-type POKéMON.\pWhile MORTY is a GHOST-type
expert, be wary of his mystic\ldeer.\pIt's said to cause strange
nightmares...$

label: EcruteakCity_GymGuideWinText
source: Whew, {PLAYER}. You did great!\pI was cowering in the corner\nout of pure terror!$

label: EcruteakCity_GymClosedText
source: MORTY, the GYM LEADER, is\nabsent.\pSorry, but you'll have to\nleave.\pHohohoho.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Silver1
source: THUD!!$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Silver2
source: {RIVAL}: How...? How is this\npossible? How can I lose to mere\lKIMONO GIRLS...?$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Silver3
source:
{RIVAL}: You were watching me,
{PLAYER}...\pYeah, that's right!\pI never thought defeating five
KIMONO GIRLS would be so hard...\pI got beaten to a pulp...\p...\pYou must have come here for the
same reason, right?\pDon't get cocky just because you
defeated TEAM ROCKET!\pThese KIMONO GIRLS are insanely
strong.\pSee if you can defeat them.\pBut I'm not going back, I don't
want to see you win.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Eevee
source: EEVEE: Veee!$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Vulpix
source: VULPIX: Vullll Pix!$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_UnusedMissingDaughter
source: Oh, no. Oh, no…\pMy daughter is missing.\pNo… She couldn't have gone to the\nBURNED TOWER.\pI told her not to go near it…\pPeople seem to disappear there…\pOh, what should I do…?$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Gramps1
source: ECRUTEAK used to have two towers:\none each in the east and west.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Gramps2
source: Ah, child. Have you learned to\ndance like the KIMONO GIRLS?\pIf you go to their DANCE THEATER,\nan odd old man will give you\lsomething nice, I hear.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Lass1
source: I'm going to practice at the DANCE\nTHEATER. Care to join me?$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Lass2
source: The tower that used to be here…\pMy grandma told me it used to be\nmuch taller.\pI hear there are ghosts in it now.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Lass2_ReleasedBeasts
source: Three big POKéMON ran off in different\ndirections. What were they?$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Fisher
source: I heard a rumor about OLIVINE\nLIGHTHOUSE.\pThe POKéMON that serves as the\nbeacon fell ill. Sounds like they\lare in trouble.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Fisher_JasmineReturned
source: The POKéMON at OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE\nhas been cured.\pBoats can safely sail out to sea at\nnight again.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Youngster
source: I hear POKéMON are rampaging at the\nLAKE OF RAGE. I'd like to see that.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Gramps3
source:
In the distant past…\pThis tower burned in a fire. Three
nameless POKéMON perished in it.\pA rainbow-colored POKéMON descended
from the sky and resurrected them…\pIt's a legend that has been passed
down by ECRUTEAK GYM LEADERS.\pMe?\pI was a trainer way back when.
Hohoho!$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_SageGym
source: Gym Leader MORTY is not here right\nnow. You may find him at the\lBURNED TOWER.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_Sign
source: ECRUTEAK CITY\nA Historical City\pWhere the Past Meets the Present$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_TinTowerSign
source: TIN TOWER\pA legendary POKéMON is said to\nroost here.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_OfficeSign
source: Barrier Station to TIN TOWER\pNo Trespassing by the Unworthy.$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_GymSign
source: ECRUTEAK CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MORTY\pThe Mystic Seer of the Future$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_DanceTheaterSign
source: ECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER$

label: EcruteakCity_Text_BurnedTowerSign
source: BURNED TOWER\pIt was destroyed by a mysterious\nfire.\pPlease stay away, as it is unsafe.$

label: EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse_Text_Gramps
source: This happened when I was young.\pThe sky suddenly turned black. A\ngiant flying POKéMON was blocking\lout the sun.\pI wonder what that POKéMON was?\pIt was like a bird and a dragon.$

label: EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouse_Text_Youngster
source: Is there really a POKéMON that big?\pIf it exists, it must be powerful.$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderAdventure
source: Ah. You're on an adventure with\nyour POKéMON?\pWell, what's an adventure without\ntreasure hunting?\pAm I right, or am I right?$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderTrueSpirit
source: Good! You understand the true\nspirit of adventure.\pI like that! Take this with you.$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderExplanation
source:
There are many items lying about
that aren't obvious.\pUse DOWSING MACHINE to check if there
is an item on the ground near you.\pIt doesn't show the exact spot,
so you'll have to look yourself.\pOh yeah--I heard there are items
in ECRUTEAK's BURNED TOWER.$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemfinderToEachHisOwn
source: Oh… To each his own, I suppose…$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ItemFinderMan
source: ECRUTEAK is a very old city.\nMany generations passed down\ltheir history in books like these.$

label: Ecruteak_Text_HistoryBook
source: HISTORY OF ECRUTEAK\pWant to read it?$

label: Ecruteak_Text_TwoTowers
source:
In ECRUTEAK, there were two towers.\pEach tower was the roost of
powerful flying POKéMON.\pBut one of the towers burned to
the ground.\pThe two POKéMON haven't been seen
since…\pKeep reading?$

label: Ecruteak_Text_ThreeMon
source:
ECRUTEAK was also home to three
POKéMON that raced around the town.\pThey were said to have been born
of water, lightning and fire.\pBut they could not contain their
excessive power.\pSo they say the three ran like the
wind off into the grassland.$

label: EcruteakMart_Text_SuperNerd
source: My EEVEE evolved into an ESPEON.\pBut my friend's EEVEE turned into\nan UMBREON.\pI wonder why? We both were raising\nour EEVEE in the same way…$

label: EcruteakMart_Text_Granny
source: If you use REVIVE, a POKéMON that's\nfainted will wake right up.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Bill1
source: Hi, I'm BILL. And who are you?\pHmm, {PLAYER}, huh?\nYou've come at the right time.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Bill2
source:
I just finished adjustments on my
POKéMON STORAGE SYSTEM.\pYou know that PC you use to store
all your POKéMON?\pI developed that myself!\pNow that I've installed this one,
my PC is running at all\lPOKéMON CENTERS in JOHTO and KANTO.\pI have to hurry on back to
GOLDENROD and see my folks. Feel\lfree to visit anytime!\pBuh-bye!$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_PokefanM
source: The way the KIMONO GIRLS dance is\nmarvelous.\pJust like the way they use their\nPOKéMON.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_PokefanM_Mobile
source: You must be hoping to battle more\npeople, right?\pThere's apparently some place where\ntrainers gather.\pWhere, you ask?\pIt's a little past OLIVINE CITY.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_CooltrainerF
source: MORTY, the GYM LEADER, is soooo\ncool.\pHis POKéMON are really tough too.$

label: EcruteakCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_GymGuide
source: LAKE OF RAGE…\pThe appearance of a GYARADOS\nswarm…\pI smell a conspiracy. I know it!$

label: EcruteakCity_SageOffice1_Text_Sign
source: The bell of tin rings clearly for\nthose under the tower's wing.$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageNoBadge
source: TIN TOWER is off limits to the\nunworthy. Sorry but you'll have\lto leave.$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageWithBadge
source: TIN TOWER is off limits to anyone\nwithout ECRUTEAK GYM's BADGE.\pAh!\pECRUTEAK's GYM BADGE! Please, go\nright through.$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageNoClearBell
source: A momentous event has occurred.\pI beg your pardon, but I must ask\nyou to leave.\p…What soothes the soul…\pThe WISE TRIO say things that are\nso very difficult to understand…$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageHearsClearBell1
source: A momentous event has occurred.\pI beg your pardon, but I must ask\nyou to leave.\p..............................$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageHearsClearBell2
source:
Ah!\pThe sound of that CLEAR BELL!\pIt… It's sublime!\pI've never heard so beautiful a
sound before!\pThat bell's chime is indicative of
the bearer's soul.\pYou…\pYou may be able to make it through
TIN TOWER.\pPlease, do go on.$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SagePleaseDoGoOn
source: Please, do go on.$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_SageDone
source: That bell's chime is indicative of\nthe bearer's soul.\pYou…\nTruly are worthy.$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_WanderingSage
source: The TIN TOWER ahead is a nine-\ntier tower of divine beauty.\pIt soothes the soul of all who\nsee it.$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_WanderingSageClearBell
source: The TIN TOWER shook! A POKéMON must\nhave returned to the top!$

label: EcruteakTinTowerEntrance_Text_Gramps
source: Two towers… Two POKéMON…\pBut when one burned down, both\nPOKéMON flew away, never to return.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Rocket1
source: ROCKET: Stop dancing such a serious\ndance! Show me something like\la hula dance!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_KimonoRocket1
source: KIMONO GIRL: ...You mustn't push\nsuch a request on me.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Rocket2
source: ROCKET: Huh?\pAre you telling me you don't\nrespect what the customer\lwants?$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Rocket3
source: Well, then I'll show you how\nto dance. I'll show you a\lgreat one.\pWahahaha!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_RocketSeen
source: Huh? Who are you?\nYou dare to get in my way?$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_RocketBeaten
source: Oh, no!\nYou make me look like a\lvillain!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_RocketAfter
source: Oops! I have an important mission!\nIf they find out I was wasting\ltime here, they'll make me start\lover as the lowest ROCKET GRUNT!\pI better leave now!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_KimonoRocket3
source:
You must be {PLAYER},
correct? That was indeed\lexcellent.\pKind and strong... Good at
raising POKéMON as well...\pThat person does know what
to look for in people...\pOhoho! That was just me
talking to myself.\lNever mind.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Kimono
source:
For KIMONO GIRLS like me,
dancing is everything.\pI have never gone a day
without a dance practice.\pPOKéMON are the same.
They grow with you little\lby little each day.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SurfGuyRocket
source: What's the deal with that\nTeam Rocket Grunt, messing\lwith that KIMONO GIRL?\pYou are a Trainer, right?\nPlease help her!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SurfGuyGiveSurf
source: Wonderful! You were so\ncourageous for your age!\pIt was a rare sight to see!\nI want you to have this.\pDon't be shy--take it!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SurfGuyGaveSurf
source: That's SURF.\nIt's a move that lets POKéMON\lswim across water with ease.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SurfGuyAfter
source:
Not only are the KIMONO GIRLS
great dancers, they're also\lskilled at POKéMON.\pBut they battle only for good
reasons.\pI don't know if you could beat
them if they showed their skill...$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Psyduck
source: PSYDUCK: Dau dau!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_BoyBefore
source: Eeeeek!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Boy
source: I was supposed to be the hero...!\nSo much for getting close to\la KIMONO GIRL!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Granny
source:
That man's always with his
PSYDUCK.\pSays he wants a POKéMON that
can SURF and dance.\pIs he trying to make a POKéMON
that stars in synchronized\lswimming?$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_GrannyBefore
source: Oh... Ouch...!\nThis stomachache!\pI wouldn't let this guy act like\nthat if not for this pain...!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Gramps
source:
The KIMONO GIRLS are so
beautiful...\pBut they have to go through
rigorous training.\pAnd they have to learn to follow
customs before appearing in\lpublic.\pBut if you love something,
anything is possible.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_GrampsBefore
source: Oh... Ouch...!\nThis back pain!\pI wouldn't let this guy act like\nthat if not for this pain...!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_Girl
source: The KIMONO GIRLS are my big\nsisters! I'll be like them one\lday!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_GirlBefore
source: I like that funny dance!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_FancyPanel
source: It's a fancy panel that's\ndecorated with flowers.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiSeen
source:
Welcome. My name is ZUKI.
I met you previously in VIOLET\lCITY.\pTo bring back {STR_VAR_1}, we
needed someone with the right bond\lwith POKéMON.\pWe asked MR. POKéMON to give this
MYSTERY EGG to\lwhoever showed potential.\pThe EGG went from MR. POKéMON
to PROF.ELM, then to you.\pBut being pure alone is not enough
to face the power of this POKéMON.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiSeenAgain
source: I will test you to see if you are\na good Trainer.\pAre you ready, {PLAYER}?$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiNo
source: That is fine...\nI will wait for you to get\lready.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_NaokoSeen
source:
You are quite strong. You helped
me in the ILEX FOREST.\pI'm NAOKO--not so good with
directions.\pI saw you defeat Team Rocket
when KURT was in trouble at\lthe SLOWPOKE WELL.\pLet me challenge you and your
POKéMON!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_MikiSeen
source:
You're quite the Trainer. I
remember you chased off that\lRocket Grunt from right here.\pThank you for that.\pThough, I'm a Trainer too.
She who knows the most speaks\lthe least!\pI am MIKI--the KIMONO GIRL!\pLet me challenge you and your
POKéMON!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_SayoSeen
source:
Excellent spirit! You got me
off the ice by pushing me.\pI skate in sandals.
I am SAYO--the KIMONO GIRL!\pI listened in the DRAGON'S DEN
when you passed the Elder's test.\pLet me challenge you and your
POKéMON!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_KuniSeen
source:
I'm the last one.\pYou were dependable at the
GOLDENROD TUNNEL.\pI'm the one who twirls even
underground--KUNI!\pI saw you thwart Rocket's
plan to take the Radio Tower.\pNow show me your strength!
Let me challenge you and your\lPOKéMON!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiDone
source: We were not wrong about you.\nYou are indeed worthy of this...\pPlease take it.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_GirlHooh
source: Big sisters! I just saw the\nbig shadow of a POKéMON over\lthe TIN TOWER!\pIt could be...$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_GirlLugia
source: Big sisters! I just saw the\nbig shadow of a POKéMON in the\lWHIRL ISLANDS' waters!\pIt could be...$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiHooh
source: ZUKI: {PLAYER}!\nWe'll be at the TIN TOWER.\nSee you there!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiLugia
source: ZUKI: {PLAYER}!\nWe'll be at the WHIRL ISLANDS.\lSee you there!$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_KimonoDone
source: We are rehearsing a dance.$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_ZukiAfterAll
source:
Thank you for your help the
other day.\pYou've shown the bond between
people can grow with POKéMON...\pWe appreciate how you lived up
to our hopes, {PLAYER}!\pIf you learned anything from
this, thank MR. POKéMON and\lPROF.ELM...$

label: EcruteakCity_Theater_Text_KimonoGirlsBeforeBattle
source: Talk to ZUKI in the middle\nwhen you are ready.$

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
source: EVER GRANDE CITY\p“The paradise of flowers, the sea,\nand POKéMON.”$

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
source:
WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pThat incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY…
That was superb work, putting an end\lto that crisis all by yourself.\pOops!\pIt wouldn't be fair to say that you
alone ended the crisis.\pYou overcame that difficult situation
by working as one with your POKéMON.\pWe TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving
them items and by teaching them new\ltechniques for battle.\pBut we ourselves also learn many
things from POKéMON.\pAnd this is where your achievements
are put to the test against what\lothers like you have achieved.\pNow!\pWho can most elegantly dance with
their POKéMON in HOENN?\pShow me right here and now!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_MakeThinkImJustKid
source: Fufufufufu.\pI'm going to make everyone think\nI'm just a kid and let them play down.\pThen, I'll shock them and grab\nthe title!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_FallarborTentMyFavorite
source:
You know how BATTLE TENTS offer
different events?\pMy favorite is definitely the red
colored TENT.\pI think it's fantastic how TRAINERS
try to win with all their faith in\ltheir POKéMON.$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_CameToCampOut
source:
I heard something about some tent,
so I came to camp out.\pI didn't know that tents these days
are so luxurious!\pSince I'm here, I may as well try
my hand at battling!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_ScottLookingForSomeone
source:
SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
So you came out to this BATTLE TENT!\pThe people in these parts tend to be
easygoing and laid-back.\pBut, you see, what I'm looking for are
people with…\pHow should I say this?\pSomeone bursting with the desire
and the drive to win.\pIf there were a TRAINER like that,
I'd immediately…\pWhoops! Never mind!
Keep working at it!$

label: FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_hns_Text_ScottMakeChallenge
source: SCOTT: Instead of wasting your\ntime with the likes of me, why not\lmake a challenge?$

label: FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_CantTeachEgg
source: Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.$

label: FarawayIsland_Entrance_hns_Text_Sign
source: The writing is fading as if it\nwas written a long time ago..\p..ber, 6th day If any human..\nsets foot here.. again..et it\lbe a kindhearted pers.. ..ith\lthat hope, I depar..$

label: FarawayIsland_Interior_hns_Text_TheFeelingOfBeingWatchedFaded
source: The feeling of being watched faded…$

label: FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_DoorNeedsTwoPasswords
source: とびらを　あけるには\nパスワードが　2つ　いるようだ$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_YouveComeBackForTheEgg
source: やあ\nタマゴを　もらいに\lきて　くれたんだね$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
source: There's no need for WINONA, our GYM\nLEADER, to deal with you!\pI'm plenty good enough for you!$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
source:
With the FEATHER BADGE, all POKéMON up
to LV 70, even those received through\ltrades, will obey your every command.\pYou will also be able to use
the HM move FLY outside of battle.\pAnd this…
This is a gift from me.$

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
source: WINONA: Even though I have lost,\nthe wings of my heart remain unbroken.\pI can rise and soar again and\nyet again.\pI am convinced of it!$

label: FourIsland_Text_RivalAlreadyGotEggBeSmellingYa
source:
{RIVAL}: Hey!
{PLAYER}!\pWhat are you doing here in the
SEVII ISLANDS?\pYou should quit copying me,
you know?\pAnyways, I already got my POKéMON
EGG, so I'm done with this island.\pHeh, I bet you don't even know
about POKéMON EGGS.\pYou'll never fill your NATIONAL
POKéDEX that way.\pBy the way, I saw someone we both
know on this island.\pWhy don't you go look around if
it makes you curious?\pMe, I don't have the time to
waste.\pBe smelling ya!$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasLotsOfStuffedDolls
source:
Oh, you found me!
Please don't tell LORELEI.\pDid you know that LORELEI has lots
and lots of stuffed dolls?\pEvery time she comes back to
FOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!$

label: FourIsland_Text_LoreleisHouse
source: LORELEI'S HOUSE$

label: FourIsland_Mart_Text_IcefallCaveIsFrigid
source:
The SEVII ISLANDS are in a warm
region overall.\pBut there is one exception you
need to know about.\pThe ICEFALL CAVE is frigid because
of the POKéMON that live in it.$

label: FourIsland_House1_Text_FatMan
source: それ　ぼよーん！\nおまえ　おもいなあー！$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_Janine_DisappointYou
source: Fufufufu…\pI'm sorry to disappoint you…\pI'm only joking!\pI'm the real deal!\pJANINE of FUCHSIA GYM, that's me!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_Janine_ToughOne
source: JANINE: You're a tough one. You\ndefinitely won…\pHere's SOULBADGE. Take it.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedSoulBadge
source: {PLAYER} received SOULBADGE.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_Janine_GiveTM
source: JANINE: You're so tough! I have a\nspecial gift!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_Janine_ExplainTM
source: It's POISON JAB, a powerful Poison-type\nmove that may poison its victim.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_Janine_ApplyMyself
source: JANINE: I'm going to really apply\nmyself and improve my skills.\pI want to become better than both\nFather and you!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_LassAlice_Before
source: Fufufu!\pI'm JANINE, the GYM LEADER!\pNo, I'm not! Gotcha, sucker!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_LassAlice_Beaten
source: I had you fooled…$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_LassAlice_After
source: How will you distinguish our real\nLEADER?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_LassLinda_Before
source: Fooled you! Hahaha!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_LassLinda_Beaten
source: Ooh… I lost… You're not weak…$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_LassLinda_After
source: Well? Wasn't my disguise perfect?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PicnickerCindy_Before
source: I'm JANINE!\pHow did you know I was real?\pLet's battle!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PicnickerCindy_Beaten
source: Darn it! I wanted to win!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PicnickerCindy_After
source: You must be getting tired.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_CamperBarry_Before
source: Wahahaha!\pYou betcha! I'm JANINE!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_CamperBarry_Beaten
source: My disguise was right on! Dang!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_CamperBarry_After
source: Hey, you. Was my disguise cute or\nwhat, huh?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JANINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JANINE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_Guide
source: Yo, CHAMP in making!\pWhoops! Take a good look around you.\pThe trainers all look like the\nLEADER, JANINE.\pWhich of them is the real JANINE?$

label: FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GuideWin
source: That was a great battle, trainer\nfrom JOHTO!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_BaobaName
source: BAOBA$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_Baoba
source:
WARDEN BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\pThis is WARDEN BAOBA.\pSomething awful has happened!
My old SAFARI ZONE in FUCHSIA CITY\lwas bought out and reopened!\pAnd apparently it has exotic new
POKéMON!\pIt's hurting my business!\p{PLAYER}, you must venture into the
new SAFARI ZONE and catch a POKéMON\lto show me. I must know about these\l'exotic' POKéMON.\pPlease {PLAYER}, my business depends
on you!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_Youngster
source: One of the ELITE FOUR used to be\nthe LEADER of FUCHSIA's GYM.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_PokefanM
source: KOGA's daughter succeeded him as\nthe GYM LEADER after he joined the\lELITE FOUR.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_Teacher
source: The SAFARI ZONE is under new\nmanagement.\pAnd it has tons of new POKéMON!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_Sign
source: FUCHSIA CITY\pBehold! It's Passion Pink!$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign
source: FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: JANINE\pThe Poisonous Ninja Master$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneOfficeSign
source: There's a notice here…\pSAFARI ZONE OFFICE is closed until\nfurther notice.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZone
source: SAFARI ZONE\nNOW OWNED BY\lDEVON CORP.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneClosedSign
source: The WARDEN is traveling abroad.\pTherefore, the SAFARI ZONE is\nclosed.$

label: FuchsiaCity_Text_NoLitteringSign
source: No littering.\pPlease take your waste with you.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillsOlderSister
source: My grandpa is at my brother BILL's\non CERULEAN CAPE.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_Youngster
source: I saw these weird, slow POKéMON on\nCYCLING ROAD.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_WardensGranddaughter1
source:
My grandpa is the SAFARI ZONE
WARDEN.\pAt least he was…\pHe decided to go on a vacation and
took off overseas all by himself.\pHe quit running SAFARI ZONE just
like that.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_WardensGranddaughter2
source: Many people were disappointed that\nSAFARI ZONE closed down, but Grandpa\lis so stubborn…$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_WardenPhoto
source: It's a photo of a grinning old man\nwho's surrounded by POKéMON.$

label: FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_SafariZonePhoto
source: It's a photo of a huge grassy plain\nwith rare POKéMON frolicking in it.$

label: FuchsiaMart_Text_Fisher
source: The old SAFARI ZONE had way better\nsouvenirs...$

label: FuchsiaMart_Text_CooltrainerF
source: The old SAFARI ZONE WARDEN's \ngranddaughter lives in town.$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_CooltrainerM
source: Hey! You have a brand new kind of\nPOKéDEX.\pDid PROF.OAK give that to you?$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_CooltrainerF
source: I got quite a shock at the GYM.\pThere were all these girls who\nlooked identical.$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_JanineImpersonator1
source: I'm JANINE! Hocus-pocus… Poof!$

label: FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter1F_Text_JanineImpersonator2
source: See? I look just like her now!$

label: Route15FuchsiaGate_Text_Officer
source: You're working on a POKéDEX? That's\nreally something.\pDon't give up!$

label: SafariZoneFuchsia_Text_Attendant1
source: This area requires\nSAFARI LEVEL 2.$

label: SafariZoneFuchsia_Text_Attendant2
source: This area requires\nSAFARI LEVEL 3.$

label: SafariZoneFuchsia_Text_Attendant3
source: This area requires\nSAFARI LEVEL 4.$

label: SafariZoneFuchsia_Text_Approved
source: Go right ahead.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_StevenGiveCase
source: Oh and you might need this.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_StevenChamp
source:
Oh, hey {PLAYER}.
Or should I say KANTO champion?\pYou know, for some time, I was the
champion of the HOENN region.\pSo welcome to the club, {PLAYER}.\pIn fact, here.
Consider this a welcome gift.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_StevenWelcome
source:
Hello again, {PLAYER}!\pWelcome to the DEVON SAFARI ZONE!\pThis specially designed safari
has 4 different habitats that\lattract and house different invasive\lspecies from the HOENN region.\pWe encourage trainers to capture
as many as they can to safely\lremove them from the environment.\pYou'll find very rare POKéMON
here. Especially if you increase\lyour SAFARI LEVEL.\pJust speak to the attendant here
any time to increase your SAFARI\lLEVEL.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Steven
source: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}.\pI hope you're enjoying the SAFARI.\pHave you seen any rare stones\nlately?$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Level1
source: Hello {PLAYER}, would you\nlike to increase your SAFARI LEVEL\lto 2? It will cost you ¥200,000.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Level2
source: Hello {PLAYER}, would you\nlike to increase your SAFARI LEVEL\lto 3? It will cost you ¥300,000.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Level3
source: Hello {PLAYER}, would you\nlike to increase your SAFARI LEVEL\lto 4? It will cost you ¥400,000.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_UpgradeGuyDeclined
source: Oh, that's too bad, then...$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_UpgradeGuyAccepted
source: Enjoy the premium SAFARI ZONE\nexperience!$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_StevenWantToTrade
source:
Say, {PLAYER}…
I've been raising this BELDUM\lfor a while now.\pBut I think it would do better
with a trainer like you.\pWould you trade me a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_StevenTakeCare
source: Excellent!\nPlease take good care of IRON.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_StevenDeclineTrade
source: That's all right.\nThe offer stands if you change\lyour mind.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_StevenNotRequestedMon
source: Hmm, that's not a {STR_VAR_1}.\nThat's not quite what I had\lin mind.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_StevenTradeCompleted
source: How is IRON doing?\nBELDUM are fascinating POKéMON.\pThey communicate with each other\nusing magnetic pulses.$

label: FuchsiaCity_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_MaxLevel
source: Hello {PLAYER}, thank you for\ncontinuing to be a premium member\lat the FUCHSIA SAFARI ZONE.$

label: FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_YouHaveTooMuchStuff
source: なんや　にもつ\nいっぱいやんけ！$

label: Gate_AzaleaTown_IlexForest_Text_Officer
source: ILEX FOREST is big.\nBe careful!\lDon't get lost.$

label: Gate_AzaleaTown_IlexForest_Text_Granny
source: The ILEX FOREST is watched\nover by its protector.\pStay out of mischief!$

label: Route38_Text_EcruteakGateOfficer
source: Where did you say you're from?\pNEW BARK TOWN?\pPROF.ELM lives over there,\nright?\pYou've come a long way to get\nhere.$

label: Route42_Text_EcruteakGateOfficer
source: MT.MORTAR is like a maze\ninside.\pBe careful. Don't get lost\nin there.$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_RandyAskFavor
source: Excuse me, kid! Can you do a guy\na favor?\pCan you take this POKéMON with MAIL\nto my friend?\pHe's on ROUTE 31.$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_RandyThanks
source: You will? Perfect! Thanks, kid!\pMy pal's a chubby guy who snoozes\nall the time.\pYou'll recognize him right away!$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_ReceivedMonWithMail
source: {PLAYER} received a POKéMON with MAIL.$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_RandyWeirdTree
source: Make sure to put it at the front of\nyour team when you find my friend!\pROUTE 31!\pOh, yeah. There was a weird tree\nblocking the road.\pI wonder if it's been cleared?$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_CantCarryMoreMon
source: You can't carry another POKéMON…$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_RandyNeverMind
source: Oh… Never mind, then…$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_ThanksForDelivery
source: Thanks, kid! You made the delivery\nfor me!\pHere's something for your trouble!$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_RandyMyPalSnoozing
source: My pal was snoozing, right? Heh,\nwhat'd I say?$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_PokefanF_TreeBlocking
source: A strange tree is blocking the road.\pIt wriggles around if you talk to it.\pI heard it became wild when someone\nwatered it with a SQUIRTBOTTLE.$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_PokefanF_Lullaby
source: I like the POKéMON Lullaby they play\non the radio.$

label: Route35GoldenrodGate_Text_Fisher
source:
I wonder how many kinds of POKéMON
there are in the world.\pThree years ago, PROF.OAK said that
there were 150 different kinds.\pBut recently I heard there's
over 400!$

label: Route34IlexForestGate_Text_Lass
source:
Did you see the shrine honoring
the protector?\pIt watches over the FOREST from
across time.\pI think that it must be a
GRASS-type POKéMON.$

label: Route34IlexForestGate_Text_Butterfree
source: BUTTERFREE: Freeh!$

label: Route43MahoganyGate_Text_Officer
source: Only people headed up to LAKE OF\nRAGE have been through here lately.$

label: Route43MahoganyGate_Text_Officer_RocketsCleared
source: Nobody goes up to LAKE OF RAGE\nthese days.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_OfficerAskToParticipate
source: Hello Trainer! The Bug-Catching\nContest is on today.\pThe rules are simple.\pUsing one of your POKéMON, catch a\nbug POKéMON to be judged.\pWould you like to give it a try?$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_OfficerGiveSportBalls
source: Any EXP your POKéMON gains during\nthe contest will be reverted when\lyou leave.\pHere are the SPORT BALLS for the\nContest.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_ReceivedSportBalls
source: {PLAYER} received SPORT BALLS.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_OfficerExplainRules
source:
The person who gets the strongest
bug POKéMON is the winner.\pIf you run out of SPORT BALLS,
you're done.\pYou can catch up to 5 POKéMON. The
last one caught will be the only\lone kept and placed in the contest.\pGo out and catch the strongest bug
POKéMON you can find!$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_OfficerAskToUseFirstMon
source: If you have more than one POKéMON,\nyou'll have to use the\lfirst POKéMON in your party.\pIs that OK with you?$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_OfficerHoldYourMon
source: Fine, we'll hold your other POKéMON\nwhile you compete.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_MonLeftWithHelper
source: {PLAYER}'s POKéMON were left with the\nCONTEST HELPER.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_ChooseMonAndComeBack
source: Please choose the POKéMON to be used\nin the Contest, then come see me.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_TakePartInFuture
source: OK. We hope you'll take part in the\nfuture.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_FirstMonCantBattle
source: Uh-oh… The first POKéMON in your\nparty can't battle.\pPlease switch it with the POKéMON\nyou want to use, then come see me.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_MakeRoom
source:
Uh-oh… Both your party and your
PC BOX are full.\pYou have no room to put the bug
POKéMON you catch.\pPlease make room in your party or
your PC BOX, then come see me.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_EggAsFirstMon
source: Uh-oh… You have an EGG as the first\nPOKéMON in your party.\pPlease switch it with the POKéMON\nyou want to use, then come see me.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_ContestIsOver
source: Today's Contest is over. We hope you\nwill participate in the future.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_Rocker
source: I love bird POKéMON! I found a\nDARK-type bird in the park\llast night!$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_BC2
source: I caught a whopping SCYTHER!$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_Beauty
source: He always wins these contests!$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_WeHoldContests
source: We hold Contests regularly in the\nPARK. You should give it a shot.$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_YoungsterWonders
source: When is the next Bug-Catching Contest\ngoing to be?$

label: Route35NationalParkGate_Text_ContestExplanation
source:
The Bug-Catching Contest is held on
Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.\pNot only do you earn a prize just
for participating,\pyou also get to keep the bug POKéMON
you may have at the end of the contest.$

label: Gate_Route29_Route46_Text_Officer
source: You can't climb ledges.\pBut you can jump down from\nthem to take a shortcut.$

label: Gate_Route29_Route46_Text_Youngster
source: Different kinds of POKéMON\nappear past here.\pIf you want to catch them all,\nyou have to look everywhere.$

label: Gate_Route31_VioletCity_Text_Policeman
source: Hi there! Did you visit\nSPROUT TOWER?$

label: Gate_Route31_VioletCity_Text_CooltrainerF
source: I saw the cutest POKéMON out\nthere.\pIt looked a lot like PIKACHU!$

label: Gate_Route43_Rocket_Text_TollFee
source: Hold it there, kiddo!\pThe toll is ¥500 to go\nthrough.$

label: Gate_Route43_Rocket_Text_ThankYou
source: Thank you very much!$

label: Gate_Route43_Rocket_Text_AllYouGot
source: Then pay what you have, please.$

label: Gate_Route43_Rocket_Text_KickOut
source: Wow!\pYou're totally broke!\pI almost feel sorry for you.\pOkay, you can pass...\pJust don't tell the other guard,\nokay?$

label: Gate_Route43_Rocket_Text_MakingABundle
source: He-he-he. We're making a bundle.\pEveryone wants to see what's going\non up at LAKE OF RAGE.$

label: Route43Gate_Text_OfficerFoundTM
source: I got chased from my post by these\nthugs in black.\pThey left this behind.\pIt makes me uncomfortable. Could\nyou take it away?$

label: Gate_Route43_Text_ReceivedTM30
source: {PLAYER} received TM36.$

label: Gate_Route43_Text_OfficerAvoidGrass
source: Use this gate to avoid walking in\nthe grass.$

label: Gate_RuinsOfAlph_Route32_Text_PokefanM
source: You're studying the RUINS?\nI see a scientist in the making.$

label: Gate_RuinsOfAlph_Route32_Text_Youngster
source: There are drawings on stone\npanels.\pI tried moving them.\nI wonder what they are.$

label: Gate_RuinsOfAlph_Route36_Text_Officer
source: RUINS OF ALPH\pA Look-and-Touch Tourist Site\pTry the sliding stone panels!$

label: Gate_RuinsOfAlph_Route36_Text_PokefanM
source: You're studying the RUINS?\pI see a scientist in the making.$

label: Gate_RuinsOfAlph_Route36_Text_Youngster
source: There are drawings on stone\npanels.\pI tried moving them.\nI wonder what they are.$

label: Route5_Text_SaffronGateOfficer
source: You're from JOHTO, aren't you?\pHow do you like KANTO?\nIt's nice, don't you agree?$

label: Route6_Text_SaffronGuardWelcome
source:
Welcome to SAFFRON CITY, home of
the MAGNET TRAIN!\p…That's what I'd normally say,
but the MAGNET TRAIN isn't\lrunning now.\pIt's not getting any electricity
because there's something wrong\lwith the POWER PLANT.$

label: Route6_Text_SaffronGuardMagnetTrain
source: The MAGNET TRAIN is the most\nfamous thing about SAFFRON.$

label: Route7_Text_SaffronGuard_PowerPlant
source: Did you hear about the accident\nat the POWER PLANT?\pIt's located in the East, close\nto LAVENDER TOWN.$

label: Route7_Text_SaffronGuard_Serious
source: I take my GUARD job seriously.\pHey! You have a POKéDEX.\pOK. You can go through.$

label: Route8_Text_SaffronGateOfficer
source: Have you been to LAVENDER TOWN?\pThere's a tall RADIO TOWER there.$

label: GoldenrodCity_BikeShop_Text_Clerk2
source:
Riding the BIKE is as simple as
pressing a button if you\lREGISTER it from the BAG.\pIf you need to go faster,
you first need to come to a stop!\pThat might seem like strange
advice, but you can only change\lgears on the BIKE while stopped.\pPress your R button when stopped
and the next time you pedal,\lyou will reach greater speeds!$

label: GoldenrodCity_BikeShop_Text_ClerkIntro
source: …sigh… I moved here, but I can't\nsell my BICYCLES. Why is that?\pCould you ride a BICYCLE and\nadvertise for me?$

label: GoldenrodCity_BikeShop_Text_ClerkAgreed
source: Really? Great!\pGive me your name and phone number,\nand I'll loan you a BICYCLE.$

label: GoldenrodCity_BikeShop_Text_BorrowedBicycle
source: {PLAYER} borrowed a BICYCLE.$

label: GoldenrodCity_BikeShop_Text_Mainshop
source:
Business has been hard to come
by since we moved from KANTO.\lWe appreciate your help!\pCan you make sure to show off
our patented gear-changing tech?\pIt's as simple as pressing R when
you are stopped on your BIKE.\pBeware! You will then go faster!$

label: GoldenrodCity_BikeShop_Text_Refused
source: …sigh… Oh, for the kindness of\npeople…$

label: GoldenrodCity_BikeShop_Text_JustReleasedCompact
source: Just released!\pFirst-rate compact BICYCLES!$

label: GoldenrodCity_BikeShop_Text_Bicycle
source: It's a shiny new BICYCLE!$

label: BillHouse_Text_TakeThisEevee
source:
BILL: Hi, {PLAYER}! Do us a favor and
take this EEVEE.\pIt was left in our care while
I was away working on my system.\pSomeone has to take care of it,
but I don't like being outside.\pCan I count on you to play with it,
{PLAYER}?$

label: BillHouse_Text_CountingOnYou
source: BILL: I knew you'd come through!\pWay to go! You're the real deal!\pOK, I'm counting on you.\pTake good care of it!$

label: BillHouse_Text_ReceivedEevee
source: {PLAYER} received EEVEE!$

label: BillHouse_Text_EeveeMayEvolve
source: BILL: PROF.ELM claims EEVEE may\nevolve in new and unknown ways.$

label: BillHouse_Text_PartyFull
source: Whoa, wait. You can't carry any\nmore POKéMON.$

label: BillHouse_Text_NoEevee
source: Oh… Now what to do?$

label: BillHouse_Text_PopWontWork
source: BILL: My pop, he won't work. All he\ndoes is goof off all day long.\pHe's getting to be a real headache…$

label: BillHouse_Text_MomBeforeEcruteak
source:
Oh, you collect POKéMON? My son
BILL is an expert.\pHe just got called to the POKéMON
CENTER in ECRUTEAK CITY.\pMy husband went off to the GAME
CORNER without being called…$

label: BillHouse_Text_MomAfterEcruteak
source: My husband was once known as a\nPOKéMANIAC.\pBILL must have taken after his\nfather.$

label: BillHouse_Text_SisterUsefulNumber
source: Are you a TRAINER?\pI've got a useful phone number\nfor you.$

label: BillHouse_Text_RecordedBillsNumber
source: {PLAYER} recorded BILL's number.$

label: BillHouse_Text_SisterRefusedNumber
source: My brother made the PC POKéMON\nstorage system.\pI was going to give you BILL's\nnumber…$

label: BillHouse_Text_SisterPhoneFull
source: You can't record any more numbers.$

label: BillHouse_Text_SisterStorageSystem
source: My big brother BILL made the PC\nPOKéMON storage system.$

label: GoldenrodDeptStore_Text_BlackBeltMove
source: MACHOKE, help us move that boulder!$

label: GoldenrodDeptStore_Text_B1FBlackBelt1
source: Hey, kid! You're holding us up!\pOur policy is to work behind the\nscenes where no one can see us!$

label: GoldenrodDeptStore_Text_B1FBlackBelt2

label: GoldenrodCity_GameCorner_Text_VF_HowToPlay
source:
VOLTORB FLIP is a game in which you flip
cards to find numbers hidden beneath.\pThe cards hide the numbers 1 through 3,
and VOLTORB as well.\pThe first number you flip gives
you that many Coins.\pEach new number multiplies your total.
A 2 by x2 and a 3 by x3.\pBut if you flip a VOLTORB, it's game over.
You lose all Coins collected that round!\pQUIT the game at any time to keep
the Coins you've found so far.\pFind all hidden x2 and x3 cards to clear
the game and advance to the next level!$

label: GoldenrodCity_GameCorner_Text_VF_HintText
source:
The numbers on the sides of the board
are hints about the numbers…\phidden in that row or column.\pThe larger the number, the more high-
value cards are in that row or column.\pThe VOLTORB count tells you how
many VOLTORBs lurk there.\pUse both totals to figure out
which cards are safe to flip!$

label: GoldenrodCity_GameCorner_Text_VF_AboutNotes
source: Use the notes mode ({L_BUTTON} & {R_BUTTON}) to mark\ncards with numbers 1-3 or a VOLTORB.\pMark a card you think you know,\nthen flip it when you're sure.\pApply a note again to remove it.$
