label: GoldenrodCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MonShallBeKnownAsName
source: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!$

label: GoldenrodCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_DoVisitAgain
source: I see.\nDo come visit again.$

label: GoldenrodCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameNoDifferentYetSuperior
source: Done! From now on, this POKéMON\nshall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!\pIt looks no different from before,\nand yet, this is vastly superior!\pHow fortunate for you!$

label: GoldenrodCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MagnificentName
source: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1} it is!\pThis is a magnificent nickname!\nIt is impeccably beyond reproach!\pYou'll do well to cherish your\n{STR_VAR_1} now and beyond.$

label: GoldenrodCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnEgg
source: Now, now.\nThat is merely an EGG!$

label: GoldenrodPPSpeechHouse_Text_Man
source: Once while I was battling, my\nPOKéMON couldn't make any moves.\pThe POWER POINTS, or PP, of its\nmoves were all gone.$

label: GoldenrodPPSpeechHouse_Text_Lass
source: Sometimes, a healthy POKéMON may be\nunable to use its moves.\pIf that happens, heal it at a\nPOKéMON CENTER or use an item.$

label: GoldenrodHappinessRater_Text_PokefanM
source: I keep losing in battles, and my\nPOKéMON end up fainting…\pMaybe that's why my POKéMON don't\nlike me much…$

label: GoldenrodHappinessRater_Text_Twin
source: When I use an item on my POKéMON,\nit acts really glad!$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_LinkNpc_Text_Intro
source: LINK CORNER\pSELECT LINK TYPE.$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_LinkNpc_Text_BattleMode
source: SELECT BATTLE TYPE.$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_LinkNpc_Text_Goodbye
source: GOODBYE.$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_Text_LinkExplainer
source: You can use this machine to trade\nor battle with other local players.\pIsn't technology wonderful?$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_GrannyText
source: I just love living in the big city!\nI moved here when I was a young\ltrainer, like you!$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_GameboyKidText1
source: This is a special POKéMON CENTER.\nThe roof is made of gold!$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_GameboyKidText2
source: I told my brother that the roof is\nmade of real gold. He'll believe\lanything!$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_LassText
source:
A higher level POKéMON doesn't
always win.\pAfter all, it may have a type
disadvantage.\pI don't think there is a single
POKéMON that is the toughest.$

label: GoldenrodPokeCenter_LinkReceptionistPleaseAcceptGSBallText
source: {PLAYER}, isn't it?\pCongratulations!\pAs a special deal, a GS BALL has\nbeen sent just for you!\pPlease accept it!$

label: GoldenrodPokeCenter_LinkReceptionistPleaseDoComeAgainText
source: Please do come again!$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_PokefanFDoYouHaveEonMailText
source: Oh my, your pack looks so heavy!\pOh! Do you happen to have\nsomething named EON MAIL?\pMy daughter is after one.\pYou can part with one, can't you?$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_AskGiveAwayAnEonMailText
source: Give away an EON MAIL?$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_PokefanFThisIsForYouText
source: Oh, that's great! Thank you,\nhoney!\pHere, this is for you in return!$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_PokefanFDaughterWillBeDelightedText
source: My daughter will be delighted!$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_PokefanFTooBadText
source: Oh? You don't have one? Too bad.$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_PokefanFAnotherTimeThenText
source: Oh… Well, another time, then.$

label: GoldenrodCity_PokemonCenter_PlayerGaveAwayTheEonMailText
source: {PLAYER} gave away the EON MAIL.$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_Whitney1
source: WHITNEY: Hi!\pMy name is WHITNEY!\pI heard about the QUIZ to win a\nRADIO CARD, so I came here to get\lone...\pBut this QUIZ is so hard!$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_Whitney2
source: WHITNEY: Wow, you did it!\pI thought the answer to the third\nquestion was surely apricorns!\lOops!\pIt's time to go back to the GYM!$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_ReceptionistWelcome
source: Welcome!$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_ReceptionistNoTours
source: Hello. I'm sorry, but we're not\noffering any tours today.$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_RadioCardWomanOfferQuiz
source:
We have a special QUIZ campaign on
right now.\pAnswer five questions correctly to
win a POKéGEAR RADIO CARD.\pYou and your POKéMON can use it to
play music anytime, anywhere.\pWould you like to take the QUIZ?$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_QuizQuestion1
source: Question 1:\pIs there a POKéMON that appears only\nin the daytime?$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_QuizQuestion2
source: Correct!\nQuestion 2:\pIs this statement correct?\pYou can't buy a BERRY at a MART.$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_QuizQuestion3
source: Bull's-eye!\nQuestion 3:\pKURT, the POKéBALL creator, uses\napricorns as ingredients?$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_QuizQuestion4
source: So far so good!\nQuestion 4:\pIs FALKNER the VIOLET GYM LEADER\nwho uses bird POKéMON?$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_QuizQuestion5
source: Wow! Right again!\nHere's the final question:\pDo GOLDENROD GAME CORNER's slots\nhave CHARMANDER on their reels?$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_QuizWin
source: Bingo! You got it!\nCongratulations!\pHere's your prize, a RADIO CARD!$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_PokegearRadio
source: {PLAYER}'s POKéGEAR can now double as\na RADIO!$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_TuneIn
source: Please tune in to our RADIO shows.$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_WrongAnswer
source: Oh, dear.\nSorry, but you got it wrong.\pPlease try again!$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_DeclineQuiz
source: Oh. I see. Please see me if you\nchange your mind.$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_Lass
source: BEN is a fabulous DJ.\pHis sweet voice makes me melt!$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_Youngster
source: I love MARY, from POKéMON TALK.\pI only know what she sounds like,\nthough.$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_GruntM3Seen
source: We've finally taken over the\nRADIO TOWER!\pNow everyone will get to experience\nthe true terror of TEAM ROCKET!\pWe'll show you how scary we are!$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_GruntM3Beaten
source: Too strong! I'm sorry boss…$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_GruntM3After
source: You're too strong.\pOur plan could be ruined. I must\nwarn the others…$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_Directory
source: 1F RECEPTION\n2F SALES\p3F PERSONNEL\n4F PRODUCTION\p5F DIRECTOR'S OFFICE$

label: RadioTower1F_Text_GotRadio
source: {PLAYER} got the RADIO CARD\nfor the POKéGEAR!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_LotteryCornerDrawTicket
source: This is the POKéMON LOTTERY CORNER.\pIf the LOTO TICKET's number matches\nthe ID number of any of your POKéMON,\lyou will receive a fabulous gift.\pWould you like to draw a POKéMON\nLOTO TICKET?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_ComeBackTomorrow
source: Please come back tomorrow.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_PleaseVisitAgain
source: 欢迎再来。$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_PleasePickTicket
source: Please pick a LOTO TICKET.\n…{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}…{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}…{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}{PAUSE 0x0F}$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_TicketNumberIsXPleaseWait
source: The LOTO TICKET number is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI need to run a check on this number\nto see if it matches any of your\lPOKéMON's ID numbers. Please wait.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_TicketMatchesPartyMon
source: Congratulations!\pThe ID number of your team's\n{STR_VAR_1} matches your\lLOTO TICKET's number!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_TicketMatchesPCMon
source: Congratulations!\pThe ID number of your PC-boxed\n{STR_VAR_1} matches your\lLOTO TICKET's number!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_NoNumbersMatched
source: I'm sorry.\nNone of the numbers matched.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_TwoDigitsMatched
source: Two digits matched, so you win the\nthird prize!\lYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_ThreeDigitsMatched
source: Three digits matched, so you win the\nsecond prize!\lYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_FourDigitsMatched
source: Four digits matched, so you win the\nfirst prize!\lYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_AllFiveDigitsMatched
source: Oh, my goodness, all five digits\nmatched!\pYou've won the jackpot prize!\nYou've won the {STR_VAR_1}!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_NoRoomForThis
source: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\pPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_PrizeWeveBeenHolding
source: {PLAYER}?\nYes, I've been expecting you.\pThis is the prize we've been holding\nfor you.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_1F_Text_PleaseVisitAgain2
source: 欢迎再来。$

label: RadioTower2FBuenaPasswordIsHelpText
source: BUENA: Huh? Today's password?\nHELP, of course!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_SuperNerd
source: You can listen to the radio\nanywhere. Tune in!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_Policeman
source: Restricted access beyond this\npoint.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_Teacher
source: Lullabies on the radio may make\nPOKéMON sleep.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_TeacherRockets
source: Why would they want to take over\nthe RADIO TOWER?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_Jigglypuff
source: JIGGLYPUFF: Jiggly…$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_BlackBelt1
source: Sorry. Authorized personnel only\nbeyond this point.\pIt wasn't that way before.\pThere's something wrong with the\nDIRECTOR…$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_BlackBelt2
source: Feel free to look around anywhere.\pThe DIRECTOR is nice again, just\nas he was before.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntM4Seen
source: Three years ago, TEAM ROCKET was\nforced to disband.\pBut we're making a comeback here!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntM4Beaten
source: Gwah! Don't get cute!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntM4After
source: We won't let you ruin our plans\nfor our comeback!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntM5Seen
source: We're TEAM ROCKET, the exploiters\nof POKéMON!\pWe love being evil! Scared?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntM5Beaten
source: You think you're a hero?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntM5After
source: We're not always evil. We just do\nwhatever we like.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntM6Seen
source: Hey, hey! Keep out of our way!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntM6Beaten
source: Arggh. I give up.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntM6After
source: Our EXECUTIVES are trying to take\nthis place over.\pThey have some big plan. I wonder\nwhat that is?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntF2Seen
source: Hahaha!\pHow boring. It was far too easy\nto take over this place!\pCome on, keep me amused!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntF2Beaten
source: Wh-who are you?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_GruntF2After
source: You beat me, and I won't forget\nit!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_BuenaShowPromo
source: BUENA: Tune in to my PASSWORD\nSHOW!\pListen to find out today's\npassword!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_BuenaAskPassword
source: BUENA: Hi there!\pSo, do you know today's\npassword?\pOK! Which one is it?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_BuenaCorrect
source: BUENA: You got it!\pHere, take this {STR_VAR_1}\nas your prize!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_BuenaWrong
source: BUENA: Bzzt! Too bad!\pTry again tomorrow!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_BuenaComeBack
source: BUENA: No guess?\nCome back when you're ready!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_BuenaAlreadyPlayed
source: BUENA: You already guessed\ntoday's password!\pTune in again tomorrow!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_BuenaBagFull
source: BUENA: You got it right, but\nyour BAG is full!\pMake some room and come\ntalk to me again!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_SalesSign
source: 2F SALES$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_OakTalkSign
source: PROF.OAK'S POKéMON TALK\pThe Hottest Show on the Air!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_2F_Text_PokemonRadioSign
source: Anywhere, Anytime POKéMON Radio$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_CardKeySlot
source: It's the CARD KEY slot.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_InsertedCardKey
source: {PLAYER} inserted the CARD KEY.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_Open
source: The gate is open.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_PersonnelSign
source: 3F PERSONNEL$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_PokemonMusicSign
source: POKéMON MUSIC with Host DJ BEN$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_SuperNerd
source: We have recordings of the cries\nof all POKéMON that have been\lfound.\pWe must have about 400 kinds.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GymGuideRockets
source: To trainers, POKéMON are their\nbeloved partners.\pIt's terrible how TEAM ROCKET is\ntrying to control POKéMON.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GymGuide
source: We run 24 hours a day to broadcast\nentertaining programs.\pI'll do my best to run around the\nclock too!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_CooltrainerFPleaseSave
source: The TEAM ROCKET boss has locked\nhimself in.\pBut the DIRECTOR can open it.\pHe's up on the fifth floor.\pPlease save him!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_CooltrainerFDirectorSafe
source: Is the DIRECTOR safe?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_CooltrainerFHeroGift
source: Thank you! You're my hero!\pThis is a token of my appreciation.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_CooltrainerFSunnyDay
source: It's SUNNY DAY.\pIt powers up fire-type moves\nfor a while.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_CooltrainerFMarvelous
source: You were simply marvelous!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GruntM7Seen
source: I've been given strict orders.\pI'm to crush anyone who challenges\nTEAM ROCKET!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GruntM7Beaten
source: What?!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GruntM7After
source: I failed in my duties…\pARCHER will be so upset...$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GruntM8Seen
source: It feels great ordering POKéMON\nto commit crimes.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GruntM8Beaten
source: You're kidding!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GruntM8After
source: I feel lousy over losing!\pDarn it! I hate useless POKéMON!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GruntM9Seen
source: Why did the shutter open? Did you\nhave something to do with this?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GruntM9Beaten
source: I'm done for!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_GruntM9After
source: What?! You made it past our men in\nthe UNDERGROUND?\pHow could you?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_ScientistMarcSeen
source: An unknown child wandering here?\pWho are you?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_ScientistMarcBeaten
source: Tch! I took you too lightly!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_3F_Text_ScientistMarcAfter
source: Bwahahaha…\pI can transmit as strong a signal\nas I need from here.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_Proton_Seen
source:
PROTON: Now wait just one second!\pAren't you the one who got in our
way at SLOWPOKE WELL?\pI see... You're doing all this
because you want to make me angry.\lBe careful!\pBut since you seem to wish it, I'll
show you the full extent of a TEAM\lROCKET EXECUTIVE's wrath!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_Proton_Beaten
source: Phew...$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_Proton_After
source: PROTON: You may have won this\ntime... But all you did was make\pTEAM ROCKET's wrath grow.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_Fisher
source: I listened to the radio while I was\nat the RUINS.\pI heard a strange broadcast there.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_DJMary
source: MARY: Why? Why do I have to suffer\nthrough this?\pMEOWTH, help me!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_DJMaryCleared
source: MARY: Oh! You're my little savior!\pWill you take this as my thanks?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_DJMaryPinkBow
source: MARY: It's good for dodging the\nenemy's attacks.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_DJMaryAfter
source: MARY: Please tune into me on PROF.\nOAK'S POKéMON TALK show!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_Meowth
source: MEOWTH: Meowth…$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_GruntM10Seen
source: You plan to rescue the DIRECTOR?\pThat won't be possible because I'm\ngoing to beat you!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_GruntM10Beaten
source: No! Unbelievable!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_GruntM10After
source: I don't believe it! I was beaten!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_ExecutiveM2Seen
source: Stop! I'm known as the TEAM ROCKET\nfortress!\pYou're not taking another step!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_ExecutiveM2Beaten
source: The fortress came down!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_ExecutiveM2After
source: You've earned my respect, so here's\nsome advice.\pIt's not too late. You can still turn\nback.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_GruntF4Seen
source: Don't I think POKéMON are cute?\pI'll think my POKéMON are cute--\pafter they beat yours!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_GruntF4Beaten
source: Oh, no! They're so useless!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_GruntF4After
source: I love my beautiful self!\pWho cares about POKéMON?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_ScientistRichSeen
source: Most excellent.\pThis RADIO TOWER will fulfill our\ngrand design.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_ScientistRichBeaten
source: Hmmm…\pAll grand plans come with snags.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_ScientistRichAfter
source: Do you honestly believe you can stop\nTEAM ROCKET?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_ProductionSign
source: 4F PRODUCTION$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_4F4_Text_Studio2Sign
source: 4F STUDIO 2$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_FakeDirector1
source: Y-you! You came to rescue me?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_FakeDirector2
source:
Is that what you were expecting?\pWrong! I'm an imposter!\pI pretended to be the real thing to
prepare for our takeover.\pDo you want to know where we hid
the real DIRECTOR?\pSure, I'll tell you. But only if you
can beat me!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_FakeDirectorWin
source: OK, OK. I'll tell you where he is.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_FakeDirectorAfter
source:
The boss stashed the DIRECTOR in
the UNDERGROUND WAREHOUSE.\pIt's at the far end of the UNDER-
GROUND.\pI am a nice guy, I will give you
the BASEMENT KEY to get to the\lUNDERGROUND WAREHOUSE.\pBut I doubt you'll get that far.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_FakeDirectorAfter2
source:
The boss stashed the DIRECTOR in
the UNDERGROUND WAREHOUSE.\pIt's at the far end of the UNDER-
GROUND.\pYou can use the BASEMENT KEY to
get to the UNDERGROUND WAREHOUSE.\pBut I doubt you'll get that far.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_ExecutiveF1Seen
source: Remember me from the HIDEOUT in\nMAHOGANY TOWN?\pMy boss scolded me but I'm stronger.\pI lost then, but I won't this time.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_ExecutiveF1Beaten
source: This can't be happening!\pI fought hard, but I still lost…\pI'm so sorry GIOVANNI…$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_ExecutiveF1After
source: {PLAYER}, isn't it?\pA brat like you won't appreciate\nthe magnificence of TEAM ROCKET.\pThat's too bad. I really admire\nyour power.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_RocketBossSeen
source:
Oh? You managed to get this far?\pYou must be quite the trainer.\pWe intend to take over this RADIO
STATION and announce our comeback.\pThat should bring our boss GIOVANNI
back from his solitary training.\pWe are going to regain our former
glory...\pI won't allow you to interfere with
our meticulous plans!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_RocketBossBeaten
source: No! Forgive me, GIOVANNI!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_RocketBossAfter
source: How could this be?\pOur dreams have come to naught.\pI wasn't up to the task after all.\pLike GIOVANNI did before me, I will\ndisband TEAM ROCKET here today.\pFarewell.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_DirectorThanks
source: DIRECTOR: {PLAYER}, thank you!\pYour courageous actions have saved\nPOKéMON nationwide.\pI know it's not much, but please\ntake this.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_DirectorClearWingExplanation
source:
There used to be a tower right here
in GOLDENROD CITY.\pBut it was old and creaky.\pSo we replaced it with our RADIO
TOWER.\pWe dug up that wing during
construction.\pI heard that all sorts of POKéMON
lived in GOLDENROD in the past.\pPerhaps…\pThat wing has some connection to the
TIN TOWER in ECRUTEAK CITY…\pOK, I better go to my OFFICE.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_DirectorTidalWingExplanation
source:
There used to be a tower right here
in GOLDENROD CITY.\pBut it was old and creaky.\pSo we replaced it with our RADIO
TOWER.\pWe dug up that wing during
construction.\pI heard that all sorts of POKéMON
lived in GOLDENROD in the past.\pPerhaps…\pThat wing has some connection to the
WHIRL ISLANDS near CIANWOOD CITY…\pOK, I better go to my OFFICE.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_DirectorLegendary
source:
Ah!\pThat reminds me…\pThat wing I gave you... I think
it's related to the LEGENDARY\lPOKéMON.\pBut! The LEGENDARY POKéMON won't
appear with just that wing...\pApparently there is something else
you need... Or something like that.\pI wonder what it was...\pI can't remember.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_DirectorFakeout
source: Are you expecting something?\nThis is what they call FAKE OUT.\pI really must go back to my OFFICE\nthis time. See ya!$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_DirectorIntro
source: DIRECTOR: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pYou know, I love POKéMON.\pI built this RADIO TOWER so I could\nexpress my love of POKéMON.\pIt would be nice if people enjoyed\nour programs.$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_Ben
source: BEN: Do you listen to our music?$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_DirectorOfficeSign
source: 5F DIRECTOR'S   OFFICE$

label: GoldenrodCity_RadioTower_5F_Text_Studio1Sign
source: 5F STUDIO 1$

label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerTrainHasntComeIn
source: The train hasn't come in…\pI know! I'll carry the passengers\non my back!\pThat won't work.$

label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerRightThisWay
source: May I see your rail PASS, please?\pOK. Right this way, please.$

label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation_Text_OfficerNoRailPass
source: Sorry. You don't have a rail PASS.$

label: GoldenrodMagnetTrainStation_Text_GentlemanPresident
source: I'm the PRESIDENT.\pMy dream was to build a train that\nis faster than any POKéMON.\pIt really brings JOHTO much closer\nto KANTO.$

label: GoldenrodCity_TrainStation_Text_Boy
source: You brought the MAGNET TRAIN PASS,\nright?$

label: GoldenrodCity_TrainStation_Text_Psychic
source: I thought you had it!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground1_Text_SuperNerd
source: I was challenged to a battle\ndownstairs.\pIt's rough down there. You'd\nbetter be careful.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground1_Text_Teacher
source: There are some shops downstairs…\nBut there are also trainers.\pI'm scared to go down there.$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_GruntM24Seen
source: How did you get this far?\pI guess it can't be helped. I'll\ndispose of you.$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_GruntM24Beaten
source: I got disposed of…$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_GruntM24After
source: TEAM ROCKET will keep going, waiting\nfor the return of GIOVANNI.\pWe'll do whatever it takes.$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_GruntM14Seen
source: You're not going any farther!\pI don't show mercy to my enemies,\nnot even brats!$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_GruntM14Beaten
source: Blast it!$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_GruntM14After
source: I lost…\pPlease forgive me, GIOVANNI!$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_GruntM15Seen
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! Look who it is!\pReady? I'm really tough now!$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_GruntM15Beaten
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! You're so good!\pThis TEAM ROCKET thing is just\na job, but I can see it hurts others.\pThat's it, I'm leaving.\pThank you so much. Sorry GIOVANNI!$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_GruntM15After
source: Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck! That was a blast!\nI'll remember you!$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_DirectorIntro
source: DIRECTOR: Who? What? You came to\nrescue me?\pThank you!\pThe RADIO TOWER!\pWhat's happening there?\pTaken over by TEAM ROCKET?\pHere. Take this CARD KEY.$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_DirectorCardKey
source: DIRECTOR: Use that to open the\nshutters on 3F.$

label: RadioTowerBasement_Text_DirectorAfter
source: I'm begging you to help.\pThere's no telling what they'll do if\nthey control the transmitter.\pThey may even be able to control\nPOKéMON using a special signal!\pYou're the only one I can call on.\pPlease save the RADIO TOWER…\pAnd all the POKéMON nationwide!$

label: GoldenrodCity_UndergroundSwitches_EventScript_AntiSoftLock_Text
source: You may be stuck.\pGo back to the entrance\nand reset switches?$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SilverBefore
source:
Hold it!\pI saw you, so I tailed you.\pI don't need you underfoot while I
take care of TEAM ROCKET.\p…Wait a second. You beat me before,
didn't you?\pThat was just a fluke.\pI've been training my team and now
I will repay my debts!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SilverWin
source: …Why… Why do I lose?\pI've assembled the toughest POKéMON.\pI didn't ease up on the gas.\pSo why do I lose?$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SilverAfter
source: …I don't understand…\pIs what that LANCE guy said true?\pThat I don't treat POKéMON properly?\pLove…\pTrust…\pAre they really what I lack?\pAre they keeping me from winning?\pI… I just don't understand.\pBut it's not going to end here.\pNot now. Not because of this.\pI won't give up my dream of becoming\nthe world's best POKéMON trainer!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SilverLoss
source: Humph. This is my real power, wimp.\pI'll make TEAM ROCKET history.\pAnd I'm going to grind that LANCE\nunder my heels.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntM11Seen
source: Open one shutter, another closes.\pBet you can't get where you want!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntM11Beaten
source: Drat! I was sunk by indecision!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntM11After
source: I'm confused too… The switch on the\nend is the one to press first, but…$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntM25Seen
source: Kwahaha!\pConfounded by the shutters, are we?\pI'll let you in on a secret if you\ncan beat me!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntM25Beaten
source: Uwww… I blew it.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntM25After
source: All right. A hint!\pChange the order of switching.\pThat'll change the ways the shutters\nopen and close.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_BurglarDuncanSeen
source: Fork over your goodies!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_BurglarDuncanBeaten
source: Mercy!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_BurglarDuncanAfter
source: Steal and sell! That's basic in\ncrime, kid!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_BurglarEddieSeen
source: They ditched this project before they\nfinished.\pI'm searching for leftover loot.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_BurglarEddieBeaten
source: Over the top!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_BurglarEddieAfter
source: UNDERGROUND WAREHOUSE?\pWhat do you want to go there for?\pThere's nothing down there.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntM13Seen
source: I don't care if you're lost.\pYou show up here, you're nothing but\na victim!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntM13Beaten
source: Urk! Yeah, think you're cool, huh?$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntM13After
source: You must have ice in your veins to\ndiss TEAM ROCKET.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntF3Seen
source: Are you lost? No, you can't be.\pYou don't have that scared look.\pI'll give you something to be\nscared about!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntF3Beaten
source: How could you?$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_GruntF3After
source: Go wherever you'd like! Get lost!\nSee if I care!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_Switch1
source: SWITCH 1 activated.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_Switch2
source: SWITCH 2 activated.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_Switch3
source: SWITCH 3 activated.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_Switch1Off
source: SWITCH 1 deactivated.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_Switch2Off
source: SWITCH 2 deactivated.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_Switch3Off
source: SWITCH 3 deactivated.$

label: GoldenrodCity_UndergroundTunnel_Text_Kimono1
source:
Team Rocket members in black suits
have been running around...\pI was wondering what was going on.
So, you took on Team Rocket?\lYou are impressive!\pYou may be able to face the
legendary POKé...$

label: GoldenrodCity_UndergroundTunnel_Text_Kimono2
source: Hahaha! Never mind.\nI must go now.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_YoungerBrotherOffer
source: Welcome to the POKéMON SALON!\pI'm the younger and less expensive\nof the two HAIRCUT BROTHERS.\pI'll spiff up your POKéMON for just\n¥300.\pSo? How about it?$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_YoungerBrotherAskWhich
source: OK, which POKéMON should I do?$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_YoungerBrotherLookCool
source: OK! I'll make it look cool!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_YoungerBrotherAllDone
source: There we go! All done!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_YoungerBrotherDisappointed
source: No? How disappointing!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_YoungerBrotherShortOnFunds
source: You're a little short on funds.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_YoungerBrotherOnePerDay
source: I can do only one haircut a day.\pSorry, but I'm all done for today.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_OlderBrotherOffer
source: Welcome!\pI run the POKéMON SALON!\pI'm the older and better of the two\nHAIRCUT BROTHERS.\pI can make your POKéMON beautiful\nfor just ¥500.\pWould you like me to do that?$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_OlderBrotherAskWhich
source: Which POKéMON should I work on?$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_OlderBrotherWatchItBeautiful
source: OK! Watch it become beautiful!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_OlderBrotherAllDone
source: There! All done!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_OlderBrotherThatsAShame
source: Is that right? That's a shame!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_OlderBrotherNeedMoreMoney
source: You'll need more money than that.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_OlderBrotherOnePerDay
source: I do only one haircut a day.\nI'm done for today.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SupernerdEricSeen
source: I got booted out of the GAME CORNER.\pI was trying to cheat using my\nPOKéMON…$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SupernerdEricBeaten
source: …Grumble…$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SupernerdEricAfterBattle
source: I guess I have to do things fair and\nsquare…$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SupernerdTeruSeen
source: Do you consider type alignments in\nbattle?\pIf you know your type advantages,\nyou'll do better in battle.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SupernerdTeruBeaten
source: Ow, ow, ow!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_SupernerdTeruAfterBattle
source: I know my POKéMON type alignments.\pBut I only use one type of POKéMON.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_PokemaniacIssacSeen
source: My POKéMON just got a haircut!\pI'll show you how strong it is!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_PokemaniacIssacBeaten
source: Aiyeeee!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_PokemaniacIssacAfterBattle
source: Your POKéMON will like you more if\nyou give them haircuts.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_PokemaniacDonaldSeen
source: I think you have some rare POKéMON\nwith you.\pLet me see them!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_PokemaniacDonaldBeaten
source: Gaah! I lost! That makes me mad!$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_PokemaniacDonaldAfterBattle
source: When I was walking near the BIKE\nSHOP last night, I felt like I was\lbeing watched from the rooftops...$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_PokemaniacDonaldAfterBattleOld
source:
Are you making a POKéDEX? Here's a
hot tip.\pThe HIKER on ROUTE 33, ANTHONY, is a
good guy.\pHe'll phone you if he sees any rare
POKéMON.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_DoorsLocked
source: The door's locked…$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_DoorIsOpen
source: The door is open.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_KeyOpenedDoor
source: The BASEMENT KEY opened the door.$

label: GoldenrodUnderground_Text_NoEntry
source: NO ENTRY BEYOND THIS POINT$

label: IcePath_1F_Text_Stuck1
source:
Me oh my... Is that you, {PLAYER}?
Fancy meeting you here!\pTo tell the truth... my sandals are
frozen on the ice, and I am stuck.\pIn other words, my flip-flops are
quick-frozen to the ground.\pTee hee.\pWell, it's no laughing matter.\pWould you come around and push
my back?$

label: IcePath_1F_Text_Stuck2
source:
Me oh my... Is that you, {PLAYER}?
Fancy meeting you here!\pTo tell the truth... my sandals are
frozen on the ice, and I am stuck.\pIn other words, my flip-flops are
quick-frozen with the ground.\pTee hee.\pWell, it's no laughing matter.
Would you push my back?$

label: IcePath_1F_Text_Cruel
source: Don't be so cruel.\nYou will push my back, won't you?$

label: IcePath_1F_Text_Thanks
source: You really are kind.\nThank you so much!$

label: IcePath_B1F_Text_PuzzleSkipButton
source: Would you like to skip this\npuzzle?$

label: IcePath_B1F_Text_Sign
source: DANGER CRACKED ICE\nGO FAST ON BICYCLE\lSWITCH GEARS BY\lPRESSING ...\lThe sign is faded...$

label: IcePath_B3F_Text_Swinub
source: SWINUB: Swiiiiii!$

label: IcePath_B3F_Text_SwinubBerry
source: Give the SWINUB a BERRY?$

label: IcePath_B3F_Text_SwinubAteBerry
source: SWINUB enjoyed the ASPEAR BERRY!$

label: IcePath_B3F_Text_SwinubTurnedAway
source: SWINUB doesn't like it!$

label: IcePath_B3F_Text_Delibird
source: DELIBIRD: SKWAAAAA!$

label: IcePath_B3F_Text_DelibirdBerry
source: Give the DELIBIRD a BERRY?$

label: IcePath_B3F_Text_DelibirdAteBerry
source: DELIBIRD enjoyed the ASPEAR BERRY!$

label: IcePath_B3F_Text_DelibirdTurnedAway
source: DELIBIRD doesn't like it!$

label: IlexForest_Text_ApprenticeIntro
source:
Oh, man… My boss is going to be
steaming…\pThe FARFETCH'D that CUTS trees
for charcoal took off on me.\pI can't go looking for it here
in the ILEX FOREST.\pIt's too big, dark and scary
for me…$

label: IlexForest_Text_ApprenticeAfter
source: Wow! Thanks a whole bunch!\pMy boss' POKéMON won't obey me\nbecause I don't have a BADGE.$

label: IlexForest_Text_ItsTheMissingPokemon
source: It's the missing POKéMON!$

label: IlexForest_Text_Kwaaaa
source: FARFETCH'D: Kwaa!$

label: IlexForest_Text_CharcoalMasterIntro
source: Ah! My FARFETCH'D!\pYou found it for us, kid?\pWithout it, we wouldn't be able\nto CUT trees for charcoal.\pThanks, kid!\pNow, how can I thank you…\pI know! Here, take this.$

label: IlexForest_Text_CharcoalMasterOutro
source: That's the CUT HM.\nTeach that to a POKéMON to clear\lsmall trees.\pOf course, you have to have the\nGYM BADGE from AZALEA to use it.$

label: IlexForest_Text_CharcoalMasterTalkAfter
source: Do you want to apprentice as a\ncharcoal maker with me?\pYou'll be first-rate in ten years!$

label: IlexForest_Text_Lass
source: Did something happen to the\nforest's guardian?$

label: IlexForest_Text_Signpost
source: ILEX FOREST is so overgrown with\ntrees that you can't see the sky.\pPlease watch out for items that may\nhave been dropped.$

label: IlexForest_Text_Shrine
source: ILEX FOREST SHRINE…\pIt's in honor of the forest's\nprotector…$

label: IlexForest_Text_ShrineCelebiEvent
source: ILEX FOREST SHRINE…\pIt's in honor of the forest's\nprotector…\pOh? What is this?\pIt's a hole.\nIt looks like the GS BALL would fit\linside it.\pWant to put the GS BALL here?$

label: IlexForest_Text_InsertGSBall
source: {PLAYER} put in the GS BALL.$

label: IlexForest_Text_KurtCaughtCelebi
source: Whew, wasn't that something!\p{PLAYER}, that was fantastic. Thanks!\pThe legends about that SHRINE were\nreal after all.\pI feel inspired by what I just saw.\pIt motivates me to make better BALLS!\pI'm going!$

label: IlexForest_Text_BugCatcherWayneSeen
source: Don't sneak up on me like that!\pYou frightened a POKéMON away!$

label: IlexForest_Text_BugCatcherWayneBeaten
source: I hadn't seen that POKéMON before…$

label: IlexForest_Text_BugCatcherWayneAfter
source: A POKéMON I've never seen before\nfell out of the tree when I used\lHEADBUTT.\pI ought to use HEADBUTT in other\nplaces too.$

label: IlexForest_Text_Kimono_Girl1
source: KIMONO GIRL, KIMONO GIRL, lost and\nall alone. Poor girl lost in the\ldark ILEX FOREST.$

label: IlexForest_Text_Kimono_Girl2
source: You remember me from VIOLET CITY?\nYou must be imagining.\pAnyway, will you show me how to\nget out of this forest?$

label: IlexForest_Text_Kimono_Girl3
source: Me oh my... You are lost yourself,\naren't you?$

label: IlexForest_Text_Kimono_Girl4
source: Wow! Are you going to show me how\nto get out?\pYou are such a smart POKéMON!$

label: IlexForest_Text_Kimono_Girl5
source: See you.$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_Sign
source: INDIGO PLATEAU\pThe Ultimate Goal for Trainers!\pPOKéMON LEAGUE HQ$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_ShigyNinja
source: Congrats on making it here!\pI've seen tons of trainers come\nthrough here over the years, and\lall of them are wonderfully unique.\pYou should be proud of yourself\nfor getting this far!\pNow, go get 'em!$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_Blackbelt
source: The POKéMON LEAGUE is not taking\nnew challengers at the moment.\pPlease check back later.$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_CooltrainerM
source: At the POKéMON LEAGUE, you'll get\ntested by the ELITE FOUR.\pYou have to beat them all. If you\nlose, you have to start all over!$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_RivalEntrance1
source:
Hold it.\pYou're going to take the POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge now?\pThat's not going to happen.\pMy super-well-trained POKéMON
are going to pound you.\p{PLAYER}!
I challenge you!$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_RivalWin
source: …\pOK--I lost…$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_RivalAfter
source: …Darn… I still can't win…\pI… I have to think more about my\nPOKéMON…\pHumph! Try not to lose!$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_TeleportGuy1
source: Ah! You're challenging the ELITE\nFOUR? Are you sure you're ready?\pIf you need to train some more,\nmy ABRA can help you.\pIt can TELEPORT you home.\pWould you like to go home now?$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_TeleportGuyYes
source: OK, OK. Picture your house in your\nmind…$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_TeleportGuyNo
source: OK, OK. The best of luck to you!$

label: IndigoPlateau_Text_Abra
source: ABRA: Aabra…$

label: LakeOfRageLowTide_Text_Sage
source: This cave contains a POKéMON\ntoo strong for an ordinary\ltrainer.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_Pryce
source: {PLAYER}.\pEven here, the cold keeps me sharp.\pIf you wish to battle again, come\nto the FIGHTING DOJO.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_Dragonite
source: DRAGONITE: Gyafooha!$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_LanceForcedToEvolve
source: This lake is full of GYARADOS\nbut nothing else…\pSo the MAGIKARP are being forced\nto evolve…$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_LanceIntro1
source: Did you come here because of\nthe rumors?\pYou're {PLAYER}? I'm LANCE, a\ntrainer like you.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_LanceIntro2
source: This man here informed me of\nsome rumors.\pSo we came to investigate…$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_LanceIntro3
source:
I saw the way you battled
earlier, {PLAYER}.\pI can tell that you're a trainer
with considerable skill.\pIf you don't mind, could you help
us investigate?$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_LanceRadioSignal
source:
LANCE: Excellent!\pIt seems that the LAKE's MAGIKARP
are being forced to evolve.\pA mysterious radio broadcast
coming from MAHOGANY is the cause.\pWe'll be waiting for you,
{PLAYER}.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_LanceRefused
source: Oh… Well, if you change your mind,\nplease help us.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_LanceAskHelp
source: LANCE: Hm? Are you going to help\nus?$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_GyaradosCry
source: GYARADOS: Gyashaa!$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_Gramps
source: The GYARADOS are angry!\pIt's a bad omen!$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_GrampsCleared
source: Hahah! The MAGIKARP are biting!$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_SuperNerd
source: I heard this lake was made by\nrampaging GYARADOS.\pI wonder if there is any\nconnection to their mass outbreak\lnow?$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainerF
source: Did my eyes deceive me? I saw a\nred GYARADOS in the LAKE…\pBut I thought GYARADOS were\nusually blue?$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_FisherAndreSeen
source: Let me battle with the POKéMON I\njust caught!$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_FisherAndreBeaten
source: I might be an expert angler, but\nI stink as a POKéMON trainer…$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_FisherAndreAfter
source: I won't lose as an angler! I catch\nPOKéMON all day.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_FisherRaymondSeen
source: No matter what I do, all I catch\nare the same POKéMON…$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_FisherRaymondBeaten
source: My line's all tangled up…$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_FisherRaymondAfter
source: Why can't I catch any good\nPOKéMON?$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainermAaronSeen
source: If a trainer spots another trainer,\nhe has to make a challenge.\pThat is our destiny.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainermAaronBeaten
source: Whew… Good battle.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainermAaronAfter
source: POKéMON and their trainer become\npowerful through constant battling.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainerfLoisSeen
source: What happened to the red\nGYARADOS?\pIt's gone?\pOh, darn. I came here for\nnothing?\pI know--let's battle!$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainerfLoisBeaten
source: Good going!$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_CooltrainerfLoisAfter
source: Come to think of it, I've seen a\npink BUTTERFREE.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_MeetWesley
source: WESLEY: Well, how do you do?\pI'm a member of the WEEKDAY family!\nCan you guess my favorite day?$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_WesleyGivesGift
source: Pleased to meet you. Please take a\nsouvenir.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_WesleyGaveGift
source: WESLEY: BLACK BELT beefs up the\npower of fighting moves.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_WesleyWednesday
source: WESLEY: Since you found me, you\nmust have met my brothers and\lsisters.\pOr did you just get lucky?$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_WesleyNotWednesday
source: WESLEY: Not exactly...$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_Sign
source: LAKE OF RAGE,\nalso known as GYARADOS LAKE.$

label: LakeOfRage_Text_FishingGuruSign
source: FISHING GURU'S HOUSE$

label: HiddenPowerGuy_Text_Intro
source: …You have strayed far…\pHere I have meditated. Inside me,\na new power has been awakened.\pLet me share my power with your\nPOKéMON. Take this, child.$

label: HiddenPowerGuy_Text_Explanation
source: Do you see it? It is HIDDEN POWER!\pIt draws out the power of POKéMON\nfor attacking.\pRemember this: its type and power\ndepend on the POKéMON using it.$

label: HiddenPowerGuy_Text_Meditating
source: I am meditating…$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_LakeHistory
source:
LAKE OF RAGE is actually a crater
made by rampaging GYARADOS.\pThe crater filled up with rainwater
and the LAKE was formed.\pThat's the story passed on from my
Grandpa's great-great-grandpa.\pIt used to be that you could catch
lively MAGIKARP there, but…\pI don't understand what's happening.$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_MenInBlack
source: The LAKE hasn't been normal since\nthose men wearing black arrived.$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_LastMon
source: Well don't let me take your last\nPOKéMON!$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_WorldsLargest
source: LAKE OF RAGE is back to normal.\pThe MAGIKARP have returned.\pI may yet realize my dream of own-\ning the world's largest MAGIKARP.\pIn fact... I'll pay you ¥2000 for\nevery MAGIKARP you give me, and\l¥100,000 for a HUGE MAGIKARP!$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_ForMe
source: So... Do you have a MAGIKARP for\nme?$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_HaveMagikarp
source: Ah, you have a MAGIKARP! Let's\nsee how big that baby is.$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_BigPayout
source: Wow! This one is outstanding!\pI tip my hat to you!\pHere's a little something for your\ntrouble.$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_Bonus
source: The record is the important thing.\pThink of that as a bonus!$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_TooShort
source: Wow! This one is outstanding!\p…I wish I could say that, but I've\nseen a bigger one before.\pI guess it's worth something.$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_NotMagikarp
source: What? That's not a MAGIKARP!$

label: LakeOfRage_House2_Text_Refused
source: Oh… So you didn't get one good\nenough to show me? Maybe next time.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEveryDay
source: I bathe in the hot springs every day.\pI want to become a beautiful and strong\nGYM LEADER like FLANNERY.$

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign
source: LAVARIDGE TOWN\p“POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS\nAn excellent place for relaxing!”$

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
source:
Oh…
I guess I was trying too hard…\pI… I've only recently become
a GYM LEADER.\pI tried too hard to be someone
I'm not.\pI have to do things my natural way. If
I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.\pThanks for teaching me that.
For that, you deserve this.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_TownKnownAsMonGraveSite
source: This town is known as the grave\nsite of POKéMON.\pMemorial services are held in\nPOKéMON TOWER.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_PokefanM
source: That's quite some building, eh?\pIt's KANTO's RADIO TOWER.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_Teacher
source: KANTO has many good radio shows.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_Gramps
source: People come from all over to pay\ntheir respects to the departed\lsouls of POKéMON.$

label: LavenderTown_Text_Youngster
source: You need a POKé FLUTE to wake\nsleeping POKéMON.\pEvery trainer has to know that!$

label: LavenderTown_Text_Sign
source: LAVENDER TOWN\pThe Noble Purple Town$

label: LavenderTown_Text_KantoRadioStationSign
source: KANTO RADIO STATION\pYour Favorite Programs On-Air\nAround the Clock!$

label: LavenderTown_Text_VolunteerPokemonHouseSign
source: LAVENDER VOLUNTEER POKéMON\nHOUSE$

label: LavenderTown_Text_SoulHouseSign
source: SOUL HOUSE\pMay the Souls of POKéMON Rest\nEasy$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_Girl
source: Can you believe it?\pSome people get bored with taking\ncare of POKéMON.\pGRANPDA takes in such poor homeless\nPOKéMON and takes care of them.$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_Guy
source: MR. FUJI does live here but he's\naway now. He should be at the\lSOUL HOUSE.$

label: LavenderTown_House1_Text_Marowak2
source: The MAROWAK is quiet, though it\nappears quite happy.$

label: LavenderSpeechHouse_Text_PokefanF
source: LAVENDER is a tiny, quiet town at\nthe foot of the mountains.\pIt's gotten a bit busier since\nthe RADIO TOWER was built.$

label: LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SoldNuggetFromMountainsFor5000
source: この　あいだ　やまおくで\nきんのたまを　ひろい　ましてね！\pつかえない　しなもの　ですが\nうったら　なんと　5000¥でした$

label: LavenderMart_Text_PokefanM
source: REPEL is a necessity if you are\ngoing to explore a cave.\pEven though I like exploring,\nI still haven't made it to all\lthe caves.$

label: LavenderMart_Text_Rocker
source: I heard about a craftsman who\nmakes custom BALLS in the JOHTO\ltown of AZALEA.\pI wish I had some.$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Gentleman
source: To the north of LAVENDER is ROCK\nTUNNEL. Go through it to get to\lthe POWER PLANT.$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Teacher
source:
There's a radio program that plays
POKé FLUTE music.\pOh? Ah, your radio needs a RADIO
UPGRADE to tune into it.\pMaybe the RADIO STATION here
in town can provide you one?$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Youngster
source: If the POWER PLANT isn't running,\nthe MAGNET TRAIN won't run either…\pIt also means the RADIO STATION\ncan't broadcast…$

label: LavenderTown_PokemonCenter1F_Text_Youngster_ReturnedMachinePart
source: The DIRECTOR of the RADIO STATION\nsure was happy.\pHe said they're back on the air\nbecause the POWER PLANT is running\lsmoothly again.$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Receptionist
source: Welcome! Feel free to look around\nanywhere on this floor.$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Officer
source: Sorry, but you can only tour the\nground floor.\pEver since JOHTO's RADIO TOWER\nwas taken over by a criminal gang,\lwe have had to step up our\lsecurity.$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_SuperNerd1
source: Many people are hard at work here\nin the RADIO TOWER.\pThey must be doing their best to\nput on good shows.$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Gentleman
source: Oh, no, no, no!\pWe've been off the air ever since\nthe POWER PLANT shut down.\pAll my efforts to start this\nstation would be wasted if I can't\lbroadcast.\pI'll be ruined!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Gentleman_ReturnedMachinePart
source:
Ah! So you're the {PLAYER} who
solved the POWER PLANT's problem?\pThanks to you, I never lost my
job.\pI tell you, you're a real
lifesaver!\pPlease take this as my thanks.$

label: LavendertownRadioStation_Text_Upgraded_Radio
source: {PLAYER} obtained the\nRADIO UPGRADE!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Gentleman_GotExpnCard
source: With that thing, you can tune into\nthe radio programs here in KANTO.\pGahahahaha!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_SuperNerd2
source: Hey there!\pI am the super MUSIC DIRECTOR!\p

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_SuperNerd2
source: my music programs. How unfortunate!\pIf you get an EXPN CARD upgrade,\nyou can tune in. You'd better get\lone!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_SuperNerd2_GotExpnCard
source: Hey there!\pI am the super MUSIC DIRECTOR!\pI'm responsible for the gorgeous\nmelodies that go out over the air.\pDon't be square. Grab your music\noff the air!$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_Directory
source: 1F RECEPTION 2F SALES\p3F PERSONNEL 4F PRODUCTION\p5F DIRECTOR'S OFFICE$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_PokeFluteSign
source: Perk Up POKéMON with Mellow\nSounds of the POKé FLUTE on\lCHANNEL 20$

label: LavenderTown_RadioStation_Text_ReferenceLibrary
source: Wow! A full rack of POKéMON CDs\nand videos.\pThis must be the reference\nlibrary.$

label: MrFuji_Text_Main
source:
MR.FUJI: Welcome.\pHmm… You appear to be raising
your POKéMON in a kind and\lloving manner.\pPOKéMON lovers come here to pay
their respects to departed\lPOKéMON.\pPlease offer condolences for the
souls of the departed POKéMON.\pI'm sure that will make them
happy.$

label: SoulHouse_Text_Teacher
source: There are other graves of POKéMON\nhere, I think.\pThere are many chambers that only\nMR.FUJI may enter.$

label: SoulHouse_Text_Lass
source: I came with my mom to visit\nPOKéMON graves…$

label: SoulHouse_Text_Granny
source: The POKéMON that lived with me…\pI loved them like my\ngrandchildren…$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBadges
source: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do?\pCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\pWell, while you're collecting BADGES,\n{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm going to work on my\lPOKéDEX. I'll complete it before you!\pSee you!$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign
source: LILYCOVE CITY\p“Where the land ends and the\nsea begins.”$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokeblocks
source: People have to work together to get it\nto spin faster.\pThe faster you can make it spin, the\nbetter {POKEBLOCK}S you can get, I've heard.$

label: LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender
source: It's used for making a kind of candy\ncalled a {POKEBLOCK}.\pIf you give a good {POKEBLOCK} to a POKéMON,\nits condition will improve by a lot.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
source: That young man who won earlier had\na whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.\pCan you win if you had that many\nof those things?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest_hns
source: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST\nhere before.\pWell, guess what? Today, I made it\nwin a SMARTNESS CONTEST!\pMy abilities scare even me…$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests_hns
source:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS,
so I'm seeing how things work.\pIf you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST,
cool moves go over as appeals.\pBut smart moves and cute moves
don't go over well, for instance.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks_hns
source: That young man who won earlier had\na whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.\pCan you win if you had that many\nof those things?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous_hns
source: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!\pThe tension in the air… It's not\nlike a CONTEST hall in the sticks.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal_hns
source: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their\nTRAINERS, are you ready?!\pGive it your best showing!\nLet's appeal!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest_hns
source: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?\pCome back with three friends, and\nall of you may enter a CONTEST!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest_hns
source:
Ayayayay…
I entered the wrong CONTEST.\pI entered this tough POKéMON in
the SMARTNESS CONTEST…\pCome on, wow them with a smart-looking
ROCK SMASH.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart_hns
source: I've spent many a year, and all my\nwisdom besides, raising this POKéMON\lto be smart.\pIt won't be easily bested by some\nyoung pup's POKéMON.\pMy dear wife, are you seeing this?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext_hns
source: There it is!\pIf my POKéMON pulls a smart move next,\nthe audience's excitement will peak!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife_hns
source: Oh, dear, no!\pMy darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so\ncute I kept using it over and over!\pBut these mean people don't appreciate\nit at all!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_YoureBeautifulGrandpa_hns
source: Kiyaaah! You're beautiful, Grandpa!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves_hns
source: Even when TRAINERS enter the same\nkind of POKéMON, they all seem to use\ldifferent moves for appeals.\pIt's just like the way people have\ndifferent styles for battling.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSmarterThanTrainers_hns
source: I think the POKéMON look smarter\nthan their TRAINERS. By a lot.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests_hns
source: When all's said and done, I still love\nSMARTNESS CONTESTS.\pThat intellectual green color…\nIt's so… So… Cool.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnteringBeautyContest_hns
source: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY\nCONTEST, too? Good luck!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty_hns
source: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is\na model of pristine beauty!\pWhy, I almost forgot to score them!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty_hns
source: A POKéMON this beautiful…\nThere isn't another one like it.\pEveryone's eyes will be glued to\nmy beauty.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming_hns
source: Waaaah!\pI brushed and groomed my POKéMON\ncarefully for this CONTEST…\pBut I overdid it…\nMy POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…\pWhat should I do?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam_hns
source: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling,\nthe JUDGE won't be able to see it.\pUh, wait a second…\nThat'll be meaningless, then!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe_hns
source: This pretty POKéMON looks just like\nme when I was younger.\pRight when I said that, my husband\nspewed the coffee he was drinking.\pDid I say something funny?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyContestMakesMeHappy_hns
source: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY\nCONTEST, sure it makes me\lhappy. More than usual, anyway.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon_hns
source: Wahahahah!\pWill you take a gander at all those\npretty POKéMON!\lI just love this sort of glitz!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone_hns
source: You can't always win on just beauty\nalone.\pYou have to groom your POKéMON so\nit's nice and glossy like mine.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest_hns
source: MC: Uh-oh! Hello!\nWe're in the middle of a CONTEST!\pPlease enter at our registration\ncounter and come out, okay?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals_hns
source: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute\nappeals!\pOh, my goodness! What a perfectly\nadorable WATER SPORT appeal!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillWasDistracted_hns
source: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was\ndistracted by another POKéMON.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBattleButContest_hns
source: My POKéMON has never won in a battle,\nbut put it in a CONTEST and look out!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel_hns
source: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel\nof elegance.\pI won't let anyone disturb its\nperformance.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter_hns
source: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.\pHowever, if my POKéMON were to make\na cute appeal…\pI'm sure that it would be so much \ncuter than the others.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsInContest_hns
source: My child is in this CONTEST.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear_hns
source: Come on, dear. Go for it!\nYour POKéMON is the best!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlThereIsCutest_hns
source: I think that girl over there is\nthe cutest of the lot.\pWhat's that? They're judging\nPOKéMON by their looks?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMonOfMyOwn_hns
source: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON,\nthey make we want to get my own!\pI'm going to go catch some!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyContestStage_hns
source: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE\nBE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContestStage_hns
source: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartContestStage_hns
source: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveMePokeblockCase
source: Yippee!\pThe lady at the reception counter\ngave me a case for {POKEBLOCK}S!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeblocksDifferentBerries
source: Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there.\pWhen you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone\nhas to put in a different BERRY.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeblocksWithFamily
source: I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and\nBig Sister. They turned out great!\pI bet you can make smoother, better\n{POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveMePokeblockCase_hns
source: Yippee!\pThe lady at the reception counter\ngave me a case for {POKEBLOCK}S!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeblocksDifferentBerries_hns
source: Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there.\pWhen you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone\nhas to put in a different BERRY.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokemonSpurredMeToPaint_hns
source: Congratulations!\pI did a painting of your POKéMON to\ncommemorate its victory…\pWell, your POKéMON's appeals were\nso fantastic, it spurred me into\lpainting better than I usually do.\lLook, see?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum_hns
source:
What do you think? I'm confident in
what I've done, but do you like it?\pA work of this caliber, it wouldn't look
out of place in an art museum.\pHuh? An art museum really is looking
for paintings?\pDo you think I should take this there?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum_hns
source:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take
this painting there right now.\pI'll give it a proper title, too.\pI hope they'll like it and consider
exhibiting this.\pPlease check if they did accept this.
Thank you!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMementoOfPainting_hns
source: Oh, that's right!\pAs a memento of me painting your\nPOKéMON, please take this.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceivedARibbon_hns
source: {PLAYER} received a RIBBON.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PutTheRibbonOnMon_hns
source: {PLAYER} put the RIBBON on\n{STR_VAR_1}.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_OkaySeeYou_hns
source: Okay, see you!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeButIdLikeToTakeToMuseum_hns
source: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take\nthis home with me…\pBut, you know, I would like to take\nthis to the art museum… Okay?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThatsTheWayItIs_hns
source: Oh, fine, that's the way it is.\nI will hang this in my own house.\pI'll just have to try harder next time.\nWell, be seeing you.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRankHereICome_hns
source: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS,\nhere I come.\pThe world will know that my dearest\nPOKéMON is the cutest being in all\lexistence. The time has come!\lUheheheh.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVarietyOfPokemonHere_hns
source: You can see a whole variety of\nPOKéMON here.\pThat's why I make this place a regular\npart of my daily stroll.$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFeastForEyes_hns
source: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is\na feast for these eyes!\pWould you look at all the POKéMON\nthat just scream to be painted?$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughContestIsExtreme_hns
source: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like\nextreme, man!\pThose muscular appeals…\nCascading sweat… I swoon!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedCareOnMon_hns
source: Day in and day out, I lavished my care\non this POKéMON.\pIts condition is peaking.\nToday, victory is mine!$

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeblocksWithFamily_hns
source: I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and\nBig Sister. They turned out great!\pI bet you can make smoother, better\n{POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMasterOfPokeblocks
source:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you're so young! Good for you!\pI'm sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!\pMe? I'm a master of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf I get serious just a little, why,
I can concoct great {POKEBLOCK}S.\pWould you like to learn from me,
a master of {POKEBLOCK}S?$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokeblocks
source:
Oh, good! You're a smart soul!
This is a bit long, so listen up!\pAre you ready?\pIf you look at {POKEBLOCK}S, you should see
that they are rated on how they feel.\pThe lower the feel rating,
the better it is. Don't forget this!\pA good {POKEBLOCK} has a low feel
rating and a high level.\pA POKéMON can eat more good
{POKEBLOCK}S than ordinary ones, too.\pAnd this is important.\pIf you want to make smooth {POKEBLOCK}S,
use different kinds of BERRIES.\pDon't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES
affect the smoothness of {POKEBLOCK}S.\pAnd another thing.\pThe more people blending BERRIES,
the smoother the {POKEBLOCK}S.\pThat's why you should talk to other
people and make {POKEBLOCK}S together.\pThat's about all you need to know to
make good {POKEBLOCK}S.\pIf everyone had POKéMON they love,
smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, and a loving family,\lthe world would be a happier place.\pDon't give up, dear!$

label: LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksWithBerryBlender
source: We're going to make super {POKEBLOCK}S\nwith a BERRY BLENDER!$

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
source: Uh…\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\pI can make POKéMON forget their moves.\pWould you like me to do that?$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
source:
Huh?
Who… Who are you?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}.
So your move was today.\pUm… I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!\pI…
I have this dream of becoming friends\lwith POKéMON all over the world.\pI… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from
my dad, PROF. BIRCH.\pI was hoping that you would be nice,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.\pOh, this is silly, isn't it?
I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pEheheh…\pOh, no! I forgot!\pI was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!$

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
source:
Hey!
You…\pWho are you?\pOh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
Moved in next door, right?\pI didn't know that you're a girl.\pDad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new
next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's\lkid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.\pMy name's BRENDAN.
So, hi, neighbor!\pHuh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have
a POKéMON?\pDo you want me to go catch you one?\pAw, darn, I forgot…\pI'm supposed to go help my dad catch
some wild POKéMON.\pSome other time, okay?$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
source:
Huh?
Who… Who are you?\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pOh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}.
So your move was today.\pUm… I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!\pI…
I have this dream of becoming friends\lwith POKéMON all over the world.\pI… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from
my dad, PROF. BIRCH.\pI was hoping that you would be nice,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.\pOh, this is silly, isn't it?
I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pEheheh…\pOh, no! I forgot!\pI was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!$

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
source:
Hey!
You…\pWho are you?\pOh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you?
Moved in next door, right?\pI didn't know that you're a girl.\pDad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new
next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's\lkid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.\pMy name's BRENDAN.
So, hi, neighbor!\pHuh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have
a POKéMON?\pDo you want me to go catch you one?\pAw, darn, I forgot…\pI'm supposed to go help my dad catch
some wild POKéMON.\pSome other time, okay?$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeardYouBeatRivalTakePokedex
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI heard you beat {RIVAL} on
your first try. That's excellent!\p{RIVAL}'s been helping with my research
for a long time.\p{RIVAL} has an extensive history as
a TRAINER already.\pHere, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I ordered this for my
research, but I think you should have\lthis POKéDEX.$

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
source:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Let's have a look at your POKéDEX.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …\pYes, there's no doubt about it.\pYou really have completed the HOENN
region's POKéDEX.\pThat's more than just impressive.\pI have a gift for you.\pConsider it my show of appreciation
for the fantastic work you've done.\pMy gift is a rare POKéMON only found
in another region!\pYou can have any one of these
three POKéMON!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
source: MAHOGANY TOWN POKéMON GYM\pPRYCE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n{PLAYER}$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceIntro
source:
POKéMON have many experiences
in their lives, just like we do.\pI, too, have seen and suffered
much in my life.\pSince I am your elder, let me
show you what I mean.\pI have been with POKéMON since
before you were born.\pI do not lose easily.\pI, PRYCE--the winter trainer--
shall demonstrate my power!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceImpressed
source: Ah, I am impressed by your\nprowess.\pWith your strong will, I know you\nwill overcome all life's obstacles.\pYou are worthy of this BADGE!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedBadge
source: {PLAYER} received GLACIERBADGE.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_GlacierBadgeSpeech
source: That BADGE will raise the SPECIAL\nATTACK of POKéMON.\pIt also lets your POKéMON use\nWHIRLPOOL to get across\lreal whirlpools.\pAnd this… This is a gift from me!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_HailSpeech
source: That TM contains HAIL.\pIt inflicts damage every\nturn for 5 turns.\pIt demonstrates the harshness\nof winter.$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_CherishPokemon
source: When the ice and snow melt,\nspring arrives.\pYou and your POKéMON will be\ntogether for many years to come.\pCherish your time together!$

label: MahoganyTown_Gym_Text_PryceRematch
source:
Ah, JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYour skills are indeed
remarkable.\pI am impressed.\pBut even now, there is much to

label: NewBarkTown_House1_Text_NeighborsDaughter
source:
PIKACHU is an evolved POKéMON.\pI was amazed by PROF.ELM's
findings.\pHe's so famous for his research
on POKéMON evolution.\p…sigh…\pI wish I could be a researcher
like him…$

label: NewBarkTown_House1_Text_Neighbor
source: My daughter is adamant about\nbecoming PROF.ELM's assistant.\pShe really loves POKéMON!\pBut then, so do I!$

label: NewBarkTown_House2_Text_ElmsWife
source: Hi, {PLAYER}! My husband's always\nso busy--I hope he's OK.\pWhen he's caught up in his\nPOKéMON research, he even\lforgets to eat.$

label: NewBarkTown_House2_Text_ElmsSon
source: When I grow up, I'm going to\nhelp my dad!\pI'm going to be a great\nPOKéMON professor!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAideIsWaiting
source: {PLAYER}!\pWhat are you doing here?\pMy aide is still waiting for you\nIn VIOLET CITY!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShouldntTouch
source: Probably shouldn't touch!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmIntro
source:
空木：{PLAYER}！你来啦！\p我有件事想拜托你。\p我正在做新的宝可梦研究，想请你帮
帮忙，{PLAYER}。\p你看……\p我正在写一篇论文，想在学会上发表
。\p但还有些地方我怎么也想不明白。\p所以！\p我想请你培育一只我最近刚捉到的宝
可梦。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAccepted
source: Thanks, {PLAYER}!\nYou're a great help!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmRefused
source: But… Please, I need your\nhelp!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmResearchAmbitions
source: When I announce my findings,\nI'm sure we'll delve deeper\pinto the many mysteries of\nPOKéMON.\pYou can count on it!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGotAnEmail
source: Oh, hey! I got an e-mail!\p… … … … … … … …\nHm… Uh-huh…\pOkay…$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmMissionFromMrPokemon
source:
Hey, listen.\pI have an acquaintance called
MR. POKéMON.\pHe keeps finding weird things and
raving about his discoveries.\pAnyway, I just got an e-mail
from him saying that this\ltime it's real.\pIt is intriguing, but we're
busy with our POKéMON research...\pWait!
I know!\p{PLAYER}, can you go in our
place?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmChooseAPokemon
source: I want you to raise one of\nthe POKéMON contained in these BALLS.\pYou'll be that POKéMON's\nfirst partner, {PLAYER}!\pGo on. Pick one!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmWhereGoing
source: 空木：等等！你要去哪里？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ChooseCyndaquil
source: 空木：你要选\n{STR_VAR_1}，那只\l{STR_VAR_2}宝可梦吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ChooseTotodile
source: 空木：你想要\n{STR_VAR_1}，那只\l{STR_VAR_2}宝可梦吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ChooseChikorita
source: 空木：这么说，你喜欢\n{STR_VAR_1}，那只\l{STR_VAR_2}宝可梦？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_DidntChooseStarter
source: 空木：好好考虑吧。\p你的伙伴很重要。$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ChoseStarter
source: 空木：我觉得那只宝可梦也很棒！$

source: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_1}!$

source: Would you like to give your\n{STR_VAR_1} a nickname?$

source:
MR. POKéMON lives a little bit
beyond CHERRYGROVE, the next\lcity over.\pIt's almost a direct route
there, so you can't miss it.\pBut just in case, you have my
phone number. Call me if\lanything comes up!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDirections1_Register
source:
MR. POKéMON lives a little bit
beyond CHERRYGROVE, the next\lcity over.\pIt's almost a direct route
there, so you can't miss it.\pBut just in case, here's my
phone number. Call me if\lanything comes up!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_RegisteredElm
source: Registered PROF.ELM\nin the POKéGEAR.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmLetYourMonBattle
source: If a wild POKéMON appears,\nlet your POKéMON battle it!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDirections2
source: If a wild POKéMON appears, let\nyour POKéMON battle it!\pIf your POKéMON is hurt, you\nshould heal it with the machine\lto my right, or at the POKéCENTER.\pI'm counting on you!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_GotElmsNumber
source: {PLAYER} got ELM's phone\nnumber.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmDescribesMrPokemon
source: MR. POKéMON goes everywhere and\nfinds rarities.\pToo bad they're just rare and\nnot very useful…$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmPokeBall
source: It contains a POKéMON caught\nby PROF.ELM.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft1
source: ELM: {PLAYER}, this is terrible…\pOh, yes, what was MR. POKéMON's\nbig discovery?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft2
source: {PLAYER} handed the MYSTERY EGG\nto PROF.ELM.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft3
source: 空木：这个？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAfterTheft4
source:
But… Is it a POKéMON EGG?\pIf it is, it is a great
discovery!\pELM: What?!?\pPROF.OAK gave you a POKéDEX?\p{PLAYER}, is that true?
Th-that's incredible!\pHe is superb at seeing the
potential of people as trainers.\pWow, {PLAYER}. You may have what
it takes to become the CHAMPION.\pYou seem to be getting on
great with POKéMON too.\pYou should take the POKéMON
GYM challenge.\pThe closest GYM would be the
one in VIOLET CITY.\p…{PLAYER}. The road to the
championship will be a long one.\pBefore you leave, make sure
that you talk to your mom.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmStudyingEgg
source: 空木：别放弃！那枚蛋要是有什么消\n息，我会打电话给你的！$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmAideHasEgg
source:
ELM: {PLAYER}? Didn't you meet
my assistant?\pHe should have met you with
the EGG at VIOLET CITY's\pPOKéMON CENTER.\pYou must have just missed him.
Try to catch him there.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmWaitingEggHatch
source: 空木：那枚蛋有什么变化吗？$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmThoughtEggHatched
source: {PLAYER}? I thought the EGG\nhatched.\pWhere is the POKéMON?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi1
source: ELM: {PLAYER}, you look great!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi2
source: What? That POKéMON!?!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ShowTogepi3
source:
The EGG hatched! So, POKéMON
are born from EGGS…\pNo, perhaps not all POKéMON
are.\pWow, there's still a lot of
research to be done.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveEverstone1
source: Thanks, {PLAYER}! You're helping\nunravel POKéMON mysteries for us!\pI want you to have this as a\ntoken of our appreciation.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveEverstone2
source:
That's an EVERSTONE.\pSome species of POKéMON evolve
when they grow to certain levels.\pA POKéMON holding the EVERSTONE
won't evolve.\pGive it to a POKéMON you don't
want to evolve.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmCallYou
source: ELM: {PLAYER}, I'll call you if\nanything comes up.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideAfterTheft
source: …sigh… That stolen POKéMON.\pI wonder how it's doing.\pThey say a POKéMON raised by a\nbad person turns bad itself.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveMasterBall1
source: ELM: Hi, {PLAYER}!\pThanks to you, my research is\ngoing great!\pTake this as a token of my\nappreciation.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveMasterBall2
source:
The MASTER BALL is the best!\pIt's the ultimate BALL! It'll
catch any POKéMON without fail.\pIt's given only to recognized
POKéMON researchers.\pI think you can make much better
use of it than I can, {PLAYER}!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_KimonoGirls
source:
By the way...
A group of beautiful KIMONO\lGIRLS were looking for you.\pThey told me they are
waiting for you at the\lECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER.\pI know you've gone through many
things since that EGG got you\linvolved in all this...\pI hope you'll carry through it.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_KimonoWaiting
source: PROF.ELM: The KIMONO\nGIRLS are waiting for you at\lthe ECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_League
source:
PROF.ELM: Hahaha...
Good job!\pThat rare EGG has brought you
a lot of trouble, huh?\pThe KIMONO GIRLS said something
about me?\pI have nothing to do with it.\pYou made your decision and went
through with it.\pHaving done so much, you should
be able to face the LEAGUE now!\pYou should head for INDIGO
PLATEAU!\pDo you know how to get there?
Follow ROUTE 27 to ROUTE 26.\pOnce there, go straight north!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveTicket1
source: ELM: {PLAYER}! There you are!\pI called because I have\nsomething for you.\pSee? It's an S.S.TICKET.\pNow you can catch POKéMON in\nKANTO.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmGiveTicket2
source:
The ship departs from OLIVINE
CITY.\pBut you knew that already,
{PLAYER}.\pAfter all, you've traveled all
over with your POKéMON.\pGive my regards to PROF.OAK in
KANTO!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_LabMonEgg
source: It's the POKéMON EGG being\nstudied by PROF.ELM.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideGivePotion
source: {PLAYER}, I want you to have\nthis for your errand.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideAlwaysBusy
source: There are only three of us, so\nwe're always busy.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideSave
source: Don't forget to save your game\nregularly!\pPress the START button, then\nSAVE the game!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideTheftTestimony
source:
There was a loud noise
outside…\pWhen we went to look,
someone stole a POKéMON.\pIt's unbelievable that anyone
would do that!\p…sigh… That stolen POKéMON.\pI wonder how it's doing.\pThey say a POKéMON raised by a
bad person turns bad itself.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideGiveBalls
source: {PLAYER}!\pUse these on your POKéDEX\nquest!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_AideExplainBalls
source: To add to your POKéDEX, you\nhave to catch POKéMON.\pThrow POKé BALLS at wild\nPOKéMON to get them.$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Officer1
source:
I heard a POKéMON was stolen
here…\pI was just getting some
information from PROF.ELM.\pApparently, it was a young
male with long, red hair…\pWhat?\pYou battled a trainer like
that?\pDid you happen to get his
name?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Officer2_1
source: OK! So {RIVAL} was his name?$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Officer2
source: Thanks for helping my\ninvestigation!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_OfficerNo
source: Surely you got his name?!$

label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_Elm_CallMe
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pHow's your POKéDEX coming along?\nI'm busy now, but call me sometime\land I can check your progress!$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MomAnythingElse
source: Is there anything else I can\nhelp you with, sweetie?$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_CurrentSavings
source: I'm holding {STR_VAR_2}\nfor you right now.$

source: Do you want me to save some of the\nmoney you earn?$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SavingEnabled

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SavingDisabled

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Goodbye
source: Take care, sweetie!$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WithdrawSuccess
source: MOM: Here you go!$

source: MOM: You don't have any money to\ndeposit right now, sweetie.$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ElmsLookingForYou
source:
Oh, {PLAYER}…! Our neighbor,
PROF.ELM, was looking for you.\pHe said he wanted you to do
something for him.\pOh! I almost forgot! Your POKéGEAR
is back from the repair shop.\pHere you go!$

source: {PLAYER} obtained the POKéGEAR.$

label: NewBarkTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ExplainPokeGear
