label: Route12_Text_Magikarp
source: MAGIKARP: Kaaaarp.$

label: Route12_Text_NewFisher
source: Careful, something vicious lives in\nthese waters.$

label: Route12_Text_FisherMartinSeen
source: Patience is the key to both\nfishing and POKéMON.$

label: Route12_Text_FisherMartinBeaten
source: Gwaaah!$

label: Route12_Text_FisherMartinAfterBattle
source: I'm too impatient for fishing…$

label: Route12_Text_FisherStephenSeen
source: I feel so content, fishing while\nlistening to some tunes on my\lradio.$

label: Route12_Text_FisherStephenBeaten
source: My stupid radio distracted me!$

label: Route12_Text_FisherStephenAfterBattle
source: Have you checked out KANTO's radio\nprograms? We get a good variety\lhere.$

label: Route12_Text_FisherBarneySeen
source: What's most important in our\neveryday lives?$

label: Route12_Text_FisherBarneyBeaten
source: The answer is coming up next!$

label: Route12_Text_FisherBarneyAfterBattle
source: I think electricity is the most\nimportant thing in our daily\llives.\pIf it weren't, people wouldn't\nhave made such a fuss when the\lPOWER PLANT went out of\lcommission.$

label: Route12_Text_KyleRegister
source: I'll remember this.\nGive me your number!$

label: Route12_Text_KyleRematchIntro
source: Did you forget?\nLet's see!$

label: Route12_Text_KyleRematchDefeat
source: You remembered.$

label: Route12_Text_KylePostRematch
source: The thrill of battle is almost\nas good as a big catch!$

label: Route12_Text_FisherKyleSeen
source: Do you remember?$

label: Route12_Text_FisherKyleBeaten
source: You do remember?$

label: Route12_Text_FisherKyleAfterBattle
source: The tug you feel on the ROD when\nyou hook a POKéMON…\pThat's the best feeling ever for\nan angler like me.$

label: Route12_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 12\pNORTH TO LAVENDER TOWN$

label: Route12_Text_FishingSpotSign
source: FISHING SPOT$

label: Route12_House_Text_OfferSuperRod
source: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI can see that you like fishing.\pThere's no doubt in my mind at\nall!\pSo? I know I'm right.$

label: Route12_House_Text_GiveSuperRod
source: Yes, yes. Just as I thought!\pHere, fishing fan! Take this--\nit's a SUPER ROD.$

label: Route12_House_Text_GaveSuperRod
source: Try your hand at fishing wherever\nthere is water.\pRemember--you can catch different\nPOKéMON using different RODS.$

label: Route12_House_Text_DontWantSuperRod
source: Huh? My own eyes deceived me?$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmAlexSeen
source: Bow down before my regal POKéMON!$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmAlexBeaten
source: How… How dare you mock royalty!$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmAlexAfterBattle
source: Doesn't everyone wish to someday\nbe a king?$

label: Route13_Text_AlexRegister
source: You're not royalty but you're good.\nLet me get your number.$

label: Route13_Text_AlexRematchIntro
source: I've added knights to my court!\nLet's battle!$

label: Route13_Text_AlexRematchDefeat
source: Dethroned again…$

label: Route13_Text_AlexPostRematch
source: Maybe I'm just a pawn after all.$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmJoshuaSeen
source: Nihihi! Would you like to battle\nmy PIKACHU gang?$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmJoshuaBeaten
source: PI-PIKACHU!$

label: Route13_Text_PokefanmJoshuaAfterBattle
source: You look like you have many\nPOKéMON, but PIKACHU\lis still the best.$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperPerrySeen
source: Agility is the key attribute of\nbird POKéMON.$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperPerryBeaten
source: You beat me with your speed…$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperPerryAfterBattle
source: Your POKéMON are remarkably well-\ntrained.$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperBretSeen
source: Check out my POKéMON. Just look\nat their coloring and their\lplumage.$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperBretBeaten
source: Shoot! Not good enough!$

label: Route13_Text_BirdKeeperBretAfterBattle
source: If you groom them, POKéMON get\nhappy.$

label: Route13_Text_HikerKennySeen
source: I should go to ROCK TUNNEL to get\nmyself an ONIX.$

label: Route13_Text_HikerKennyBeaten
source: I lost…$

label: Route13_Text_HikerKennyAfterBattle
source: Geological features don't appear\nto change.\pBut they actually change, little\nby little.$

label: Route13_Text_KennyRegister
source: Maybe POKéMON change over time too.\nLet's battle again sometime!$

label: Route13_Text_KennyRematchIntro
source: I've learned from geology!\nLet's go!$

label: Route13_Text_KennyRematchDefeat
source: Still not enough…$

label: Route13_Text_KennyPostRematch
source: The power of POKéMON is like\nerosion. We will persevere!$

label: Route13_Text_TrainerTips
source: TRAINER TIPS\pLook! Right there, at the left\nside of the post.$

label: Route13_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 13\pNORTH TO SILENCE BRIDGE$

label: Route13_Text_DirectionsSign
source: NORTH TO LAVENDER TOWN\pWEST TO FUCHSIA CITY$

label: Route13_GetOffBoat_Text_0
source: Welcome back to mainland Kanto!\pCome back if you'd like to take a trip\nto the ALOLA ISLES!$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_0
source: Ahoy there!\pThat's one strange souvenir.\nYou must be from the ISLES!$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_0_5
source: Would you like to take the next ship?\nIt departs shortly!$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_1
source: Ahoy! Let's get you on board!$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_2
source: Ahoy!\nCome back when you'd like to set sail.$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_3
source: Ah, it's you again!\nDo you want to go to the ALOLA ISLES?$

label: Route13_TravelToAlola_Text_4
source:
Ahoy!
This port is for residents only.\pAll of the residents of these ISLES
carry some… {PAUSE 30}strange souvenirs.\pIt makes them so easy to identify,
I don't even need to check tickets!$

label: Route14_Text_Eusine
source:
EUSINE: {PLAYER}! Not again!
I'll be there first next time!\pHaving followed it here, I'm
starting to understand what SUICUNE\lis after.\pTo be honest, I would like to keep
this information to myself.\pBut I want to be an honest trainer
in front of SUICUNE!\pThat's why I am sharing a clue with
you.\pIt seems that...
SUICUNE prefers a hilly place...\lNear water...\lSomewhere north...\pI don't know exactly where yet.
It will just be you and me!\pWho'll find it first?
I challenge you!$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmTrevorSeen
source: Hi. Did you know…?\pPOKéMON get more friendly if you\ntrain them in a place that they\lremember.$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmTrevorBeaten
source: Where did I meet this SCIZOR?$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmTrevorAfterBattle
source: If only there were an easy way to\nidentify where I got my POKéMON…$

label: Route14_Text_TrevorRegister
source: You're interesting!\nCan I have your number?$

label: Route14_Text_TrevorRematchIntro
source: I've been training with my\nPOKéMON in familiar places!$

label: Route14_Text_TrevorRematchDefeat
source: Maybe I need new places…$

label: Route14_Text_TrevorPostRematch
source: Friendship makes POKéMON\nstronger. I'm sure of it!$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmCarterSeen
source: Let me tell you, I had a hard time\ncatching my prized POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmCarterBeaten
source: Awaaah!$

label: Route14_Text_PokefanmCarterAfterBattle
source: TOTODILE, CYNDAQUIL, CHIKORITA…\pI think that's a well-balanced mix.$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRegister
source: You know your starters!\nLet me get your number!$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro
source: I've found even more rare starters\nto show off! Battle me!$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchDefeat
source: My precious starters…$

label: Route14_Text_CarterPostRematch
source: There are so many starters from\ndifferent regions to collect!$

label: Route14_Text_BirdKeeperRoySeen
source: My dream is to fly with my beloved\nbird POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_BirdKeeperRoyBeaten
source: I can dream, but I can't ever fly…$

label: Route14_Text_BirdKeeperRoyAfterBattle
source: You have POKéMON that know the HM\nmove FLY, don't you? I envy you.$

label: Route14_Text_Pidgeotto
source: PIDGEOTTO: Kaaaaa!$

label: Route14_Text_PidgeottoBerry
source: Give the PIDGEOTTO a BERRY?$

label: Route14_Text_PidgeottoAteBerry
source: PIDGEOTTO enjoyed the QUALOT BERRY!$

label: Route14_Text_PidgeottoTurnedAway
source: PIDGEOTTO doesn't like it!$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherColetteSeen
source: Have you forgotten anything?$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherColetteBeaten
source: Kyaaah!$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherColetteAfterBattle
source: Before I became a teacher, I used\nto forget a lot of things.$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherHillarySeen
source: On sunny days, I think that the\nkids would rather be playing in the\lschoolyard than studying in class.$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherHillaryBeaten
source: I didn't want to lose…$

label: Route15_Text_TeacherHillaryAfterBattle
source: Studying is important, but\nexercise is just as vital.$

label: Route15_Text_HillaryRegister
source: You've taught me a lesson!\nMay I have your number?$

label: Route15_Text_HillaryRematchIntro
source: I'll school you this time!$

label: Route15_Text_HillaryRematchDefeat
source: Back to the drawing board…$

label: Route15_Text_HillaryPostRematch
source: Teaching POKéMON is just like\nteaching children. Patience!$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyKippSeen
source: Hang on. I have to phone my mom.$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyKippBeaten
source: Sorry, Mom! I was beaten!$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyKippAfterBattle
source: My mom worries so much about me, I\nhave to phone her all the time.$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyTommySeen
source: Let's battle. I won't lose!$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyTommyBeaten
source: I forgot to do my homework!$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyTommyAfterBattle
source: Sayonara! I just learned that in\nmy Japanese class.$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyJohnnySeen
source: We're on a field trip to LAVENDER\nRADIO TOWER for social studies.$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyJohnnyBeaten
source: You're wickedly tough!$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyJohnnyAfterBattle
source: I'm tired of walking. I need to\ntake a break.$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyBillySeen
source: My favorite class is Gym!$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyBillyBeaten
source: Oh, no! How could I lose?$

label: Route15_Text_SchoolboyBillyAfterBattle
source: If POKéMON were a subject at\nschool, I'd be the best!$

label: Route15_Text_BillyRegister
source: I should've paid more attention in class.\nCan I have your number?$

label: Route15_Text_BillyRematchIntro
source: I've been studying hard!\nLet me show you what I learned!$

label: Route15_Text_BillyRematchDefeat
source: I need to study more…$

label: Route15_Text_BillyPostRematch
source: Book smarts aren't everything.\nI need battle experience too!$

label: Route15_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 15\pFUCHSIA CITY - LAVENDER TOWN$

label: Route16_Text_Sign
source: CYCLING ROAD\nDOWNHILL COASING\lALL THE WAY DOWN!$

label: Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouse_Text_SuperNerd
source: A celebrity used to live here.$

label: Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouse_Text_SuperNerdOld
source: If you cruise down CYCLING ROAD,\nyou will end up in FUCHSIA CITY.$

label: Route17_Text_BikerRileySeen
source: Hey, you! You're from JOHTO, huh?$

label: Route17_Text_BikerRileyBeaten
source: Whoa, you kick!$

label: Route17_Text_BikerRileyAfterBattle
source: Don't get cocky, you JOHTO punk!$

label: Route17_Text_BikerJoelSeen
source: Wow. That's a cool BICYCLE!$

label: Route17_Text_BikerJoelBeaten
source: But you don't just look cool…$

label: Route17_Text_BikerJoelAfterBattle
source: I look cool, but I'm weak, so I'm\nnot really cool.\pI have to train harder…$

label: Route17_Text_BikerGlennSeen
source: Hey! Want to have a speed battle?$

label: Route17_Text_BikerGlennBeaten
source: Yikes! You've got awesome torque!$

label: Route17_Text_BikerGlennAfterBattle
source: Hands-free riding is considered\ncool on CYCLING ROAD.$

label: Route17_Text_BikerCharlesSeen
source: We're fearless highway stars!$

label: Route17_Text_BikerCharlesBeaten
source: Arrrgh! Crash and burn!$

label: Route17_Text_BikerCharlesAfterBattle
source: Reckless driving causes accidents!\nTake it easy!$

label: Route17_Text_RileyRegister
source: Not bad for a JOHTO kid!$

label: Route17_Text_RileyRematchIntro
source: JOHTO punks can only win once!$

label: Route17_Text_RileyRematchDefeat
source: I got kicked...$

label: Route17_Text_RileyPostRematch
source: Maybe I should train in JOHTO\nafter all.$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganBeaten
source: Oh! You're really strong!$

label: Route27_Text_CooltrainerfMeganAfter
source:
I'm checking out pre- and post-
evolution POKéMON.\pEvolution really does make
POKéMON stronger.\pBut evolved forms also learn
moves later on.$

label: Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertSeen
source: Don't say a thing!\pLet me guess what you're thinking.\pMmmmmmm…\pI got it! You're on the POKéMON\nLEAGUE challenge!$

label: Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertBeaten
source: You're too much!$

label: Route27_Text_PsychicGilbertAfter
source: With your skills, you'll do well at\nthe LEAGUE.\pThat's what my premonition says.$

label: Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseSeen
source: Tweet! Tweet! Tetweet!$

label: Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseBeaten
source: Tweet!$

label: Route27_Text_BirdKeeperJoseAfter
source: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$

label: Route27_Text_JoseRegister
source: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$

label: Route27_Text_JoseRematchIntro
source: Tweet! Tweet! Tetweet!$

label: Route27_Text_JoseRematchDefeat
source: Tweet!$

label: Route27_Text_JosePostRematch
source: BIRD KEEPERS like me mimic bird\nwhistles to command POKéMON.$

label: Route27_Text_JoseHasItem
source: Hey! I found something\nshiny while bird-watching!\pHere, you can have it!$

label: Route27_Text_JoseGaveItem
source: I find all sorts of things\nout here on ROUTE 27.\pI'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$

label: Route27_Text_JoseNoRoom
source: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

label: TohjoFalls_Text_Sign
source: TOHJO FALLS\pTHE LINK BETWEEN KANTO AND JOHTO$

label: Route27_Text_FisherScottSeen
source: I'm feeling great today!\pI feel like I could boot even the\nLEAGUE CHAMP!$

label: Route27_Text_FisherScottBeaten
source: No! Not in this battle!$

label: Route27_Text_FisherScottAfter
source: Just like in fishing, it's all over\nin POKéMON if you give up.$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_Woman1
source: Where are you off to with\nPOKéMON?\pPOKéMON LEAGUE?\pAre your POKéMON loyal enough for\nyou to win?\pLet me see…$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_LoyalMon
source: Ah! Your POKéMON trusts you very\nmuch.\pIt's nice to see a good trainer.\pHere. A gift for your journey.$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_TM37Description
source: TM37 happens to be SANDSTORM.\pIt's a move that inflicts damage\non both battlers.\pIt's for advanced trainers only.\pUse it if you dare. Good luck!$

label: SandstormHouse_Text_DisloyalMon
source: If it doesn't come to trust you\nsome more, it could be tough going.\pTrust is the tie that binds POKéMON\nand trainers.$

label: Route28_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 28$

label: Route28_Text_Scientist
source: Hiya, Boss.\pYes, I've found several artifacts,\nbut no sign of the AZURE FLUTE.\pIt may be inside the MOUNTAIN, but\nthe wild POKéMON here are strong,\land my team needs some rest...\p..................\pYou're breaking up...\lBoss....?\pI'm going to the POKéMON CENTER.\pI'll call back if I find the FLUTE.$

label: Route28_Text_Scientist2
source: .......CLICK\pThe signal in SINJOH sucks...$

label: Route28House_Text_Celebrity1
source: Oh, dear. You've found me.\pPlease don't tell anyone about me.\pI'll give you this for keeping my\nsecret. Please?$

label: Route28House_Text_Celebrity2
source: It's tough being a top celebrity.\pEverywhere I go, people chase me.\pI just want to be left alone…$

label: Route28House_Text_Fearow
source: FEAROW: Feero!$

label: Route29_Text_PressAorB
source: Press A or B to stop viewing.$

label: Route29_Text_OldMan1
source: POKéMON hide in the grass.\nWho knows when they'll pop out…$

label: Route29_Text_OldMan2
source: I've seen you a couple times.\nHow many POKéMON have you caught?\pWould you like me to tell you\nhow to catch POKéMON?$

label: Route29_Text_OldManExplanation
source:
If you weaken them first,
POKéMON are easier to catch.\pThen, throw a ball at them from
your bag! Any ball will do.\pIf you want to learn more,
go to the ACADEMY in VIOLET CITY!\pThe students there know a lot
about POKéMON.$

label: Route29_Text_OldManDeclined
source:
Oh. Fine, then.\pCheck every route to find
different types of POKéMON.\pYour POKéDEX shows where you can
find them too!\pIf you want to learn more,
go to the ACADEMY in VIOLET CITY!\pThe students know a lot about
POKéMON.$

label: Route29_Text_Youngster
source: Yo. How are your POKéMON?\pIf they're weak and not ready\nfor battle, keep out of the grass.$

label: Route29_Text_Lass
source: See those ledges?\nIt's scary to jump off them.\pBut you can go to NEW BARK\nwithout walking through the grass.$

label: Route29_Text_Girl
source: I wanted to take a break,\nso I saved to record my progress.$

label: Route29_Text_Boy_WaitingForDay
source: I'm waiting for POKéMON that\nappear only later in the day.$

label: Route29_Text_Boy_WaitingForNight
source: I'm waiting for POKéMON that\nappear only at night.$

label: Route29_Text_MeetTuscany
source: TUSCANY: I do believe that this\nis the first time we've met?\pI'm TUSCANY of the WEEKDAY FAMILY.\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyNope
source: Not quite!$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyGivesGift
source: Yes! By way of introduction,\nplease accept this gift, a SILK\lSCARF.$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyGaveGift
source: TUSCANY: Wouldn't you agree\nthat it is most adorable?\pIt strengthens NORMAL-type\nmoves.\pI am certain it will be of use.$

label: Route29_Text_TuscanyTuesday
source: TUSCANY: Have you met MONICA,\nmy older sister?\pOr my younger brother, WESLEY?\pI am the third of seven\nchildren.$

label: Route29_Text_Sign1
source: ROUTE 29\pCHERRYGROVE CITY - NEW BARK TOWN$

label: Route2_Text_RobRegister
source: Let me get your number!$

label: Route2_Text_RobRematchIntro
source: I've caught even more bugs!\nCheck them out!$

label: Route2_Text_RobRematchDefeat
source: I need better bugs!$

label: Route2_Text_RobPostRematch
source: I caught every bug in VIRIDIAN.\nIs there a better FOREST somewhere?$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_Seen
source: My bug POKéMON are tough. Prepare to\nlose!$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_Beaten
source: I was whipped…$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherRob_AfterBattle
source: I'm going to look for stronger bug\nPOKéMON.$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_Seen
source: If you walk in tall grass wearing\nshorts, do you get nicks and cuts?$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_Beaten
source: Ouch, ouch, ouch!$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherEd_AfterBattle
source: They'll really sting when you take a\nbath.$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_Seen
source: Why don't girls like bug POKéMON?$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_Beaten
source: No good!$

label: Route2_Text_BugCatcherDoug_AfterBattle
source: Bug POKéMON squish like plush toys\nwhen you squeeze their bellies.\pI love how they feel!$

label: Route2_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 2\pVIRIDIAN CITY - PEWTER CITY$

label: Route2_Text_DiglettsCaveSign
source: 地鼠洞$

label: Route2_House_Text_Fisher
source: Hi! Wow, I'm glad to see you.\pYou're the first visitor I've had in a\nlong time.\pI'm super-happy! Let me give you a\nlittle present.$

label: Route2_House_Text_Fisher_GotNugget
source: That's a NUGGET.\pI can't give you any nuggets of\nwisdom, so that'll have to do!$

label: Route30_Text_Mailbox
source: MR.POKéMON's House$

label: Route30_Text_UseTackle
source: Go, RATTATA!\pTACKLE!$

label: Route30_Text_ThisIsABigBattle
source: What? This is a big battle!\nLeave me alone!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1Seen
source: I just lost, so I'm trying to\nfind more POKéMON.\pWait! You look weak! Come on,\nlet's battle!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1Beaten
source: Ack! I lost again!\nDoggone it!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoey1After
source: Do I have to have more POKéMON\nin order to battle better?\pNo! I'm sticking with this one\nno matter what!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeySeen
source: You're a POKéMON trainer,\nright?\pThen you have to battle!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeyBeaten
source: That's strange.\nI won before.$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterMikeyAfter
source: Becoming a good trainer is\nreally tough.\pI'm going to battle other\npeople to get better.$

label: Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonSeen
source: Instead of a bug POKéMON,\nI found a trainer!$

label: Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonBeaten
source: Argh! You're too strong!$

label: Route30_Text_BugCatcherDonAfter
source: I ran out of POKé BALLS while\nI was catching POKéMON.\pI should've bought some more…$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterDirectionsToMrPokemon
source: MR. POKéMON's house?\nIt's a bit farther ahead.$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterEveryoneIsBattling
source: Everyone's having fun\nbattling!\pYou should too!$

label: Route30_Text_CooltrainerF
source: I'm not a trainer.\pBut if you look one in the\neyes, prepare to battle.$

label: Route30_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 30\pVIOLET CITY - CHERRYGROVE CITY$

label: Route30_Text_MrPokemonsHouseDirectionsSign
source: MR. POKéMON'S HOUSE\nSTRAIGHT AHEAD!$

label: Route30_Text_MrPokemonsHouseSign
source: MR. POKéMON'S HOUSE$

label: Route30_Text_TrainerTips
source: TRAINER TIPS\pNo stealing other people's\nPOKéMON!\pPOKé BALLS are to be thrown\nonly at wild POKéMON!$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyRegister
source: You're pretty good!\pMy RATTATA's raring to go,\njust like always.\pIt's the only one I have.\nI'm going to become a great\lTRAINER with it!\pLet's battle again sometime!$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyRematchIntro
source: I promised things would be\ndifferent! Let's battle!$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyRematchDefeat
source: Ack! I lost again!\nDoggone it!$

label: Route30_Text_JoeyPostRematch
source: I'm checking out my\nRATTATA's moves and devising\lsome strategies.\pWhen I come up with a good\none, let's battle!$

label: Route30_Text_YoungsterJoeyGiveHPUp
source:
I lost again…
Gee, you're tough!\pOh yeah, I almost forgot that
I had to give you this.\pUse it to get even tougher,
OK?\pI'm going to get tougher too.$

label: Route30_Text_ElmName
source: 空木博士$

label: Route30_Text_Elm_Disaster
source: PROF.ELM: H-hello? {PLAYER}? It's\na disaster!\pUh, um, it's just terrible!\pWhat should I do? It…\nOh, no…\pPlease get back here now!$

label: Route30_Text_Poliwag
source: POLIWAG: Wag waag!$

label: Route30_BerryHouse_Text_MonEatBerries
source:
When you follow that path up north,
you will see MR. POKéMON’s house.\pBut before you go, allow me to
tell you about BERRIES!\pPOKéMON get healthier by eating
BERRIES.\pThey can even eat BERRIES
they're holding in battle.\pBERRIES can also be turned into
BALLS by KURT in AZALEA TOWN.\pHere. I'll share one with you!$

label: Route30_BerryHouse_Text_CheckTrees
source: Check trees for BERRIES.\nThey grow back after a few hours.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro1
source: Hello, hello! You must be\n{PLAYER}.\pPROF.ELM said that you would\nvisit.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro2
source: This is what I want PROF.ELM\nto examine.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GotEgg
source: {PLAYER} received MYSTERY EGG.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro3
source:
I know a couple who run a
POKéMON DAY-CARE service.\pThey gave me that EGG.\pI was intrigued, so I sent
mail to PROF.ELM.\pFor POKéMON evolution,
PROF.ELM is the authority.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro4
source: Even PROF.OAK here recognizes\nthat.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Intro5
source: If my assumption is correct,\nPROF.ELM will know it.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Heal
source: You are returning to PROF.ELM?\pHere. Your POKéMON should have\nsome rest.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_DependingOnYou
source: I'm depending on you!$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_AlwaysNewDiscoveries
source: Life is delightful!\nAlways, new discoveries to be made.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_OakIntro
source:
OAK: Aha! So you're {PLAYER}!\pI'm OAK! A POKéMON researcher.\pI was just visiting my old friend
MR. POKéMON.\pI heard you were running an errand
for PROF.ELM, so I waited here.\pOh! What's this? A rare POKéMON!\pLet's see…
Hm, I see!\pI understand why PROF.ELM gave
you a POKéMON for this errand.\pTo researchers like PROF.ELM and
I, POKéMON are our friends.\pHe saw that you would treat your
POKéMON with love and care.\p…Ah!\pYou seem to be dependable. How
would you like to help me out?\pSee? This is the latest version of
the POKéDEX.\pIt automatically records data on
POKéMON you've seen or caught.\pIt's a hi-tech encyclopedia!\pIt shows their habitats, how
they evolve, and their moves.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GetDex
source: {PLAYER} received POKéDEX!$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_OakParting
source: Go meet many kinds of POKéMON and\ncomplete that POKéDEX!\pBut I've stayed too long.\pI have to get to GOLDENROD\nfor my usual radio show.\p{PLAYER}, I'm counting on you!$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GimmeTheScale
source:
Hm? That SCALE! What's that?
A red GYARADOS?\pThat's rare! I, I want it…\p{PLAYER}, would you care to
trade it?\pI can offer this EXP.SHARE
that I got from PROF.OAK.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_Disappointed
source: That's disappointing.\nThat happens to be very rare.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_ExpShare
source: I also have a special item\nfor you.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_ForeignMagazines
source: It's packed with foreign\nmagazines.\pCan't even read their titles…$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_BrokenComputer
source: It's a big computer.\nHmm. It's broken.$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_StrangeCoins
source: A whole pile of strange coins!\pMaybe they're from another\ncountry…$

label: MrPokemonHouse_Text_GotExpShare
source: {PLAYER} received EXP. SHARE!$

label: Route31_Text_CooltrainerM
source: DARK CAVE…\pIf POKéMON could light it up,\nI'd explore it.$

label: Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_Seen
source: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nLet me battle with you!$

label: Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_Beaten
source: Awwwww…$

label: Route31_Text_BugCatcherWade1_After
source: You can catch POKéMON even if\nyou have six with you.\pIf you catch one, it'll go to\nyour BOX automatically.$

label: Route31_Text_SleepyMan
source: … Hnuurg… Huh?\pI walked too far today looking\nfor POKéMON.\pMy feet hurt and I'm sleepy…\pIf I were a wild POKéMON, I'd\nbe easy to catch…\p…Zzzz…$

label: Route31_Text_SleepyManGotMail
source: …Zzzz… Huh?\pWhat's that? You have MAIL\nfor me?$

label: Route31_Text_SleepyManFail
source: …Zzzz…$

label: Route31_Text_HandOverMailMon
source: {PLAYER} handed over the\nPOKéMON holding the MAIL.$

label: Route31_Text_ReadingMail
source:
Let's see…\pThanks for bringing this to
me.\pMy friend's a good guy, and
you're swell too!\pI'd like to do something good
in return too!\pI know! I want you to have
this!$

label: Route31_Text_DescribeRest
source: ...Zzz...\p...Umm... Rest!\pThe phrase 'recover fast' became\nshortened to 'Rest,' you see?\pThis is a move to sleep and recover\nsome HP.$

label: Route31_Text_WrongMail
source: This MAIL isn't for me.$

label: Route31_Text_MissingMail
source: Why is this POKéMON so special?\pIt doesn't have any MAIL.$

label: Route31_Text_DeclinedToHandOverMail
source: What? You don't want\nanything?$

label: Route31_Text_CantTakeLastMon
source: If I take that POKéMON from\nyou,\pwhat are you going to use in\nbattle?$

label: Route31_Text_Youngster
source:
I found a good POKéMON in DARK
CAVE.\pI'm going to raise it to take
on FALKNER.\pHe's the leader of VIOLET
CITY's GYM.$

label: Route31_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 31\pVIOLET CITY - CHERRYGROVE CITY$

label: Route31_Text_WadeRegister
source:
You're awesome! I like you!\pI look for POKéMON here every
day.\pWhen I'm in the grass, I find
all kinds of BERRIES.\pIf you'd like, I'll share
some.$

label: Route31_Text_WadeRematchIntro
source: I was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$

label: Route31_Text_WadeRematchDefeat
source: Awwwww…$

label: Route31_Text_WadePostRematch
source: You'll hear from me as soon\nas I find anything that you\lmight like.$

label: Route31_Text_WadeHasItem
source: Hey! I've been looking for\nyou!\pI found something while I\nwas in the grass.\pHere, you can have it!$

label: Route31_Text_WadeGaveItem
source: I'll let you know if I find\nanything else!$

label: Route31_Text_WadeNoRoom
source: Hmm, looks like your BAG\nis full.\pCome back when you have\nroom!$

label: Route31_Text_DarkCaveSign
source: DARK CAVE$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_WhatsTheHurry
source: Wait up!\nWhat's the hurry?$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_AideIsWaiting
source: {PLAYER}, right?\nSome guy wearing glasses\pwas looking for you.\pSee for yourself. He's waiting for\nyou at the POKéMON CENTER.$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_SproutTower
source: Have you gone to SPROUT TOWER?\nIf you ever visit VIOLET CITY,\pthey'll expect you to train there.\nThat's basic for trainers.\pGo to SPROUT TOWER!$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_VioletGym
source: Have you gone to the POKéMON GYM?\nYou can test your POKéMON and\pyourself there.\nIt's a rite of passage for all\ptrainers!$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_HaveThisSeed
source:
You have some good POKéMON there.
It must be from the training you\pgave them around VIOLET CITY.
The training at the GYM must have\pbeen especially helpful. As a
souvenir of VIOLET CITY, take this.\pIt increases the power of GRASS-
type moves.$

label: Route32_Text_CooltrainerM_Experiences
source: Your experiences in VIOLET CITY\nshould be useful for your journey.$

label: Route32_Text_SlowpokeTailOffer
source: How would you like to have this\ntasty, nutritious SLOWPOKETAIL?\pFor you right now, just\n¥1,000,000!\pYou'll want this!$

label: Route32_Text_ThoughtKidsLoaded
source: Tch! I thought kids\nthese days were loaded…$

label: Route32_Text_RefusedSlowpokeTail
source: You don't want it?\nThen scram. Shoo!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherJustin_Seen
source: Whoa!\pYou made me lose that fish!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherJustin_Beaten
source: Sploosh!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherJustin_After
source: Calm, collected… The essence of\nfishing and POKéMON is the same.$

label: Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_Seen
source: I'm really good at both\nfishing and POKéMON.\pI'm not about to lose to any kid!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_Beaten
source: Tch! I tried to rush\nthings…$

label: Route32_Text_FisherRalph1_After
source: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$

label: Route32_Text_RalphRegister
source: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$

label: Route32_Text_RalphRematchIntro
source: I'm really good at both\nfishing and POKéMON.\pI'm not about to lose to any kid!$

label: Route32_Text_RalphRematchDefeat
source: Tch! I tried to rush\nthings…$

label: Route32_Text_RalphPostRematch
source: Fishing is a lifelong\npassion.\pPOKéMON are lifelong friends!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherHenry_Seen
source: My POKéMON? Freshly caught!$

label: Route32_Text_FisherHenry_Beaten
source: SPLASH?$

label: Route32_Text_FisherHenry_After
source: Freshly caught POKéMON are\nno match for properly raised ones.$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_Seen
source: I haven't seen you around before.\nSo you think you are pretty tough?$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_Beaten
source: You're strong!$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterAlbert_After
source: I'm going to try to be the\nbest with my favorites.\pI'm not using the same tough\nPOKéMON as everyone else.$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_Seen
source: I found some good POKéMON\nin the grass!\pI think they'll do it for me!$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_Beaten
source: Darn. I thought I could win.$

label: Route32_Text_YoungsterGordon_After
source: The grass is full of\nclingy things.$

label: Route32_Text_CamperRoland_Seen
source: That glance… It's intriguing.$

label: Route32_Text_CamperRoland_Beaten
source: Hmmm. This is disappointing.$

label: Route32_Text_CamperRoland_After
source: If you don't want to battle,\njust avoid eye contact.$

label: Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_Seen
source: Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know…\pPardon? Battle? I'm on the phone.\nOh, all right. But make it fast.$

label: Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_Beaten
source: Oh! I've got to relieve\nmy anger!$

label: Route32_Text_PicnickerLiz1_After
source: I was having a nice chat too.$

label: Route32_Text_LizRegister
source: I was having a nice chat too.$

label: Route32_Text_LizRematchIntro
source: Uh-huh. Yeah, and you know…\pPardon? Battle? I'm on the phone.\nOh, all right. But make it fast.$

label: Route32_Text_LizRematchDefeat
source: Oh! I've got to relieve\nmy anger!$

label: Route32_Text_LizPostRematch
source: I was having a nice chat too.$

label: Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_Seen
source: That BADGE! It's from VIOLET CITY!\nYou beat FALKNER?$

label: Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_Beaten
source: I know what my weaknesses are.$

label: Route32_Text_BirdKeeperPeter_After
source: I should train again at the\nGYM in VIOLET CITY.$

label: Route32_Text_RoarIntro
source: WROOOOAR! PEOPLE RUN WHEN I\nROAR! BUT YOU CAME LOOKING!\pTHAT PLEASES ME! NOW TAKE THIS!$

label: Route32_Text_RoarOutro
source: WROOOOAR! IT'S ROAR!\pEVEN POKéMON RUN FROM A GOOD\nROAR!$

label: Route32_Text_MeetFrieda
source: FRIEDA: Yahoo!\pI'm FRIEDA of the WEEKDAY FAMILY!\nNice to meet you!\pIf you can guess my favorite day,\nI'll give you a reward.$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaGivesGift
source: Here's a POISON BARB for you!$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaGaveGift
source: FRIEDA: Give it to a POKéMON\nthat has POISON-type moves.\pOh!\pIt's wicked!\pYou'll be shocked how good it\nmakes poison moves!$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaFriday
source: FRIEDA: Hiya! What day do\nyou like?\pI love Friday. No doubt about\nit!\pDon't you think it's great too?$

label: Route32_Text_FriedaNope
source: FRIEDA: Not that one!$

label: Route32_Text_Sign1
source: ROUTE 32\pVIOLET CITY - AZALEA TOWN$

label: Route32_Text_Sign2
source: RUINS OF ALPH\nEAST ENTRANCE$

label: Route32_Text_Sign3
source: UNION CAVE\nAHEAD$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruQuestion
source: This is a great fishing spot.\pYou saw people fishing?\nHow about you?\pWould you like one of my RODS?$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruYes
source: Heh, that's good to hear.\pNow you're an angler too!$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruGiveRod
source: Fishing is great!\pIf there's water, be it the sea or\na stream, try out your ROD.$

label: Route32_Pokecenter_Text_FishingGuruNo
source: Oh. That's rather disappointing…$

source:
That there's SNATCH.\pIt's a tricky move that lets
a POKéMON steal a foe's move\lright before it's used.\pIf more than one POKéMON use
SNATCH, only the slowest one\lwill end up stealing the move.\pUse it smart, hon. Timing is
everything.$

label: Route39_Text_ChooseLegend
source: BAOBA: GOOD HEAVENS! Did that\nshadow belong to a POKéMON?\pDid you get a good look at it?\nI can't tell what color it was...$

label: Route39_Text_BaobaIntro
source:
How strange...\p...Ohh!
What you are holding is...\lwhat they call... a POKéDEX!\pHaven't seen one of those in ages.\pMy name is BAOBA!
I used to run a SAFARI ZONE in\lFUCHSIA CITY, but it was becoming\lout of date with new entertainment\loptions coming out.\pI decided to go overseas to learn
the newest technology and open a\lstate-of-the-art SAFARI ZONE\lin CIANWOOD.\pIt may be more than a coincidence
that we are chatting.\pWhy don't we register each other's
numbers in the POKéGEAR?\pI can give you a call once the
SAFARI ZONE is open before I call\lanyone else!$

label: Route39_Text_Registered
source: {PLAYER} registered BAOBA\nin the POKéGEAR!$

label: Route39_Text_WillCall

label: Route39_Text_SailorEugeneBeaten

label: Route39_Text_SailorEugeneAfter

label: Route39_Text_PokefanFJaimeBeaten
source: Oh, how disappointing…$

I met UMBREON at night right
here on ROUTE 39.\pI'm not sure why, but it

by training here than\lanywhere else.$

label: Route40_Text_StandingYoungster

Have you gone to the TRAINER
HILL?\pI think a lot of tough trainers
have gathered there already.\pBut since you have so many BADGES

source: What's the secret to your\nstrength?$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkSeen
source: The waves are wild here.\pThey tire you out while\nyou swim.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkBeaten
source: I'm beat!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermKirkAfter
source: The currents keep me from\nreaching that island.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewBeaten
source: Ooh, you've got great endurance!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmermMathewAfter

source: I'm on my way to WHIRL ISLANDS.\pI'm going exploring with friends.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKayleeBeaten

source: You look so elegant,\nriding your POKéMON.$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieBeaten
source: I'm crushed…$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfSusieAfter

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfDeniseBeaten
source: Ohhh!$

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraBeaten

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfKaraAfter

label: Route41_Text_SwimmerfWendyBeaten

myths.\pI've heard so many stories

source: My POKéMON weren't spunky enough!$

source: Boy, do I love HP UP! Mmmm, yum!\pI keep drinking my POKéMON's!\pI can't help it!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParrySeen
source: My POKéMON are power packed!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParryBeaten
source: Wahahah! I'm the big loser!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParryAfter
source: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$

label: Route45_Text_ParryRegister
source: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$

label: Route45_Text_ParryRematchIntro
source: My POKéMON are power packed!$

label: Route45_Text_ParryRematchDefeat
source: Wahahah! I'm the big loser!$

label: Route45_Text_ParryPostRematch
source: I'm not much good at thinking,\nsee?\pSo, I just plow ahead with power!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerTimothySeen
source: Why do I climb mountains?\pBecause they're there.\pWhy do I train POKéMON?\pBecause they're there!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerTimothyBeaten
source: Losses… They're there too!$

label: Route45_Text_HikerTimothyAfter
source: The best thing to ever happen to\nme was discovering POKéMON.$

label: Route45_Text_HikerParryGivesIron
source: I just can't find a way to win!\pKeep it up!\pOh, and take this -- it's the\ngift you couldn't take when we\nlast met.$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiSeen
source: I was training here alone.\pBehold the fruits of my labor!$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiBeaten
source: Waaaargh!$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiAfter
source: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiRegister
source: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiRematchIntro
source: I was training here alone.\pBehold the fruits of my labor!$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiRematchDefeat
source: Waaaargh!$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiPostRematch
source: This calls for extreme measures.\pI must take to the hills and train\nin solitude.$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiHasItem
source: Hey! I'm taking a break from\ntraining.\pI found something good while I\nwas out. Here, take it!$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiGaveItem
source: Use it well!\pI need to get back to my\ntraining. Oooooaaarrrgh!$

label: Route45_Text_KenjiNoRoom
source: Hmm, your BAG is full.\pCome back when you have room.$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiMorning
source: I'm going to train a bit more\nbefore I break for lunch.$

label: Route45_Text_BlackbeltKenjiNight
source: We had plenty of rest at lunch, so\pnow we're all ready to go again!\pWe're going to train again!$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanSeen
source: What are your thoughts on\nraising POKéMON?$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanBeaten
source: You've won my respect.$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainermRyanAfter
source: I see you're raising your POKéMON\nwith care.\pThe bond you build will save you\nin tough situations.$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellySeen
source: What is your battle strategy?\pIt is foolish to use strong moves\nindiscriminately.$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellyBeaten
source: Fine. I lost.$

label: Route45_Text_CooltrainerfKellyAfter
source: I'm not in favor of overly\npowerful moves.\pI want to win, but I also don't\nwant to harm POKéMON.$

label: Route45_Text_CamperQuentinSeen
source: I'm really, really tough!$

label: Route45_Text_CamperQuentinBeaten
source: I was tough at the TRAINER HILL…$

label: Route45_Text_CamperQuentinAfter
source: Have you been to the TRAINER HILL?\pI never, ever lose there, but…$

label: Route45_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 45\nMOUNTAIN RD. AHEAD$

label: Route46_Text_HikerBaileySeen
source: Awright! I'll show you the\npower of mountain POKéMON!$

label: Route46_Text_HikerBaileyBeaten
source: Mercy! You showed me your\npower!$

label: Route46_Text_HikerBaileyAfterBattle
source: It's over. I don't mind.\nWe HIKERS are like that.$

label: Route46_Text_CamperTedSeen
source: I'm raising POKéMON too!\pWill you battle with me?$

label: Route46_Text_CamperTedBeaten
source: Wha…?$

label: Route46_Text_CamperTedAfterBattle
source: I did my best but came up\nshort.\pNo excuses--I admit I lost.$

label: Route46_Text_PicnickerErinSeen
source: I raise POKéMON too!\pWill you battle with me?$

label: Route46_Text_PicnickerErinBeaten
source: Oh, rats!$

label: Route46_Text_PicnickerErinAfterBattle
source: I've been to many GYMS, but the\nGYM in GOLDENROD is my favorite.\pIt's filled with pretty flowers!$

label: Route46_Text_ErinRegister
source: I've been to many GYMS, but the\nGYM in GOLDENROD is my favorite.\pIt's filled with pretty flowers!$

label: Route46_Text_ErinRematchIntro
source: I raise POKéMON too!\pWill you battle with me?$

label: Route46_Text_ErinRematchDefeat
source: Oh, rats!$

label: Route46_Text_ErinPostRematch
source: I've been to many GYMS, but the\nGYM in GOLDENROD is my favorite.\pIt's filled with pretty flowers!$

label: Route46_Text_PicnickerErin2Beaten
source:
Aww… I keep losing all the time!\pI'll just have to try harder!
Anyway, thanks for battling
me again and again.\pHere's that present from the
other time.$

label: Route46_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 46\nMOUNTAIN RD. AHEAD$

label: Route47_Text_HikerSeen
source: Longing for others is...\nwhat it is. \pBut battles are battles,\nso let's go!$

label: Route47_Text_HikerBeaten
source: Wahaha!$

label: Route47_Text_HikerAfter
source: After a battle you should always leave\nwith a parting laugh!$

label: Route47_Text_CamperSeen
source: I'm not good with large crowds, so\nI'm camping out here with my\lPOKéMON!$

label: Route47_Text_CamperBeaten
source: I should be headed deeper into the\nmountain I guess...$

label: Route47_Text_CamperAfter
source: See ya!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1Seen
source: THOM: One plus one is two. But the\ntwo of us together is much\lstronger!\pKAE: The two of us aren't just some\nboring pair!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1Beaten
source: THOM: That wasn't what I expected.\lKAE: You're unusual too!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1After1
source: THOM: It seems your power is\nimpossible to predict!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple1After2
source: KAE: I figured you were an ordinary\nlone trainer. Boy was I wrong!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2Seen
source: DUFF: Watching over my girlfriend\nmakes my heart soar!\pEDA: My heart's feelings for my\nboyfriend are as wide and deep\lthe ocean!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2Beaten
source: DUFF: I was no match for you...\lEDA: You are really something...$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2After1
source: DUFF: Thank you for the awe-\ninspiring battle! Bye!$

label: Route47_Text_Couple2After2
source: EDA: You should really find a\nwonderful partner, too!$

label: EmbeddedTower_Text_OldManIntro
source:
Well, hello!\pIt's said that past this hole used to
be a huge tower reaching far into\lthe sky.\pThey say that it was a rather strange
tower with half of it embedded\lin the cliff.\pIt was not just a tall tower reaching
up to the sky, but also reaching deep\ldown underground!\pIt is rumored that it even reached
the bottom of the ocean!\pIn short, the ruins used to connect
the sky, the land, and the sea to\leach other...\pMost of the tower is now crumbled,
and the only things that remain are\lthe entrance and its interior, where\lyou'll see strange patterns.$

label: Route47_Text_Chinchou
source: CHINCHOU: Chou!$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarDefeat
source: OKAY, you can have the PLATE.$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarAfter
source: As cool as that PLATE is,\nyou earned it fair and square.\pI'll just buy something at the gift\nshop instead.$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarBeforeBattle
source: What?\pYou want the PLATE?\nIt's an artifact imbued with an\lancient power with a connection\lto the legendary POKéMON?!\pWell now I'm definitely keeping it.\pFine.\pYou'll just have to battle me for it.$

label: Route49_Text_SkylarBefore
source: When I was hitting the slopes, my\nskis snagged on something.\pIt was this strange SKY-blue PLATE.\pI think I'll hold onto it as a\nsouvenir!$

label: Route49_Text_SkierM
source: Hey, watch out for my board!\pWhat? You want to battle?\nNo way, these slopes are too wicked!$

label: Route49_Text_KimonoGirl
source: You....\pYou must be {PLAYER}, correct?\nI've heard all about you and\lyour deeds from my cousins\lin ECRUTEAK CITY.\pMy sisters wish to meet with you.\lIf you find the time, please\nseek us out in the town up ahead.$

label: Route49_Text_Sign
source: The sign is faded.\nROUTE 49$

label: Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_Seen
source: I'm raising my POKéMON. Want to battle\nwith me?$

label: Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_Beaten
source: Ack! I lost that one…$

label: Route4_Text_BirdKeeperHank_AfterBattle
source: If you have a specific POKéMON that you\nwant to raise, put it out first, then\lswitch it right away.\pThat's how to do it.$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_Seen
source: I have a feeling that I can win.\pLet's see if I'm right!$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_Beaten
source: Aww, you are too strong.$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerHope_AfterBattle
source: I heard CLEFAIRY appear at MT.MOON.\pBut where could they be?$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerSharon_Seen
source: Um…\nI…$

label: Route4_Text_PicnickerSharon_AfterBattle
source: ……I'll go train some more…$

label: Route4_Text_MtMoonSquareSign
source: MT.MOON NEW ENTRANCE\nDUE TO CAVE-IN\pWATCH YOUR STEP$

label: Route50_Text_BlackBelt1
source: The body must be hardened\nand the mind strengthened\lin the harshest of conditions!$

label: Route50_Text_BlackBelt2
source: Phew!\pI'm not as hardcore as he is.\pThere's really not much else\nto do here but train.$

label: Route50_Text_WesselBefore
source:
Incredible, A VOLTORB!\pBut it appears to be made
of... Wood?\pMy hypothesis that this route
would contain many STEEL TYPE\lPOKéMON is disproven yet again.\pBut why else would I have found
this STEEL PLATE here?\pI must collect more data!$

label: Route50_Text_WesselBeforeBattle
source: You want this PLATE?\nBut I haven't analyzed it yet!\pFine, we will battle for it.$

label: Route50_Text_WesselDefeat
source: My hypothesis was wrong...$

label: Route50_Text_WesselAfter
source: Take the PLATE. I don't want to\ntalk about it.$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyBefore
source:
How are the villagers treating
you?\pThey can be very unwelcoming to
strangers.\pBut meeting new people is one
of life's greatest joys.\pOne day, I hope to meet CHAMPION
LANCE.\pHe is a legendary dragon tamer,
much like myself.\lWho am I?\pWell, I am FINLEY, keeper of the
DRACO PLATE.$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyBeforeBattle
source: I know the KIMONO's have sent you\nto collect these PLATES.\pThey say you are worthy...\nBut can you conquer my dragons?$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyDefeat
source: My dragons fought well.$

label: Route50_Text_FinleyAfter
source: Perhaps you are even strong enough\nto beat LANCE...$

label: Route5_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: UNDERGROUND PATH\pCERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY$

label: Route5_House_Text_Granny1
source: Eeyaaaah!\pI sense a sinister shadow\nhovering over you.\lTake this to ward it off!$

label: Route5_House_Text_Granny2
source: You were in mortal danger, but\nyou're protected now.$

label: Route5_House_Text_Woman
source: My grandma is into warding off what\nshe believes to be evil spirits.\pI'm sorry that she startled you.$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToTakeALookAtYours
source: きみの\nみてみるかね？$

label: Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_CantAcceptMonWithHM
source: わるいけど　ひでんのわざを　もった\nポケモンは　あずかれないなぁ$

label: Route6_Text_PokefanM
source: The road is closed until the\nproblem at the POWER PLANT is\lsolved.$

label: Route6_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: UNDERGROUND PATH\pCERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY$

label: PokefanM_Text_RexSeen
source: My STANTLER is the cutest in the\nworld.$

label: PokefanM_Text_RexBeaten
source: My STANTLER!$

label: PokefanM_Text_RexAfter
source: Look how adorable my STANTLER\nacts!\pIsn't it cute enough to make\nyour heart melt?$

label: PokefanM_Text_AllanSeen
source: My GRANBULL is the cutest in the\nworld.$

label: PokefanM_Text_AllanBeaten
source: My GRANBULL!$

label: PokefanM_Text_AllanAfter
source: Look how adorable my GRANBULL\nacts!\pIsn't it cute enough to make\nyour heart melt?$

label: Route7_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: What's this flyer?\p… Uncouth trainers have been\nholding battles in the\lUNDERGROUND PATH.\pBecause of rising complaints by\nlocal residents, the UNDERGROUND\lPATH has been sealed indefinitely.\pCELADON POLICE$

label: Route7_Text_LockedDoor
source: It's locked…$

label: Route8_Text_BikerDwayneSeen
source: We're the KANTO POKéMON FEDERATION\ntrainer group.\pWe'll drive you under our wheels!$

label: Route8_Text_BikerDwayneBeaten
source: S-sorry!$

label: Route8_Text_BikerDwayneAfter
source: The KANTO POKéMON FEDERATION will\nnever fall!$

label: Route8_Text_BikerHarrisSeen
source: The cops shut down our\nUNDERGROUND PATH!\pThat really fries me!$

label: Route8_Text_BikerHarrisBeaten
source: F-forgive me!$

label: Route8_Text_BikerHarrisAfter
source: Wiped out by some punk from\nJOHTO…$

label: Route8_Text_BikerZekeSeen
source: We're the KANTO POKéMON FEDERA-\nTION!\nRight on!$

label: Route8_Text_BikerZekeBeaten
source: Yikes! Sorry!$

label: Route8_Text_BikerZekeAfter
source: We'll try not to disturb anyone\nfrom now on…$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdSamSeen
source: How does the MAGNET TRAIN work?$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdSamBeaten
source: I just want to see the MAGNET\nTRAIN…$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdSamAfter
source: The power of magnets is awesome!$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdTomSeen
source: Hm… You've got many GYM BADGES.$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdTomBeaten
source: Just as I thought… You're tough!$

label: Route8_Text_SupernerdTomAfter
source: GYM BADGES give you advantages in\nbattles.$

label: Route8_Text_LockedDoor
source: It's locked…$

label: Route8_Text_UndergroundPathSign
source: The flyer's torn.\pIt's impossible to read…$

label: Route9_Text_CamperDeanSeen
source: I came to explore ROCK TUNNEL.$

label: Route9_Text_CamperDeanBeaten
source: Whoa! Danger, man.$

label: Route9_Text_CamperDeanAfter
source: My POKéMON were hurt before even\nentering ROCK TUNNEL.\pI'd better take them to a POKéMON\nCENTER right away.$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerHeidiSeen
source: Have you ever been to a picnic?\pThey're so much fun!$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerHeidiBeaten
source: Ohhhh!$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerHeidiAfter
source: We bake lots of goodies and share\nthem all around.\pThey're delicious!$

label: Route9_Text_CamperSidSeen
source: Hey, you! Don't litter!$

label: Route9_Text_CamperSidBeaten
source: I was just pointing out…$

label: Route9_Text_CamperSidAfter
source: Sorry. You weren't littering. It\nwas my mistake.$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerEdnaSeen
source: People shouldn't leave any litter\nbehind.$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerEdnaBeaten
source: Ohh… I lost…$

label: Route9_Text_PicnickerEdnaAfter
source: Conserving energy is important,\nbut the environment is even more\lvital.$

label: Route9_Text_HikerTimSeen
source: She'll be coming 'round MT.SILVER\nwhen she comes…\pMT.SILVER is in JOHTO, right?$

label: Route9_Text_HikerTimBeaten
source: I was too busy singing…$

label: Route9_Text_HikerTimAfter
source: Battles are about concentration.$

label: Route9_Text_HikerSidneySeen
source: I'll tell you a secret.\pBut first, we battle!$

label: Route9_Text_HikerSidneyBeaten
source: Oh, dang! I lost that…$

label: Route9_Text_HikerSidneyAfter
source: The POWER PLANT is across a small\nriver.$

label: Route9_Text_Sign
source: ROUTE 9\pCERULEAN CITY - ROCK TUNNEL$

label: Route9_PokemonCenter_Text_Engineer1
source: Sometimes us engineers come here\nfor our break. Or just to get away\lfrom our MANAGER.\pThat guy is crazy.$

label: Route9_PokemonCenter_Text_Engineer2
source: The POWER PLANT is very remote, so\nI travel far for work.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Presence
source: There is a strange presence here.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Hiker
source: This is a big room, but there's\nnothing here.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Teacher
source: This place has a mystical\nquality to it.\pIt feels sort of ethereal\neven.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_B1F_Text_Gramps
source: Ancient buildings are often\ntombs of kings.\pLike the pyramids, for\ninstance.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_Scientist1
source: The RUINS are about 1500 years old.\pBut it's not known why they were\nbuilt--or by whom.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_Scientist2
source: There are odd patterns drawn on\non the walls of the RUINS.\pThey must be the keys for\nunraveling the RUINS' mystery.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_Fossils
source: Fossils found within the RUINS.\nMaybe there are more somewhere...$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
source: We're developing a device for talking\nwith POKéMON.\pBut we haven't had much success…$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
source: I'm developing new kinds of\nPOKé BALLS…\pBut I haven't made much headway…$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
source:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!\pThe REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.\pThe TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.\pBoth are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.\pPlease give them a try!$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_IMadePokenav
source: I made the POKéNAV!\pAs an engineer, I feel blessed to have\nmade something so great!$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
source:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!\pIt came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about\lthe feelings of POKéMON.\pWould you like me to describe its
features in detail?\pNo, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
source: I'm trying to develop a device that\nvisually reproduces the dreams of\lPOKéMON…\pBut it's not going well.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
source: I've been trying to develop a device\nthat resurrects POKéMON from fossils…\pAnd, it's working!$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
source:
Wait! That thing you have there…
Is that a POKéMON fossil?\pWould you like to bring that POKéMON
back to life?\pI can with my newly developed
FOSSIL REGENERATOR.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_OhIsThatSo
source: Oh, is that so?\pMy technological expertise\nis outstanding, I tell you.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_OhIsThatSo2
source: Oh, you don't have this fossil.\nCome back if you manage to find it.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
source:
Oh, now that's a surprise!
You have more than one fossil?\pUnfortunately, my machine can only
regenerate one POKéMON at a time.\pWhich fossil would you like to
regenerate?$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
source: Excellent!\nLet's do this right away.\p{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to\nthe RUINS RESEARCHER.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
source:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.\pBut it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.\pSo, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
source: Thanks for waiting!\pYour fossilized POKéMON has been\nbrought back to life!\pThe fossil was an ancient POKéMON.\n{STR_VAR_2}, it was!$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
source: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from\nthe RESEARCHER.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_TooManyPokemon
source: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON.\nYou have no room for this one.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
source: I'm trying to develop a new feature\nfor the POKéNAV…\pBut it's not going well.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Lab_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
source:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?\pOur company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.\pOne couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Quagsire
source: QUAGSIRE: Quag Quag$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Scientist
source:
Hm? That's a POKéDEX, isn't it?
May I see it?\pThere are so many kinds of
POKéMON.\pHm? What's this?\pWhat is this POKéMON?\pIt looks like the strange
writing on the walls of the\pRUINS.\pIf those drawings are really
POKéMON, there should be many
more.\pI know! Let me upgrade your
POKéDEX. Follow me.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_SuperNerdStan_Seen
source: What do you want? I'm studying--\ndon't disturb me!$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_SuperNerdStan_Beaten
source: Sorry…\nI'm frustrated by our lack of\preal understanding…$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_SuperNerdStan_After
source: The RUINS are from about 1500\nyears ago.\pNobody knows who built them.\pIt's also not known if the POKéMON\nstatues have any meaning.\pIt's all one big mystery…$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_PsychicNathan_Seen
source: Hmmm… This is a strange place.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_PsychicNathan_After
source: I like thinking here.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_MysteryChamberSign
source: MYSTERY STONE PANEL CHAMBER$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_MainSign
source: RUINS OF ALPH\nVISITORS WELCOME$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_ResearchSign
source: RUINS OF ALPH RESEARCH CENTER\pTHE AUTHORITY ON THE\nRUINS OF ALPH$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Fisher1
source: While exploring the RUINS, we\nsuddenly noticed an odd presence.\pWe all got scared and ran away.\nYou should be careful too.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Fisher2
source: The RUINS hide a huge secret!\p…I think…$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Youngster1
source: There are many kinds of UNOWN, so\nwe use them for our secret codes.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_Outside_Text_Youngster2
source: A… H… E… A… D… Hmm…\pWhat?\pI'm decoding this message!$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Reward
source: The chamber reacts!\nThe way is open.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Mon
source: Some kind of ancient sensor.\nWhat is it looking for?$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Solved
source: The way is open.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Receptionist1
source:
Welcome to this chamber.\pThere are sliding panels that depict
a POKéMON drawn by the ancients.\pSlide the panels around to form
the picture.\pTo the left is a description of
the POKéMON.\pScientists in the lab are examin-
-ing some newly found patterns.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Receptionist2
source: A hole just opened up in the floor!\nI'd better tell the others.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Receptionist3
source: Now a hole in the wall too?!\nThis is getting spooky.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Kabuto
source: A POKéMON that hid on the sea floor.\nEyes on its back scanned the area.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_UnownText
source: It's UNOWN text!$

source: It's a replica of an ancient\nPOKéMON.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Aerodactyl
source: This flying POKéMON attacked its\nprey with saw-like fangs.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Omanyte
source: This POKéMON drifted in the sea\nby twisting its ten tentacles.$

label: RuinsOfAlph_PuzzleAndRewardChambers_Text_Hooh
source: A POKéMON that flew gracefully on\nrainbow-colored wings.$

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
source:
BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked
by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\pI bet he was on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\p{PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?
Have you filled in any pages yet?\pMine rules.\pWant to have a battle to test how
far you've progressed?$

label: RustboroCity_Text_CitySign
source: RUSTBORO CITY\p“The city probing the integration of\nnature and science.”$

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
source:
MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that
EXP. SHARE will be given some of the\lEXP Points from battle.\pIt will get EXP Points even if it didn't
actually battle.\pI would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful
for raising weak POKéMON.$

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
source:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.\pLet me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.\pI've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.\pMore specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.\pOh, what's that?
It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?\pThat's pretty impressive, I'd say, for
a starting TRAINER like yourself.\pBut, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.\pIt's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.$

label: SafariZone_Text_ForeignFeeling
source: SAFARI ZONE...\nIt makes me feel like I am in a\lforeign country.\pIt brings up a strange feeling.$

label: SafariZone_Text_JigglypuffTrainer
source: This SAFARI ZONE is great!\nI just kept going after POKéMON!\pThat made my JIGGLYPUFF upset though.$

label: SafariZone_Text_FirstCatch
source: I have always wanted to catch my first\nPOKéMON at the SAFARI ZONE.$

label: SafariZone_Text_SlowpokeFan
source: There are many POKéMON to choose from,\nbut nothing beats the cuteness of\lSLOWPOKE.\pPeople often say that I look like one!$

label: SafariZone_Text_CustomSystem
source: You may be under the impression there\nis a sophisticated system to\lcustomizing the SAFARI ZONE, right?\pThe real truth is that...$

label: SafariZone_Text_Sign
source: SAFARI ZONE\nThis is where everything is thrilling.\pFeel free to come by and experience\nthe wild!$

label: SafariZoneGate_Text_VitaminGuruSellWhatYouNeed
source: I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and\nsell you what you need!$

label: SafariZoneGate_PokemonCenter_Text_NPC1
source: Those who come to a POKéMON CENTER\noften take good care of their POKéMON.\pWouldn't you agree?$

label: SafariZoneGate_PokemonCenter_Text_NPC2
source: After a long walk in the mountains to\nfind a POKéMON CENTER, when you're\ljust about to fall flat...\pThen it feels like you are in paradise!$

label: SafariZoneGate_PokemonCenter_Text_SafariSong
source: Safari, safari, it is so much fun.\nSafari, safari, so interesting, huh!\pSo many POKéMON are waiting for us!\p...That's a song I made up.\nI sing it when I am in the SAFARI ZONE.$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaBeachDone
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nHere, take this money to upgrade\lyour SAFARI LEVEL and show me an\lexotic POKéMON from the BRUSH area\lnext!$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaBrushDone
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nHere, take this money to upgrade\lyour SAFARI LEVEL and show me an\lexotic POKéMON from the MOUNTAIN\larea next!$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaMountainDone
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nHere, take this money to upgrade\lyour SAFARI LEVEL and show me an\lexotic POKéMON from the CAVE area\lnext!$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaCaveDone
source: Thank you, {PLAYER}!\nThat's all I need to see.\pNow that I know what DEVON is up\nto, I'll be able to keep my SAFARI\lcompetitive. Here, take this as a\lreward for your troubles.$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaWrong
source: That can't be right!$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaBeach
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pDid you bring an exotic POKéMON\nfrom the BEACH area of the FUCHSIA\lSAFARI ZONE to show me?$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaBrush
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pDid you bring an exotic POKéMON\nfrom the BRUSH area of the FUCHSIA\lSAFARI ZONE to show me?$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaMountain
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pDid you bring an exotic POKéMON\nfrom the MOUNTAIN area of the\lFUCHSIA SAFARI ZONE to show me?$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaCave
source: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pDid you bring an exotic POKéMON\nfrom the CAVE area of the FUCHSIA\lSAFARI ZONE to show me?$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaDeclined
source: What will I do now?\nWe'll never keep up with DEVON!$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaLastMon
source: I can't take your last POKéMON!$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaDone
source:
Ah, {PLAYER}!\pThanks to you, the SAFARI ZONE is
thriving!\pMaybe I should name you OWNER of
the safari zone...\pNo, that would be ridiculous.
Ahahahaha.$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaWelcome
source:
Hi {PLAYER}!
I've been waiting for you.
What do you think?\pThis is a brand new SAFARI ZONE
by the way...\pAnd it's still expanding!\pSo far, we have two zones open
and 4 more on the way!\pEnjoy the SAFARI ZONE! I'll
call you when the other zones\lare ready!$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BaobaPokeblocks
source: Oh! I almost forgot.\pPOKéBLOCKS are an essential\nfeature of my SAFARI ZONE, so\lyou'd better have one of these!$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Baoba
source: Hi {PLAYER}!\pHow are you enjoying the SAFARI\nZONE?$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Boy
source:
Do you know about POKéBLOCK
feeders?\pPutting a POKéBLOCK in the feeder
brings out POKéMON with HIDDEN\lABILITIES!\pThe type of POKéBLOCK also affects
the POKéMON's nature.\pAnd best of all, the type of POKéBLOCK
you use can attract POKéMON with\lperfect IVs!\pThose charts on the wall have all
the details.$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_BoyGiveCase
source: Here, you seem like you need this.$

label: SafariZoneGate_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Engineer
source: Sorry Trainer, this area is still\nunder construction. Check back\llater!$

label: SafariZone_East_Text_KeepAnyItemFoundOnSafari
source: You can keep any item you find in\nthe SAFARI ZONE.\pBut, you'll run out of time if you\ntry for all of them at once.$

label: CopycatsHouse1F_Text_PokefanF

label: CopycatsHouse1F_Text_PokefanF_ReturnedPart
source: She recently lost the POKé DOLL\nthat a boy gave her three years\lago.\pEver since then, she's gotten even\nbetter at mimicry…$

label: CopycatsHouse1F_Text_Blissey
source: BLISSEY: Bliisii!$

label: Copycat_Text_Male_1
source: {PLAYER}: Hi! Do you like POKéMON?\p{PLAYER}: Uh, no, I just asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Huh? You're strange!$

label: Copycat_Text_QuickMimicking
source: COPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?\pBut that's my favorite hobby!$

label: Copycat_Text_Male_2
source:
{PLAYER}: Hi! I heard that you
lost your favorite POKé DOLL.\p{PLAYER}: If I find it, you'll give
me a rail PASS?\p{PLAYER}: I'll go find it for you.\pYou think you lost it when you
went to VERMILION CITY?$

label: Copycat_Text_Worried
source: COPYCAT: Pardon?\pI shouldn't decide what you\nshould do?\pBut I'm really worried… What if\nsomeone finds it?$

label: Copycat_Text_GiveDoll
source: COPYCAT: Yay! That's my CLEFAIRY\nPOKé DOLL!\pSee the tear where the right leg\nis sewn on? That's proof!$

label: Copycat_Text_GivePass
source: OK. Here's the MAGNET TRAIN PASS\nlike I promised!$

label: Copycat_Text_ExplainPass
source: COPYCAT: That's the PASS for the\nMAGNET TRAIN.\pThe rail company man gave me\nthat when they tore down our old\lhouse for the STATION.$

label: Copycat_Text_Male_3
source: {PLAYER}: Hi! Thanks a lot for the\nrail PASS!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it that fun to mimic\nmy every move?$

label: Copycat_Text_ItsAScream
source: COPYCAT: You bet! It's a scream!$

label: Copycat_Text_Dodrio1
source: DODRIO: Gii giii!$

label: Copycat_Text_Dodrio2
source: MIRROR, MIRROR ON THE WALL,\nWHO'S THE FAIREST ONE OF ALL?$

label: Copycat_Text_2FDoll
source: This is a rare POKéMON! Huh?\pIt's only a doll…$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Falkner_Rematch
source:
Congratulations on defeating
the ELITE 4!\pI've been training my
FLYING-type POKéMON even harder.\pThink you can take on the power
of the skies again?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Falkner_RematchDefeat
source: Wow… You beat me again.\pI'm going to train harder to\nbecome the greatest bird master!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Bugsy_Rematch
source: Wow, you're the JOHTO CHAMPION\nnow!\pYour skills are truly impressive!\pI've been busy with my research.\pI'm ready to show you my new\nfindings.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Bugsy_RematchDefeat
source: Wow, you must be an expert\ntrainer.\pMy research must not be\ncomplete…$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Whitney_Rematch
source: Hi! It's you!\pWow, JOHTO CHAMPION now?\pYou really are amazing!\pI want to see how strong you are.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Whitney_RematchDefeat
source: Waaaaah!\pWaaaaah!\p…Snivel, hic… …You meanie!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Morty_Rematch
source:
Ah, the JOHTO CHAMPION! Good of
you to come.\pYou've shown your strength and
skill, but have you improved\lsince our last battle?\pI've been training with my
GHOST-type POKéMON.\pLet's see if you can overcome
the shadows once again.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Morty_RematchDefeat
source: I'm not good enough yet…\pYou have witnessed much more\nthan I.\pI envy you for that…$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Chuck_Rematch
source: WAHAHAH! JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYou've come back for more!\pI see your skills have improved!\pReady to see who's stronger?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Chuck_RematchDefeat
source: Wha? Huh? I lost? Again?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Jasmine_Rematch
source: …Congratulations, JOHTO\nCHAMPION.\pYou have become so strong…\pI wonder if I have improved.\pWould you like to test that?\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Jasmine_RematchDefeat
source: …You are a better trainer than\nme,\pin both skill and kindness.$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Pryce_Rematch
source: Ah, JOHTO CHAMPION!\pYour skills are indeed\nremarkable.\pI am impressed.\pBut even now, there is much to\nlearn from each other.\pI, PRYCE--the winter trainer--\pstill have a few tricks left.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Pryce_RematchDefeat
source: Ah, yet again I'm impressed by\nyour prowess.\pWith your strong will, I know\nyou will overcome all life's\lobstacles.$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Clair_Rematch
source: You did it, huh?\pYou are now the JOHTO CHAMP.\pYou've proven your strength but\ncan you handle me again?\pAs a Dragon Master, I won't hold\nback.\pNot this time.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Clair_RematchDefeat
source: I lost?\pAgain?\pI don't believe it. There must\nbe some mistake…$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Brock_Rematch
source: BROCK: Hey there, {PLAYER}!\pI heard you are now the KANTO\nCHAMPION.\pThat's incredible!\pYou must be even stronger now.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Brock_RematchDefeat
source: BROCK: Your POKéMON once again\novercame my rock-hard defense…$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Misty_Rematch
source: MISTY: Wow, you're the KANTO\nCHAMPION now!\pThat's amazing! You've come a\nlong way, {PLAYER}.\pBut I'm not backing down.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Misty_RematchDefeat
source: MISTY: You really are good…$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Surge_Rematch
source: SURGE: So, you're now KANTO\nCHAMPION!\pImpressive work, kid! But don't\nthink I'm done!\pHow about we have a go again?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Surge_RematchDefeat
source: SURGE: Arrrgh! You're still just\nas strong!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Erika_Rematch
source: ERIKA: Oh, hello.\pWhat a surprise, CHAMPION!\pIt's so lovely to see you again.\pYour journey must have been so\nexciting.\pEven champions enjoy a challenge.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Erika_RematchDefeat
source: ERIKA: Losing still leaves a\nbitter aftertaste…\pBut knowing that there are strong\ntrainers spurs me to do better…$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Sabrina_Rematch
source: SABRINA: Ah, the CHAMPION.\pI sensed your return.\pYour power has grown immensely.\pEven now, I feel your aura.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Sabrina_RematchDefeat
source: SABRINA: Your love for your\nPOKéMON again overwhelmed my\lpsychic power…$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Janine_Rematch
source: Fufufufu…\pWow, you did it!\pYou're the CHAMPION now!\pI'm so proud of you! But don't\nthink I'll go easy on you.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Janine_RematchDefeat
source: JANINE: You're still just as\ntough!\pYou definitely won…$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Blaine_Rematch
source: BLAINE: Whoa!\pI see you've become the KANTO\nCHAMPION!\pThat's blazing!\pYour skills are top-notch.\pI'm always up for a battle.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Blaine_RematchDefeat
source: BLAINE: Your skills are truly\nfiery!\pYou've burned right through my\ndefenses.$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Blue_Rematch
source: BLUE: Well, well. CHAMPION!\pLooks like you've come a long way.\pI used to have that title too,\nyou know. But I won't go easy.\pLet's see if you can keep it up.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojoVIP_Text_Blue_RematchDefeat
source: BLUE: What?\pHow the heck did I lose again?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Lickilicky
source: LICKILICKY: LIIIIICK!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Machamp
source: MACHAMP: CHAMP!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Steelix
source: STEELIX: GRRRIND!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Alakazam
source: ALAKAZAM: ZAM!$

source: SLOWKING: HMMM...$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Pidgeot
source: PIDGEOT: GEEEE!$

source: You enter the FIGHTING DOJO!\pHere, you may hone the stats of\nof your POKéMON by battle!$

source: Left: HP, DEFENSE, SPECIAL DEFENSE$

source: RIGHT: ATTACK, SPECIAL ATTACK, SPEED$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Text_Cooltrainer
source: Only trainers with all KANTO badges\nmay enter the VIP lounge.$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Finish_Text
source: That's it! You're welcome!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text1
source: Welcome! I'm the ABILITY EXPERT!\pI can swap POKéMON's abilities in\na heartbeat, only for 25.000¥!\pWould you like me to swap any\nPOKéMON's ability?$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text_No
source: Sure. I'll be here if you need me.$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text_Cant
source: I cannot do that. This POKéMON\ndoes not have a second ABILITY!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_Ability_Text_NoChampion
source: Welcome! I'm the ABILITY EXPERT!\pI can swap POKéMON's abilities\nin a heartbeat.\pUnfortunately, my back hurts and\nI can't work today.\pCome again later!$

label: SaffronCity_FightingDojo_SetZeroTextNoMoney
source: You don't have enough money.\pCome back when you have.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro
source:
SABRINA: I knew you were coming…\pThree years ago I had a vision
of your arrival.\pYou're after my BADGE.\pI don't enjoy battling, but it's
my duty as a LEADER to confer\lBADGES on anyone who has proven\lhim- or herself worthy.\pSince you wish it, I will show
you my psychic powers!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaWinLoss
source: SABRINA: Your power…\pIt far exceeds what I foresaw…\pMaybe it isn't possible to fully\npredict what the future holds…\pOK, you win. You earned yourself\nMARSHBADGE.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMarshBadge
source: {PLAYER} received MARSHBADGE.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MarshBadgeInfo
source:
SABRINA: MARSHBADGE draws out
your subliminal powers…\pAlthough I failed to accurately
predict your power, this much I\lknow to be true.\pYou will become a celebrated and
beloved CHAMPION!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_Sabrina_GiveTM
source: Here, take this as well.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_Sabrina_ExplainTM
source: It holds SKILL SWAP.\pIt can take your opponents' abilities\naway from them and give them your own.\pUse it wisely...$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle
source: SABRINA: Your love for your\nPOKéMON overwhelmed my psychic\lpower…\pThe power of love, I think, is\nalso a kind of psychic power…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRematch
source: SABRINA: Ah, the KANTO CHAMPION.\pI sensed your return.\pYour power has grown immensely.\pEven now, I feel your aura.\pWant to have a rematch with me?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaRematchDefeat
source: SABRINA: Your love for your\nPOKéMON again overwhelmed my\lpsychic power…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumRebeccaSeen
source: The power of all those you\ndefeated comes to me!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumRebeccaBeaten
source: Strong… Far too strong…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumRebeccaAfter
source: What is the source of your power?$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicFranklinSeen
source: Psychic power is the power of\nyour soul.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicFranklinBeaten
source: Your soul has more power than\nmine!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicFranklinAfter
source: You made your soul stronger, not\njust your abilities.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumDorisSeen
source: Fufufufu… I see it clearly.\pI can see into your soul!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumDorisBeaten
source: Though I read you, I still lost…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_MediumDorisAfter
source: Darn! I forgot that I predicted I\nwould lose to you.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicJaredSeen
source: The FIGHTING DOJO next door was\nonce this city's GYM.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicJaredBeaten
source: I was no match…$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PsychicJaredAfter
source: KARATE KING, the master of the\nFIGHTING DOJO, was just destroyed\lby SABRINA.$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideIntro
source: Yo, CHAMP in making!\pA trainer as skilled as you\ndoesn't need to be told how to\ldeal with PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,\lright?\pI expect great things from you!\pGood luck!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideWin
source: That was another fantastic battle!$

label: SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$
