label: VioletCity_Text_Elm_Call
source: PROF.ELM: Hello, {PLAYER}? We\ndiscovered something about the EGG!\pMy assistant is at the POKéMON\nCENTER in VIOLET CITY.\pCould you talk to him?$

label: VioletCity_Text_Kimono_Girl1
source: Me oh my...\nThat EGG must be...!$

label: VioletCity_Text_Kimono_Girl2
source: I see...\pSo it was handed from MR. POKéMON\nto PROF.ELM, then from \lPROF.ELM to you.\pNow I get it...$

label: VioletCity_Text_Kimono_Girl3
source: That EGG is truly an important EGG.\pPlease do take good care of it\nfor me. Is that understood?$

label: VioletCity_Text_Kimono_Girl4
source: I am counting on you.$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
source: I collect POKéMON!\nDo you have a {STR_VAR_1}?\pWant to trade it for my\n{STR_VAR_2}?$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare
source: Yay! I got myself {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you take care!$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon
source: Uh, no, I don't think so.\nThat isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe
source: You don't want to trade? Aww...$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_After
source: Hi, how's my old ONIX doing?$

label: VioletCity_House1_Text_PokefanM
source: A POKéMON you get in a trade\ngrows quickly.\pBut if you don't have the right\nGYM BADGE, they may disobey you.$

label: VioletCity_NicknameHouse_Text_Teacher
source: She uses the names of her\nfavorite things to eat.\pFor the nicknames she gives to\nher POKéMON, I mean.$

label: VioletCity_NicknameHouse_Text_Lass
source: I call my PIDGEY STRAWBERRY!$

label: VioletCity_NicknameHouse_Text_Bird
source: STRAWBERRY: Pijji!$

label: VioletCity_Mart_Text_Granny
source:
When you first catch a POKéMON,
it may be weak.\pBut it will eventually grow to
be strong.\pIt's important to treat POKéMON
with love.$

label: VioletCity_Mart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: POKéMON can hold items like\nPOTION and ANTIDOTE.\pBut they don't appear to know\nhow to use man-made items.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideFavor
source: {PLAYER}, long time, no see.\pPROF.ELM asked me to find you.\pHe has another favor to ask.\pWould you take the POKéMON EGG?$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideNoRoom
source: {PLAYER}, long time, no see.\pPROF.ELM asked me to find you.\pHe has another favor to ask.\pWould you take the POKéMON EGG?\pOh, wait... You need to make room\nin your party first.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideGiveEgg
source:
We discovered that a POKéMON won't
hatch until it grows in the EGG.\pIt also has to be with other
active POKéMON to hatch.\p{PLAYER}, you're the only person
we can rely on.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideGiveItem
source: Oh, and this might help when it hatches.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideFullParty
source: Oh, no. You can't carry any more\nPOKéMON with you.\pI'll wait here while you make\nroom for the EGG.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideEggToPC
source: Oh, but you can't carry any more\nPOKéMON with you.\pDon't worry--I sent the EGG to\nBILL'S PC for you.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_ElmsAideRefuse
source: B-but… PROF.ELM asked for you…$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_BooksAreGreat
source: While my POKéMON are recovering\nI love to read a good book.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_MobileAdapter
source: I just battled a friend in\nCIANWOOD over a link.\pIf you connect a MOBILE ADAPTER,\nyou can link with a friend far\laway.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_GameboyKid
source: A guy named BILL made the\nPOKéMON PC storage system.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_Gentleman
source: It was around three years ago.\pTEAM ROCKET was up to no good\nwith POKéMON.\pBut justice prevailed--a young\nkid broke 'em up.$

label: VioletCity_PokeCenter_Text_Youngster
source: POKéMON are smart. They won't\nobey a trainer they don't respect.\pWithout the right GYM BADGES,\nthey will just do as they please.$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Twin
source:
I'm not a GBA kid, but I love
playing POKéMON games!\pIn the old games, you had to battle
a lot of wild POKéMON to get enough\lEXP.\pBut in newer games, the EXP. SHARE
makes your POKéMON level up too fast.\pIn this game, the EXP. SHARE is
balanced to put your POKéMON at just\lthe right level. Or slightly higher,\ldepending on how many battles you do.\pIf you want a traditional GEN 1-4
experience, turn EXP. SHARE off.\lIf you want a modern experience,\lturn EXP. SHARE ON.\pYou choose how you want to play!$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_EarlIntro
source: EARL, I am!\pWonderful are POKéMON, yes!\pTeach you I will to be a better\ntrainer!$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Teacher
source:
Certain POKéMON start off weak and
require much more EXP to become\lstrong than others do.\pFor example, LARVITAR is quite weak
but will eventually become a\lmighty TYRANITAR, at the cost of\lmuch EXP.\pOnly the most dedicated trainers
should attempt to train such a\lPOKéMON.$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_TeachHowToWin
source: Good! Teach you, I will!\pIn battle, POKéMON top on list\njump out first!\pChange order in list, make\nbattle easy, maybe!\pMore from me you want to hear?$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_TeachMore
source: So, want to know how to raise\nPOKéMON well?$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_TeachRaiseWell
source:
Fine! Teach you, I will!\pIf POKéMON come out in battle
even briefly, some EXP. Points\pit gets.
At top of list put weak POKéMON\pSwitch in battle quick!
This way, weak POKéMON strong\pbecome!$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_NoMoreToTeach
source: Oh! Smart student you are!\nNothing more do I teach!\pIf you want more, talk to\npupils!$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Youngster1
source:
POKéMON previously thought to
only evolve through trade can\pevolve through leveling.
MACHOKE and GRAVELER evolve\pat LVL 38, while KADABRA and
HAUNTER evolve at LVL 42.\pSome items, like the METAL
COAT, have also been found to\pevolve certain POKéMON
while holding and leveling up.$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_GameboyKid1
source: Notable POKéMON available in an\narea can be seen in the overworld!\pBut make sure to check routes\nat DAY and NIGHT!$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_GameboyKid2
source:
BERRIES in the JOHTO region are
good for healing and making BALLS.\pBERRIES in KANTO are good for
reducing a POKéMON's stats.\pThe DOJO in KANTO helps POKéMON
perfect individual stats.$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Youngster2
source: Be aware that your opponents\nnow use teams with better type\lcoverage, so expect a much\lmore challenging journey ahead.$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Blackboard
source: The blackboard describes\nPOKéMON HM moves.\pHMs, once unlocked, don't need to\nbe taught to be used.$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook
source: It's this kid's notebook…\pCatch POKéMON using POKé BALLS.\pUp to six can be in your party.\pKeep reading?$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook1
source: Before throwing a POKé BALL,\nweaken the target first.\pA poisoned or burned POKéMON\nis easier to catch.\pKeep reading?$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook2
source: Some moves may cause confusion.\pConfusion may make a POKéMON\nattack itself.\pLeaving battle clears up any\nconfusion.\pKeep reading?$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_Notebook3
source:
People who catch and use
POKéMON in battle are POKéMON
trainers.\pThey are expected to visit
POKéMON GYMS and defeat other
trainers.\pThe next page is… Blank!\pBoy: E-he-he…\pI haven't written anymore…$

label: VioletCity_TrainerSchool_Text_StickerMachine
source: This super machine prints data\nout as stickers!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_BlueGotoDojo
source: BLUE: Back for more already?\pIf you want another shot at me,\ncome to the FIGHTING DOJO!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_Before
source:
BLUE: Yo! Finally got here, huh?\pI wasn't in the mood at CINNABAR,\pbut now I'm ready to battle you.\p…\pYou're telling me you conquered all
the GYMS in JOHTO?\pHeh! JOHTO's GYMS must be pretty
pathetic then.\pHey, don't worry about it.\pI'll know if you are good or not by
battling you right now.\pReady, JOHTO CHAMP?$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_Win
source: BLUE: What?\pHow the heck did I lose to you?\p…\pTch, all right… Here, take this--it's\nEARTHBADGE.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedEarthBadge
source: {PLAYER} received EARTHBADGE.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_After
source: BLUE: …\pAll right, I was wrong. You're the\nreal deal. You are a good trainer.\pBut I'm going to beat you someday.\pDon't you forget it!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_GiveTM
source: Take this with you.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_ExplainTM
source: That's TRICK ROOM.\pAll POKEMON in battle will change speed.\nSlow goes first. Fast goes last.\pUse it to turn a battle on its head.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_LeaderBlue_Epilogue
source: BLUE: Listen, you.\pYou'd better not lose until I beat\nyou. Got it?$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_Guide
source: Yo, CHAMP in making!\pHow's it going? Looks like you're on\na roll.\pThe GYM LEADER is a guy who battled\nthe CHAMPION three years ago.\pHe's no pushover.\pGive it everything you've got!$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_Guide_Win
source: Man, you are truly tough…\pThat was a heck of an inspirational\nbattle. It brought tears to my eyes.$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
source: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLUE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED$

label: ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon
source: VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLUE\pWINNING TRAINERS:\nBLUE, RED, {PLAYER}$

label: ViridianCity_Text_OakName
source: 大木$

label: ViridianCity_Text_OakCall
source: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\pCome and see my at my\nLAB in PALLET TOWN\lwhen you get the chance.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CoffeeGramps_Question
source:
Hey, kid! I just had a double shot
of espresso, and I am wired!\pI need to talk to someone, so you'll
have to do!\pI might not look like much now, but
I was an expert at catching POKéMON.\pDo you believe me?$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CoffeeGramps_Believed
source: Good, good. Yes, I was something\nout of the ordinary, let me tell\lyou!$

label: ViridianCity_Text_CoffeeGramps_Doubted
source: What? You little whelp!\pIf I were just a bit younger, I'd\nshow you a thing or two. Humph!$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GrampsNearGym
source: This GYM didn't have a LEADER\nuntil recently.\pA young man from PALLET became\nthe LEADER, but he's often away.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GrampsNearGym_BlueReturned
source: Are you going to battle the\nLEADER?\pGood luck to you. You'll need it.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_DreamEaterFisherNew
source: …Zzzzz…\pYawn!\pI must have dozed off in the sun.\pWhat? I remind you of somebody?\pI don't know, here, have this.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_DreamEaterFisher_GotTM
source: …Zzzzz…$

label: ViridianCity_Text_DreamEaterFisher
source: Yawn!\pI must have dozed off in the sun.\p…I had this dream about a DROWZEE\neating my dream. Weird, huh?\pHuh? What's this?\pWhere did this TM come from?\pThis is spooky! Here, you can have\nthis TM.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_DreamEaterFisher_GotDreamEater
source: TM42 contains DREAM EATER…\p…Zzzzz…$

label: ViridianCity_Text_Youngster
source: I heard that there are many items\non the ground in VIRIDIAN FOREST.$

label: ViridianCity_Text_Sign
source: VIRIDIAN CITY\pThe Eternally Green Paradise$

label: ViridianCity_Text_GymSign
source: VIRIDIAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: …\pThe rest of the text is illegible…$

label: ViridianCity_Text_WelcomeSign
source: WELCOME TO VIRIDIAN CITY,\pTHE GATEWAY TO INDIGO PLATEAU$

label: ViridianCity_Text_TrainerHouseSign
source: TRAINER HOUSE\pThe Club for Top Trainer Battles$

label: ViridianCity_House1_Text_PokefanM
source: Do you put a lot of thought into\nnaming your POKéMON?\pGiving them good nicknames adds to\nthe fun of trading with others.$

label: ViridianCity_House1_Text_Lass
source: They're SPEARY--a SPEAROW--and\nRATTEY--a RATTATA.$

label: ViridianCity_House1_Text_Speary
source: SPEARY: Ch-chun!$

label: ViridianCity_House1_Text_Rattey
source: RATTEY: Kikiii!$

label: ViridianMart_Text_Lass
source: The GYM LEADER here is totally cool.$

label: ViridianMart_Text_CooltrainerM
source: Have you been to CINNABAR?\pIt's an island way south of here.$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_Text_1FCooltrainerM
source: Where in the world is VIRIDIAN's GYM\nLEADER? I wanted to challenge him.$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_Text_1FCooltrainerM_BlueReturned
source: There are no GYM TRAINERS at the\nVIRIDIAN GYM.\pThe LEADER claims his policy is to\nwin without having any underlings.$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_Text_1FCooltrainerF
source: I heard that the GYM in CINNABAR is\ngone.\pI wonder what became of BLAINE, the\nGYM LEADER.$

label: ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_Text_1FBugCatcher
source: My dream is to become a GYM LEADER.$

label: ViridianForest_Text_Bugsy
source: BUGSY: I came to KANTO to look for\nBUG-TYPE POKéMON, so I can become\la stronger BUG-TYPE POKéMON\lTRAINER!\pIf you're ready for another match,\nI'll be at the DOJO in SAFFRON!$

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_AfterNotCaught
source: You have not only made LUGIA\nappear, but you have also defeated\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_AfterCaught
source: You have not only made LUGIA\nappear, but you have also caught\lit...\pThere is nothing more for us to\nsay. Take care of yourself in your\ljourney...$

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Zuki_Before
source: ZUKI: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Naoko_Before
source: NAOKO: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Miki_Before
source: MIKI: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Sayo_Before
source: SAYO: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kuni_Before
source: KUNI: Go, face LUGIA. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_Opening
source: KIMONO GIRL: That's right.\nThis is where we welcome LUGIA.\pWhen the dance we practiced many\ndays becomes one with the sound of the\lTidal Bell we entrusted to you, then\lLUGIA shall come out from deep within\lthe waterfall basin once again. $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_Closing1
source:
That is indeed LUGIA...
The guardian of these islands from\lancient times... \pSo many have tried again and again,
only to fail...\p{PLAYER}, your heart in complete
harmony with the Tidal Bell has finally\lallowed it to appear...
{PLAYER}, don't you see?\pLUGIA... It must have been waiting for
someone like you all this time.\pWouldn't you agree? $

label: WhirlIslands_LugiaChamber_Text_Kimono_After
source: KIMONO GIRL: You've proven yourself\ntoday, {PLAYER}.$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
source: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice!\nI see. I will do my best!\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
source:
Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}!
You spoke to me!\lI… I'm overjoyed!\pMe! My name is {STR_VAR_1}!
I just became a TRAINER!\pI'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER},
the big name in POKéMON circles!\pOh-oh-oh, I know!
May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?\pPlease take me in as your apprentice!
I want to learn from you!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
source:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
The police were looking for you!\p… … …
Of course I'm lying!\pMe, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way
I look, I'm the POKéMON CHAMPION!\l…That's a lie, too!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at battling.\pSo, how about you becoming my master
about all things POKéMON?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
source:
Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better!
I'll go to the other level, then!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks, master!
I hope you'll keep teaching me!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
source:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy, and it means hi!\pI'm {STR_VAR_1}, the rappin' SAILOR
am I!\pYour turn now, tell me a little about
yourself, give it a try!\pUh-huh, uh-huh!
{PLAYER}{KUN}'s your name,\land POKéMON's your game!\pAnd you're at a delicate age
when all the world's your stage!\pAnyway, I just want to say,
that you're the tenth TRAINER\lI've spoken to today.\pLet's make that a celebration!
Become my mentor for commemoration!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
source:
Say, hey, aren't you {PLAYER}?
What should I do? Talk to you?\lWhy not? I'm already talking to you!\p{PLAYER}, are you surprised at me?
I'd better tell you who I happen to be!\p{STR_VAR_1} is what you can call me.
The brightest star in guitardom,\lthat's me!\pAre you receiving me?
You are receiving me!\pMy luck's at its best,
I'll hit you with a request!\p{PLAYER}, let me be your underling!
I want you to teach me everything!$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
source: You're turning me down, then?\nI'll just have to ask you again!\p{PLAYER}, I beg to be your underling!\nI need you to teach me everything!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
source:
Oh, hi! You there!
Can I get you to massage my shoulder?\p…Yes, there! That's it!
Ouch, ouch! Oooh, that feels great!\pMy name's {STR_VAR_1}.
I take karate training, but my body's\lnot built to take the abuse…\pI decided I'll battle POKéMON and
toughen myself up.\pYou're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you?
The POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMP?\pListen, can I get you to give me
advice?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching13
source: Oh, why?\pI won't be a big bother, I promise!\nPlease?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
source: Hm, all right. That's {STR_VAR_1}.\nI'll go there right away.\pI hope I can keep hitting you up for\nhelp--after all, you're my mentor!$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
source:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…?\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me all self-conscious.\pI… I'm {STR_VAR_1}.\pI'm really embarrassed to say this,
but I explore ancient ruins and such.\pI'm even more embarrassed to admit
I'm interested in the BATTLE FRONTIER.\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, you have a reputation as
a tough TRAINER…\pIt's hard for me to say this,
but I want to ask something.\pCould you become my teacher and
give me advice?$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
source: Please don't brush me off like this!\nI can't live with the humiliation.\pPlease become my teacher!\nI need your advice!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
source:
Th-thank you…\pBut please don't look at me like that.
It makes me all flustered.\pPlease, answer me without looking
at my eyes.\pAt the BATTLE TOWER…
Which level should I attempt?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
source:
Oh… Okay!
I'll try my hand at that.\pI hope I can make a valiant challenge
without getting all flustered…\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
If we meet again, I hope you will be\las helpful.$

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
source:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really real?\pYou may call me {STR_VAR_1}.\pI have been toying with the idea of
apprenticing under a strong TRAINER.\pSo, I must say I'm lucky you came along!
…You really are {PLAYER}{KUN}, yes?\pNo, no, if you are real, it's fine.
I merely want you to recognize me\las your apprentice.$

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
source:
Oh?
But what would compel you to refuse?\pI apologize for being skeptical about
your identity.\pPlease accept my apology and
accept me as your apprentice.$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
source:
You really are accepting me?
I don't wish to celebrate prematurely.\pIf it is true, I apologize.
But now, I need your advice.\pIf I were to enter the BATTLE TOWER,
what would be worthy of me?\lLevel 50 or Open Level?$

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
source:
{STR_VAR_1}?
Are you certain?\pI see. If that's the case, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI realize I can annoy, but it delights
me that you have accepted me.\pLet us meet again!$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
source:
Sigh… Sob…
Oh, {PLAYER}!\pI'm all tangled up in a dilemma
that I can't decide.\pI can't decide what I should make
my {STR_VAR_1} hold.\pPlease tell me, {PLAYER}.
What item should I make it hold?$

label: gText_ApprenticeItemAlreadyRecommended1
source: Oh, uh, no, that's not what I meant.\nI want to know about a different item\lthan the ones I already know.\pOr do you mean that my POKéMON doesn't\nhave to hold anything this time?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem5
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pWe're both busy, but we seem to run
into each other often anyway!\pToday I have to do some walking,
cleaning, and brushing.\pI haven't even had the time to buy
my precious {STR_VAR_1} anything.\pI don't have any time, so how about
giving me advice on what I should make\lmy {STR_VAR_1} hold?$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem6
source:
Hiya, {PLAYER}! It's me!
I need to tap your mind again today.\lPlease, I need your advice!\pDrum roll, please!
The question I have is…\pIf I want to make my {STR_VAR_1} hold
an item, what should it be?$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksNoHeldItem7
source: I understand clearly now!\nI will keep trying like this.\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem7
source: One {STR_VAR_1} it is!\nI will order it right away.\pThank you, {PLAYER}.\nI hope I can count on you again.\lPlease take care!$

label: gText_ApprenticeThanksHeldItem8
source: {STR_VAR_1}! I'll use that!\pUm… Could it be, {PLAYER}, you also\nmake your POKéMON hold that item?\pI'll be sure to get it!\nI hope you'll be willing to teach me\lsome more another time.$

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem9
source:
Hola!
My maestro, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI want to hit you up for advice on
POKéMON tools.\pWhat do you think would be good for

source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}We have a customer, LANCE, who\noccasionally comes.\pHe always buys capes.\pI wonder… Does he have many\nidentical capes at home?$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Lance4
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}LANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Lance5
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}From what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\lsomewhere far away.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill0
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}After all, BILL's world-famous as a\nPOKéMANIAC.\pHe invented the POKéMON Storage\nSystem on PC, too.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill1
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill2
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill3
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves\nevery kind.\pApparently, the first one he caught\nwas an ABRA.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill4
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}BILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,\nwhere his folks still live.\pI've heard that it's quite the\nfestive, bustling city.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Bill5
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Apparently, BILL simply can't\nstomach milk at all.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji0
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}He's really kind.\pHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji1
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji2
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE\nMonthly Grand Prize Drawing!\pThe application form is…\pGone! It's been clipped out.\nSomeone must have applied already.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji3
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}There's a rumor…\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I hear that MR. FUJI's not from\nthese parts originally, either.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji4
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\pThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_MrFuji5
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Editor: The shy MR. FUJI turned\ndown our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored\nand respected in LAVENDER TOWN.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni0
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}TEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from\naround the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping\nour criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni1
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Those thugs that took over our\nbuilding…\pTheir BOSS said he was looking for\nstrong POKéMON.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni2
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What is this person like?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly\ncruel!\pTo him, POKéMON are just tools to\nbe used.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni3
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Welcome to my hideout!\pIt shall be so until I can restore\nTEAM ROCKET to its former glory.$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni4
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}What does this person do?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the\nGYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?$

label: gFameCheckerFlavorText_Giovanni5
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}Family and friends?\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,\nare you?\pNo, that can't be right.\nGIOVANNI's kid has red hair.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_ProfOak
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}PROF. OAK$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_ProfOak
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: PROF. OAK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Why do POKéMON compete and battle
so hard for you?\pThey do so because they can see
the love and trust you have\ltowards POKéMON.\pNever forget that.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Daisy
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}DAISY$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Daisy
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: DAISY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}While I was comfortably enjoying
my tea breaks, you've grown very\lskilled and powerful.\pI hope you'll remain a good rival
to my little brother.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Brock
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BROCK$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Brock
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BROCK
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}In this big world of ours, there
must be many tough TRAINERS.\pLet's both keep training and
making ourselves stronger!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Misty
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}MISTY$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Misty
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MISTY
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm going to keep training here at
this GYM.\pWhen I get better, I'd love to hit
the road and travel.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_LtSurge
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}LT. SURGE$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_LtSurge
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LT. SURGE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, kid!
You electrified me in our battle!\pI didn't know that there were
gutsy TRAINERS like you.\pIt made me change my mind about
you!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Erika
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}ERIKA$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Erika
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: ERIKA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I am so glad that there are strong
TRAINERS like you.\pThat awareness alone inspires and
motivates me to try harder.\pPlease visit me again.
Zzz…$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Koga
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}KOGA$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Koga
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: KOGA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}You and I, we must both set our\nsights higher and work towards\lmeeting our challenges.\pNow, I must go train my daughter.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Sabrina
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}SABRINA$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Sabrina
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: SABRINA
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The love you have towards your
POKéMON…\pIt was a power that was never
bested by my psychic power.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Blaine
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BLAINE$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Blaine
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BLAINE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}My fire POKéMON!
They'll become even more powerful!\pAnd now, a quiz. How many kinds of
FIRE-type POKéMON are there?$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Lorelei
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}LORELEI$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Lorelei
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LORELEI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I needed to thank you for your
help.\pBut that has nothing to do with our
battles.\pYou'd better watch out next time!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Bruno
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BRUNO$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Bruno
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BRUNO
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}The super power of your POKéMON
and you I've experienced myself.\pNext time, maybe I should show you
how to train yourself.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Agatha
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}AGATHA$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Agatha
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: AGATHA\nTo: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_FEMALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}When you grow older, don't you\ndare go soft like that coot OAK!\pBe like me and keep battling on!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Lance
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}LANCE$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Lance
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: LANCE
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}I'm considering going back to my
hometown.\pI want to retrain my DRAGON-type
POKéMON and strengthen them.\pI'd like to invite you to my
hometown one day.$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Bill
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}BILL$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Bill
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: BILL
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Hey, there! CELIO had nothing but
praise for you.\pHearing that makes me happy.\pWhen you catch some rare POKéMON,
come show me, okay? Promise!$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_MrFuji
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}MR. FUJI$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_MrFuji
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: MR. FUJI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}Instead of hoping for the happiness
of just your POKéMON…\p…Can I get you to wish for the
happiness of all POKéMON?$

label: gFameCheckerPersonName_Giovanni
source: {COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}GIOVANNI$

label: gFameCheckerPersonQuote_Giovanni
source:
{COLOR BLUE}{SHADOW LIGHT_BLUE}From: GIOVANNI
To: {PLAYER}\p{FONT_MALE}{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{SHADOW LIGHT_GRAY}There is nothing that I wish to say
to you.\pI will concentrate solely on
bettering myself, and none other.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBrock
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PEWTER GYM\nLEADER BROCK!\pBROCK rarely laughs, but is said to\nbe unable to stop if he starts.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMisty
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CERULEAN GYM\nLEADER MISTY!\pMISTY is said to worship LORELEI\nof the ELITE FOUR.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLtSurge
source:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: VERMILION GYM
LEADER LT. SURGE!\pLT. SURGE is rumored to have been
a pilot while home in America.\pHe used the electricity generated
by POKéMON to power his plane.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureErika
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CELADON GYM\nLEADER ERIKA!\pRumor has it that if you peek into\nCELADON GYM, you can often\lsee ERIKA snoozing.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureKoga
source:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: FUCHSIA GYM
LEADER KOGA!\pKOGA is said to have a thorough
knowledge of medicine.\pHe even concocts medicine to nurse
his POKéMON to health.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureSabrina
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: SAFFRON GYM\nLEADER SABRINA!\pPeople say that SABRINA can\ncommunicate with her POKéMON\lduring battle without speaking.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBlaine
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: CINNABAR GYM\nLEADER BLAINE!\pBLAINE is said to remove his dark\nshades only when he is thinking up\lnew quiz questions.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLorelei
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LORELEI!\pKnown for her logical, calculated,\nand cool battling style, LORELEI\lhas a surprising secret!$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBruno
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's BRUNO!\pBRUNO apparently joined the ELITE\nFOUR out of his burning ambition to\lbattle the best TRAINERS.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureAgatha
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's AGATHA!\pIn her youth, AGATHA and PROF.\nOAK were rivals who vied for\lsupremacy as TRAINERS.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLance
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:\nELITE FOUR's LANCE!\pLANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\ldragon masters.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureProfOak
source: POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature: PROF. OAK,\nthe POKéMON Researcher!\pPROF. OAK reportedly lives with his\ngrandchildren DAISY and {RIVAL}.$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureDaisyOak
source:
This is a POKéMON JOURNAL from
years ago…\pPOKéMON JOURNAL
CONTEST Special!\pThe Spring POKéMON CONTEST's
Grand Champion is DAISY OAK of\lPALLET TOWN!$

label: PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMrFuji
source:
POKéMON JOURNAL\pSpecial Feature:
MR. FUJI of POKéMON HOUSE!\pEditor: The shy MR. FUJI turned
down our interview requests.\pHe is a kindly man who is adored
and respected in LAVENDER TOWN.$

label: MatchCall_SameRouteBattleRequestText6
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
{STR_VAR_1} here.\lHow are your POKéMON keeping?\pOh, is that right? You're around
{STR_VAR_2}?\pWell, then, we'd better have
a rematch.\pI can wait, sure.
See you!$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText28
source:
I love POKéMON!
It's {STR_VAR_1} from the FAN CLUB!\pYou have to hear this!
My sweet POKéMON…\pSnort! Wahaha!
I can't say any more! It's a secret!\lIt's just too cute for words!\pOh, my sweet {STR_VAR_2} is begging
for a {POKEBLOCK}!\pIt's the picture of cuteness!\pSorry, but I can't talk now!
You'll have to hear this next time!$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText39
source:
Hey, it's {STR_VAR_1}…
Whoops!\pSplash!\pBlug-blug-blug-blug…\pSploosh!\pWhiff-whiff! Whiff-whiff!\pHey! Sorry about that!
I just put on some suntan oil.\pSo my POKéNAV went whoopsy
out of my hand into the water!\pBut, boy, DEVON's POKéNAV is built
tough. It survived that dunking!\pAnyways, I'm busy sunbathing,
so let's chat another time.$

label: MatchCall_PersonalizedText52
source:
Hi, this is {STR_VAR_1}.\pI gave a {POKEBLOCK} to my {STR_VAR_2}.
It seemed to enjoy it very much.\pIt looks like POKéMON have their
likes and dislikes with {POKEBLOCK}S.\pI find that quite fascinating.
Please do take care.$

label: MatchCall_BattleDomeText3
source:
Hey there, {PLAYER}!
It's me, {STR_VAR_1}.\lHow's it going?\pI heard you won events {STR_VAR_3} times
at the {STR_VAR_2}!\pMake it one more next time!
Catch you soon!$

label: MatchCall_BattleDomeText5
source:
Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's {STR_VAR_1}.\pI heard you won {STR_VAR_3} times
outright at the {STR_VAR_2}.\pI'd better get with it, too!
See you soon!$

label: MatchCall_BattleDomeText6
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}?
{STR_VAR_1} here. How are you?\pBy the way, I heard you became
the champion {STR_VAR_3} times at\lthe {STR_VAR_2}.\pI'd better raise my POKéMON before
you pull farther ahead.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Baoba1
source: BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\nThe SAFARI ZONE is nearly ready!\pI'll call you first thing when\nit's finished!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Baoba2
source: BAOBA: {PLAYER}!\nThe SAFARI ZONE is open! Come\panytime!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Roxanne1
source:
ROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!\pI've been hard at work retraining
since we met.\pI will still need some more time
before I can reopen the GYM.\pBut when I do, please visit my GYM
for a rematch!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Roxanne2
source:
ROXANNE: Is this {PLAYER}?
Congratulations!\lI've been hearing about you!\pAs for me, I need some more time
before I can reopen the GYM.\pBut when I do, please visit my GYM
for a rematch!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Roxanne3
source: ROXANNE: {PLAYER}!\nMy GYM is ready!\pPlease visit RUSTBORO whenever\nyou can!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Roxanne4
source: ROXANNE: At the RUSTBORO GYM,\nthe fact that we battled, {PLAYER},\lis a matter of pride.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Brawly1
source:
BRAWLY: Hey, there, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI learned a lot from the battle we
had together.\pI intend to do my training over,
then reopen the GYM.\pIt's going to take some time before
I'm ready to run the GYM again.\pBut if I can reopen the GYM,
I want you to challenge us again.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Brawly2
source:
BRAWLY: Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Congratulations!\pWord about your exploits arrived
on tidal winds!\pIt appears as if I need to work on
my training some more.\pIt's going to take some time before
I'm ready to run the GYM again.\pBut if I can reopen the GYM,
I want you to challenge us again.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Brawly3
source: BRAWLY: Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\nMy GYM's ready for action!\pCome back to DEWFORD anytime\nfor another challenge!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Brawly4
source: BRAWLY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I don't think\nI'll ever get bored of battling you!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Wattson1
source:
WATTSON: Oh, it's you!\pAfter you left, I've been redoing
my training from scratch.\pI'd say I could use a wee bit more
time to reopen my GYM.\pYou'll have to wait till then!
Wahahahaha!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Wattson2
source:
WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\pYou've really done it, haven't you?
I've been getting word about you!\pIt seems I need to retrain some
more still.\pI'd say I could use a wee bit more
time to reopen my GYM.\pYou'll have to wait till then!
Wahahahaha!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Wattson3
source: WATTSON: Oh, it's you!\nMy GYM's ready!\pVisit MAUVILLE anytime!\nWahahahaha!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Wattson4
source: WATTSON: Wahahaha!\pA battle with you is always charged\nwith shocking power!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Flannery1
source:
FLANNERY: {PLAYER}…\pWhen we battled, I learned exactly
how immature I was.\pBut I'm not done yet!\pI'm going to redo my training and
reopen the GYM.\pWhen the time comes, {PLAYER},
please challenge us again.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Flannery2
source:
FLANNERY: Hello, {PLAYER}?
Congratulations!\pWord of your success has reached
us like the heat of a volcano!\pOur training is coming along very
well here.\pWhen the GYM's ready, a mark will
appear beside my name in the\lMATCH CALL list.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Flannery3
source: FLANNERY: Oh, {PLAYER}?\nOur GYM's ready!\pCome to LAVARIDGE for a soak\nin the hot spring and a challenge!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Flannery4
source: FLANNERY: {PLAYER}…\nI'm positive that you keep getting\lbetter at training every time.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Winona1
source: WINONA: Hello, {PLAYER}!\pThanks to our battle, I've come\nto understand my weak points!\pWhen I reopen the GYM, I won't go\ndown in defeat again!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Winona2
source: WINONA: You've done it, {PLAYER}!\pNews about the new CHAMPION\nhas reached us in FORTREE!\pBut… The next time we battle,\nit's not going to end the same way.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Winona3
source: WINONA: Is this {PLAYER}?\nOur GYM is back in operation!\pWe're waiting for you in FORTREE!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Winona4
source: WINONA: {PLAYER}…\nThough I have lost, my wings will\lnever break.\pYes, in exactly the same way that\nyou never lost sight of your dream.$

label: MatchCall_Text_TateLiza1
source:
TATE: Oh! You're…
LIZA: {PLAYER}!\pTATE: We're in training again…
LIZA: So we can reopen our GYM!\pTATE: When our GYM is ready…
LIZA: When our GYM is ready…\pTATE: A mark'll appear by our name…
LIZA: On the MATCH CALL list.$

label: MatchCall_Text_TateLiza2
source:
TATE: {PLAYER}, congratulations!
LIZA: {PLAYER}, congratulations!\pTATE: The two of us are…
LIZA: Still in training!\pTATE: We need some more time, but…
LIZA: When our GYM is ready…\pTATE: A mark'll appear by our name…
LIZA: On the MATCH CALL list.$

label: MatchCall_Text_TateLiza3
source:
TATE: {PLAYER}!
LIZA: {PLAYER}!\pTATE: Our GYM is ready!
LIZA: Our GYM is ready!\pTATE: Please come visit…
LIZA: MOSSDEEP anytime!$

label: MatchCall_Text_TateLiza4
source: TATE: {PLAYER}, the battle we had…\nLIZA: Is an invaluable experience.\pTATE: It would be nice if…\nLIZA: We could all battle again!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Juan1
source:
JUAN: Hmm…
{PLAYER}{KUN}… Was it?\pOur battle together--it brought
to me memories of when I first\lencountered WALLACE.\pPerhaps you are a genius who may
yet surpass WALLACE!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Juan2
source:
JUAN: Fufu… {PLAYER}{KUN}…
You've finally achieved your goal.\pMy eye for appraising talent wasn't
mistaken…\pI wish for another chance to meet
you, for you have scaled the peak\lof power and prestige.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Juan3
source: JUAN: Hoho… {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pOur SOOTOPOLIS GYM has finally\nreopened.\pIf you wish to see me, you are\nwelcome to visit anytime.$

label: MatchCall_Text_Juan4
source: JUAN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pLike the finest music, the battles\nwe wage together strike chords\lof inspiration in my heart…\pWhen I close my eyes, I see visions\nof you soaring with the melody…$

label: MatchCall_Text_Scott4
source:
SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pI've been hearing about these odd
gangs being a nuisance.\pTEAM MAGMA and TEAM AQUA,
I think they were.\pI would think there'd be some
skilled TRAINERS among them.\p…But if they're thugs…$

label: MatchCall_Text_Scott6
source:
SCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou know that you can challenge
the POKéMON LEAGUE when you've\lcollected all the GYM BADGES?\pWith your talent, becoming the
CHAMPION isn't a pipe dream.\pBut did you know?
There's somewhere even better.\pBut, that's all I'm willing to say
for the time being.\pIt's something you can look
forward to.\pWhen you've won your way through
the POKéMON LEAGUE into the HALL\lOF FAME!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman6
source: DAD: Hiyah! Haah! Dwah!\p…Oh? {PLAYER}!\pYou caught me right in the middle\nof a POKéMON training session!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman7
source: DAD: {PLAYER}!\pWho would've thought you'd become\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…\pOkay!\nI won't be left behind!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman8
source:
DAD: Hm? {PLAYER}?
What good timing!\pThis time, I'm going to challenge
you to battle.\pI'm waiting in the PETALBURG GYM.
Accept my challenge anytime!$

label: MatchCall_Text_Norman9
source: DAD: …You amaze me, {PLAYER}.\nHow much higher will you soar?$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joey_General1
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
How're you doing?\pHow are your POKéMON doing?\pMy {STR_VAR_3}'s raring to go,
just like always.\pIt's the only one I have.
I'm going to become a great\ltrainer with it!$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joey_General2
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
Got a minute?\pMy {STR_VAR_3}'s looking
sharper than before!\pI doubt there's a POKéMON
as cool as this guy in\lyour party!$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joey_General3
source:
Yo, {PLAYER}!
How're you doing?\pI'm checking out
{STR_VAR_3}'s moves and\ldevising some strategies.\pWhen I come up with a good
one, let's battle!$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Joey_Battle
source: Yo, {PLAYER}!\pLet's get together and\nbattle!\pI promise things will be\ndifferent!$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_General1
source:
{PLAYER}, howdy!\pHow are your POKéMON doing?\pMy POKéMON have too much
energy to burn.\pIt gets to be a problem.\pOf all my POKéMON,
{STR_VAR_3} is the hardest\lto handle.\pWorking with it is
exhausting.$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_General2
source:
{PLAYER}, howdy!
Isn't it nice out?\pAre your POKéMON growing?\pMy POKéMON are growing a
bit too quickly for me.\lIt's overwhelming!\p{STR_VAR_3}'s growing
especially quickly.\pI think it'll get tough.$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_General3
source: {PLAYER}, howdy!\pOh yeah, we KO'd a wild\n{STR_VAR_3} with one hit\la while back.\pIt went down so easily,\nI felt a little sorry for\lthe poor thing.$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_FoundItem
source:
{PLAYER}, howdy!\pI found all kinds of
BERRIES.\pIf you want, I'll share
some with you.\pI'll be waiting on
ROUTE 31.$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Wade_Battle
source: {PLAYER}, howdy!\pDo you feel like a POKéMON\nbattle?\pIt won't be like last\ntime!$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Ralph_General1
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
How's the fishing?\pAre you taking good care of
your POKéMON?\pYou have to be good to
your partners!$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Ralph_General2
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI've been spending more\ntime with my {STR_VAR_3}\lthan I have with my kids.\pThat's a bit sad,\nactually.$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Ralph_General3
source:
Hey, {PLAYER}!
Listen to this!\pI just beat a wild
{STR_VAR_3}.\pI told my kid, but he
scoffed that he could do\lthe same thing easily.\pBoy, has he gotten
cocky…$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Ralph_Battle
source: Hey, {PLAYER}!\pI was waiting for you.\nLet's battle!$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Liz_General1
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
I had some time, so I\lcalled you.\pSo anyway, how are your
POKéMON?\pMe, I take my {STR_VAR_3}
to the POKéMON CENTER in\lVIOLET every day,\pso it's doing just
fantastic!\pI'm friends with the
receptionist!$

label: MatchCall_HNS_Liz_General2
source:
Hi, {PLAYER}!
You have to hear this.\pMy {STR_VAR_3} is so
adorable!\pIt always wants to
nuzzle me!$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_WelcomeToTheWorld
source: Hello, there!\nGlad to meet you!\pWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\pMy name is OAK.\pPeople affectionately refer to me\nas the POKéMON PROFESSOR.\p$

label: gOakSpeech_Text_IsInhabitedFarAndWide

label: gOakSpeech_Text_IStudyPokemon

label: gOakSpeech_Text_LetsGo

label: gText_Oak_Pokemon

label: gText_Oak_MainSpeech
source:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\pPeople and POKéMON live together,
by supporting each other.\pSome people play with POKéMON,
some battle with them. \pBut we don't know everything about
POKéMON yet. \pThere are still many mysteries
to solve. That's why I study\lPOKéMON every day.\p$

source: Oh, wow, there are POKéMON EGGS?\nI didn't know that!\pThat's pretty good, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsLow
source: You've hatched that many EGGS?\nYou really must like them!\pThat's impressive, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHigh
source: Whoa! You've hatched a whole\nbunch of EGGS!\pYou're an EGG-hatching machine!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowEggsHighest
source: Wh… You hatched that many EGGS?\pWhat's behind your love of EGGS?\nIt's beyond incredible, yup!\pYou're too awesome, I tell you.\nThat's it, I have to give you this.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_EggStickerApplied
source: The EGG STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryEggs
source: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendEggs
source: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsLowest
source: Oh, wow, you've had success\nlink battling?\pYou're pretty strong, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsLow
source: You've beaten your friends a lot\nlink battling, huh?\pYou're impressively strong, yup!\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHigh
source: Whoa! You've beaten your friends\na frightful number of times.\pHave you lost friends over this?\nI'll give you one of these.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_WowLinkWinsHighest
source:
Wh… Wickedly whoa!
You've won mind-blowingly often!\pIt just knocks me out thinking
about how tough you are.\pYou're the stuff of nightmares!
That's it, I have to give you this.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_VictoryStickerApplied
source: The VICTORY STICKER was applied\nto the TRAINER CARD.$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_ComeBackWithBetterStoryLinkWins
source: Hmm…\pCome back with a better story next\ntime, okay?$

label: FourIsland_House2_Text_LivingLegendLinkWins
source: Oh, no, no can do.\pYou're practically a living legend.\nI have no SITCKERS left to give.$

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
source: That wasn't close to what I could\ndo to show off my POKéMON.\pI'll have you as my captive audience\nas often as possible!$

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
source:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!\pNo, wait, was that forty years
I've searched?\pHmm… It could even be fifty…
How long have I been at this?$

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
source: There is much to be learned from\nyour training style.\pI request a rematch if it\nbehooves you.$

label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
source: I made the mistake of trying to battle\nwhile running!\pI should take a run to calm down…$

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch
source: POKéMON seem to like different kinds\nof {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.$

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
source: Who has the knowledge and\nthe technique for survival?\pPOKéMON RANGERS, that's who!$

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
source: MT. PYRE…\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep…\pIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits…$

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro
source: ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck.\nI'm going to go totally all out!$

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
source:
Gasp… Gasp…
I'm wiped out…\pThe going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.\pWill I have any energy left to make
the return trip?$

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
source: That young man over there looks just\nlike my husband when he was young.\pHe's making me blush!$

label: VSSeeker_Text_BatteryNotChargedNeedXSteps
source: The battery isn't charged enough.\pNo. of steps required to fully\ncharge the battery: {STR_VAR_1}{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: VSSeeker_Text_NoTrainersWithinRange
source: There are no Trainers within range\nwho can battle…\pThe VS Seeker was turned off.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: VSSeeker_Text_TrainersNotReady
source: The other Trainers don't appear\nto be ready for battle.\pLet's wait till later.{PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}$

label: Route3_Text_ColtonRematchIntro
source: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!$

label: Route3_Text_BenRematchIntro
source: Hi! I like shorts!\nThey're comfy and easy to wear!\pYou should be wearing shorts, too!$

label: Route3_Text_JaniceRematchIntro
source: Excuse me!\nYou keep looking at me, don't you?$

label: Route3_Text_GregRematchIntro
source: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?\nLet's get with it right away!$

label: Route3_Text_SallyRematchIntro
source: That look you give me…\nIt intrigues me so!$

label: Route3_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
source: Hey! What's wrong with you?\nYou're still not wearing shorts!$

label: Route3_Text_JamesRematchIntro
source: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI started raising.$

label: Route3_Text_RobinRematchIntro
source: Eek!\nDid you push me?$

label: Route4_Text_CrissyRematchIntro
source: I always catch mushroom POKéMON\non MT. MOON.$

source: Oh! You're that nosy kid who\neavesdropped on us!$

label: Route6_Text_NancyRematchIntro
source: Excuse me! Didn't I tell you that\nthis is a private conversation?\pYou shouldn't be listening in,\nyou uncouth person!$

label: Route6_Text_KeigoRematchIntro
source: I'm trying to find something good\nthat's not a BUG POKéMON, but…$

label: Route6_Text_JeffRematchIntro
source: Huh?\nYou want to go with me again?$

label: Route6_Text_IsabelleRematchIntro
source: Me?\nWell, okay. I'll play this once.$

label: Route6_Text_ElijahRematchIntro
source: Hey, long time!\nHave you gotten better?$

label: Route8_Text_AidanRematchIntro
source: You are good at POKéMON, but how\nis your chemistry grade?$

label: Route8_Text_StanRematchIntro
source: All right!\nLet's play another game!$

label: Route8_Text_GlennRematchIntro
source: You need strategy to win at\nbattling.\pAre you following my advice?$

label: Route8_Text_PaigeRematchIntro
source: I've collected many NIDORAN.\nI don't want them to evolve, but…$

label: Route8_Text_LeslieRematchIntro
source: School is fun, but I still think\nPOKéMON are fun, too.$

label: Route8_Text_AndreaRematchIntro
source: MEOWTH and PERSIAN are so cute,\nmeow, meow, meow!$

label: Route8_Text_MeganRematchIntro
source: We may look silly standing here\nlike this, but I can still battle.$

label: Route8_Text_RichRematchIntro
source: I'm a rambling, gaming dude!\nI'm on a winning streak!$

label: Route8_Text_JuliaRematchIntro
source: What's a cute, round, and fluffy\nPOKéMON?\pYou already know, don't you?$

label: Route8_Text_RicardoRematchIntro
source: My bike's still acting up, man.$

label: Route8_Text_JarenRematchIntro
source: Okay, kid!\nDon't expect mercy this time!$

label: Route8_Text_EliRematchIntro
source: ELI: Our twin power became even\nbetter!$

label: Route8_Text_AnneRematchIntro
source: ANNE: Our twin power powered up!$

label: Route9_Text_AliciaRematchIntro
source: We're to battle again?\nThis time, you're mine!$

label: Route9_Text_ChrisRematchIntro
source: I haven't forgotten you were with\nthose good-looking POKéMON.$

label: Route9_Text_DrewRematchIntro
source: I'm taking ROCK TUNNEL to go to\nLAVENDER…\pBut I keep getting stopped by\neveryone along the way…$

label: Route9_Text_CaitlinRematchIntro
source: Don't you dare patronize me today!\nWe're playing for keeps!$

label: Route9_Text_JeremyRematchIntro
source: Bwahaha!\nGreat! I was bored again, eh!$

label: Route9_Text_BriceRematchIntro
source: Hahaha!\nA little toughie, as always!$

label: Route9_Text_BrentRematchIntro
source: I got up early every day to train\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!$

label: Route9_Text_AlanRematchIntro
source: Hahahaha!\nI'll win this time!$

label: Route9_Text_ConnerRematchIntro
source: Go win, my super BUG POKéMON!$

label: Route10_Text_MarkRematchIntro
source: Wow, you came here again?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?$

label: Route10_Text_ClarkRematchIntro
source: Ha-hahah-ah-ha!\nI can't stop sneezing!$

label: Route10_Text_HermanRematchIntro
source: Hi, kid!\nDid I show you my POKéMON?$

label: Route10_Text_HeidiRematchIntro
source: I went out to a POKéMON GYM again.\p…But I lost as usual.$

label: Route10_Text_TrentRematchIntro
source: Ah!\nThis mountain air is delicious!\lIt's so good, I can't leave!$

label: Route10_Text_CarolRematchIntro
source: My head is starting to spin.\nI've been hiking for too long…$

label: Route11_Text_HugoRematchIntro
source: Win, lose, or draw!\nNow for our rematch!$

label: Route11_Text_JasperRematchIntro
source: Competing is the ultimate thrill.\nI still can't get enough!$

label: Route11_Text_EddieRematchIntro
source: You know, right?\nLet's go, but don't cheat!$

label: Route11_Text_BraxtonRematchIntro
source: Hi, there!\pBut be careful!\nI'm still laying down some cables!$

label: Route11_Text_DillonRematchIntro
source: I became a TRAINER a while ago.\nBut, I think I can win.$

label: Route11_Text_DirkRematchIntro
source: Fwahaha!\nI have never lost!\p…And if I did, I've forgotten all\nabout it!$

label: Route11_Text_DarianRematchIntro
source: I have never won before…\pPerhaps I am destined to remain\nthat way…$

label: Route11_Text_YasuRematchIntro
source: I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning and night!$

label: Route11_Text_BernieRematchIntro
source: Keep your eyes out for live wires!$

label: Route11_Text_DaveRematchIntro
source: I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now.\lThis time, they should win, too.$

label: Route12_Text_NedRematchIntro
source: Yeah!\nI got a bite, here!\lTh-this might be the real thing!$

label: Route12_Text_ChipRematchIntro
source: You're finally here.\nFishing is a waiting game.$

label: Route12_Text_JustinRematchIntro
source: Still can't find a MOON STONE…\nHave you found one?$

label: Route12_Text_LucaRematchIntro
source: Electricity has always been my\nspecialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.$

label: Route12_Text_HankRematchIntro
source: The FISHING FOOL vs. POKéMON KID!\nAnother round, fight!$

label: Route12_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
source: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\nBut, I wish I had more work…\l…It's hard to give up fishing!$

label: Route12_Text_AndrewRematchIntro
source: What's catching?\pYou'll never know unless you beat\nme!$

label: Route12_Text_JesRematchIntro
source: JES: I'll win here today and\npropose to my GIA.$

label: Route12_Text_GiaRematchIntro
source: GIA: Hey, JES…\nI've been waiting a long time now.\pIf we win today, I'll marry you!$

label: Route13_Text_SebastianRematchIntro
source: My bird POKéMON remember you!$

label: Route13_Text_SusieRematchIntro
source: I want to be the best TRAINER \nwhile I'm a kid!$

label: Route13_Text_ValerieRematchIntro
source: Wow!\nYou got more cool BADGES!$

label: Route13_Text_GwenRematchIntro
source: My cutely grown POKéMON wish to\nbecome reacquainted with you.$

label: Route13_Text_AlmaRematchIntro
source: I cleaned out my savings and\nbought more CARBOS.$

label: Route13_Text_PerryRematchIntro
source: I'm not going to lose this time.\nThe wind's blowing my way!$

label: Route13_Text_LolaRematchIntro
source: Oh, you're back?\pSure, I'll play again with you,\nsweetie.$

label: Route13_Text_SheilaRematchIntro
source: Can't you forget that you battled\nwith me?$

label: Route13_Text_JaredRematchIntro
source: What're you starin' at?$

label: Route13_Text_RobertRematchIntro
source: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.$

label: Route14_Text_CarterRematchIntro
source: I used TMs to teach good moves\nto my POKéMON.$

label: Route14_Text_MitchRematchIntro
source: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle this time.$

label: Route14_Text_BeckRematchIntro
source: Are you using TMs on POKéMON?\nJust holding them is useless.$

label: Route14_Text_MarlonRematchIntro
source: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky! Give it a try.$

label: Route14_Text_DonaldRematchIntro
source: The legend of the winged mirages…\nYou've heard it, right?$

label: Route14_Text_BennyRematchIntro
source: I'm really not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!$

label: Route14_Text_LukasRematchIntro
source: Hey!\nI remember you!\pC'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!$

label: Route14_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
source: You're here again, huh?\nShut up and battle.$

label: Route14_Text_GeraldRematchIntro
source: We've been riding here because of\nthe wide-open spaces.$

label: Route14_Text_MalikRematchIntro
source: POKéMON battle, right?\nCool! Rumble!$

label: Route14_Text_KiriRematchIntro
source: KIRI: JAN, I hope we win today.$

label: Route14_Text_JanRematchIntro
source: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nLet's win for sure this time!$

label: Route15_Text_KindraRematchIntro
source: I'm going to keep battling with the\nPOKéMON I got in trades.$

label: Route15_Text_BeckyRematchIntro
source: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it one more go!$

label: Route15_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
source: When I whistle, bird POKéMON\ngather around.\pThey're amazingly cute!$

source: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nWait, aren't you that TRAINER…$

label: Route15_Text_GraceRematchIntro
source: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!\lI remember you now!$

source: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.\pThat hasn't changed.$

label: Route15_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
source: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI got these off some loser!$

label: Route15_Text_AlexRematchIntro
source: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!$

label: Route15_Text_CeliaRematchIntro
source: What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON, of course.$

label: Route15_Text_YazminRematchIntro
source: Want to play with my POKéMON\nagain?$

label: Route15_Text_MyaRematchIntro
source: MYA: Hi, we keep meeting,\ndon't we?\pHelp me train my little brother\nagain?$

label: Route15_Text_RonRematchIntro
source: RON: My sister's gotten more\npowerful…$

label: Route16_Text_LaoRematchIntro
source: What do you want?$

label: Route16_Text_KojiRematchIntro
source: Nice BIKE!\nHand it over quick!$

label: Route16_Text_LukeRematchIntro
source: Come out and play, little mouse.\nI'll treat you right!$

label: Route16_Text_HideoRematchIntro
source: Hey, wait a second!\nDon't call me and then run away!$

label: Route16_Text_CamronRematchIntro
source: I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI really need a punching bag!$

label: Route16_Text_RubenRematchIntro
source: Hey, there!\nWe'll have ourselves a good time!$

label: Route16_Text_JedRematchIntro
source: JED: Are you here to see our\nlove, which knows no bounds?$

label: Route16_Text_LeaRematchIntro
source: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.$

label: Route17_Text_RaulRematchIntro
source: I told you, there's no getting rich\nquick in battling kids.$

label: Route17_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
source: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!$

label: Route17_Text_VirgilRematchIntro
source: You out for a stroll?$

label: Route17_Text_BillyRematchIntro
source: We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!$

label: Route17_Text_NikolasRematchIntro
source: VOLTORB's going to seriously\nelectrify you today!$

label: Route17_Text_ZeekRematchIntro
source: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nabsolutely won't evolve. Why?$

label: Route17_Text_JamalRematchIntro
source: Gaah! I really need to exercise\nand seriously trim some flab!$

label: Route17_Text_CoreyRematchIntro
source: Be a rebel!$

label: Route17_Text_JaxonRematchIntro
source: Yep, that's a nice BIKE!\nHow's it handle?$

label: Route17_Text_WilliamRematchIntro
source: Get lost, kid!\nI'm bushed!$

label: Route18_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
source: I've been checking every grassy\narea for new POKéMON.\pBut it's not always easy…$

label: Route18_Text_RamiroRematchIntro
source: Koorukukukoo!\nIs my birdcall getting better?$

label: Route18_Text_JacobRematchIntro
source: I warned you before, this is my\nturf!\pI don't want you coming around.$

label: Route19_Text_RichardRematchIntro
source: I'm almost warmed up to go\nout for a swim.$

label: Route19_Text_ReeceRematchIntro
source: Wait! Slow down!\nWhat if you have a heart attack?$

label: Route19_Text_MatthewRematchIntro
source: I love swimming!\nI guess you're the surfing type.$

label: Route19_Text_DouglasRematchIntro
source: What's beyond the horizon?\nHave you seen?$

label: Route19_Text_DavidRematchIntro
source: I tried diving for POKéMON again,\nbut it was a no-go like before.$

label: Route19_Text_TonyRematchIntro
source: I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.\p…Like losing to you the last time!$

label: Route19_Text_AnyaRematchIntro
source: You always get to ride your\nPOKéMON…\pIt looks so relaxing.\nCan I have it if I win?$

label: Route19_Text_AliceRematchIntro
source: Swimming's great!\nSunburns aren't!$

label: Route19_Text_AxleRematchIntro
source: These waters are treacherous!\nYou shouldn't come back here!$

label: Route19_Text_ConnieRematchIntro
source: I swam here with my friends…\nI'm tired…\lMust we really battle again?$

label: Route19_Text_LiaRematchIntro
source: LIA: You know my brother just\nbecame a TRAINER, right?\pI want to make him better, so I\nneed your help again.$

label: Route19_Text_LucRematchIntro
source: LUC: My big sis taught me all\nabout POKéMON.\pI wonder if I'm better?$

label: Route20_Text_BarryRematchIntro
source: The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.$

label: Route20_Text_ShirleyRematchIntro
source: Are you jealous that I'm\nvacationing on SEAFOAM?$

label: Route20_Text_TiffanyRematchIntro
source: I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.$

label: Route20_Text_IreneRematchIntro
source: Were you on vacation, too?$

label: Route20_Text_DeanRematchIntro
source: Check out my physique!\pIt's even more buff than ever\nbefore!$

label: Route20_Text_DarrinRematchIntro
source: Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nHaven't you learned to swim yet?$

label: Route20_Text_RogerRematchIntro
source: I rode my bird POKéMON here.$

label: Route20_Text_NoraRematchIntro
source: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.\nAnd, they've grown bigger!$

label: Route20_Text_MissyRematchIntro
source: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, like I said.$

label: Route20_Text_MelissaRematchIntro
source: CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.$

label: Route21_North_Text_RonaldRematchIntro
source: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?$

label: Route21_North_Text_WadeRematchIntro
source: I got a big haul again!\nWanna go for it once more?$

label: Route21_North_Text_SpencerRematchIntro
source: The sea cleanses my body and soul!$

label: Route21_North_Text_CueBallRematchIntro
source: きょうも　およぎに\nきちまったぜ$

label: Route21_South_Text_JackRematchIntro
source: I caught my POKéMON at sea.\nAnd that's where I train them.$

label: Route21_South_Text_JeromeRematchIntro
source: Right now, I'm in another triathlon\nmeet!$

label: Route21_South_Text_RolandRematchIntro
source: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!$

label: Route21_South_Text_ClaudeRematchIntro
source: Hey, cut it out already.\nYou always scare away the fish!$

label: Route21_South_Text_NolanRematchIntro
source: Keep me company till I get a hit.$

label: Route21_North_Text_LilRematchIntro
source: LIL: Huh? A battle again?\nIAN, can't you do it alone?$

label: Route21_North_Text_IanRematchIntro
source: IAN: My sis is still a slob.\nHelp me get her into shape!$

label: Route25_Text_JoeyRematchIntro
source: I won't lose while I'm here!$

label: Route25_Text_DanRematchIntro
source: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.$

label: Route25_Text_FlintRematchIntro
source: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!\pI'll show her how cool I am for\nsure this time!$

label: Route25_Text_KelseyRematchIntro
source: Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!\lMy conditioning's good today!$

label: Route25_Text_ChadRematchIntro
source: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you again!$

label: Route25_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
source: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!$

label: Route25_Text_FranklinRematchIntro
source: I just trained up on MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!$

label: Route25_Text_NobRematchIntro
source: A POKéMANIAC lives on the cape.\nHave you seen his collection?$

label: Route25_Text_WayneRematchIntro
source: You're going to see BILL again?\nFirst, we battle!$

label: Route24_Text_ShaneRematchIntro
source: I saw your feat from the grass!$

label: Route24_Text_EthanRematchIntro
source: Okay!\nI'll stomp you!$

label: Route24_Text_ReliRematchIntro
source: You always look so busy…\nAren't you getting tired?$

label: Route24_Text_TimmyRematchIntro
source: You really must love coming to\nNUGGET BRIDGE.$

label: Route24_Text_AliRematchIntro
source: The time we battled…\pEven though I was the second in\nline, I was the best, wasn't I?$

label: Route24_Text_CaleRematchIntro
source:
People call this the NUGGET
BRIDGE!\pYou've already beaten us, so you're
not allowed to take the challenge…\p…But, you're welcome to battle with
us again.$

label: OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraRematchIntro
source: Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nI don't notice time slipping by…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaRematchIntro
source: The weather's gorgeous!\nI'll try not to spoil it.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
source: My sunburn is starting to hurt…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnRematchIntro
source: The fire bird's mountain casts\na huge shadow…$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettRematchIntro
source: I have this strong feeling that\nI can win this time!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyRematchIntro
source: Wait! Wait a second!\nI'm sure I've hooked a big one!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonRematchIntro
source: You'll help me out with my\ntraining again?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaRematchIntro
source: We haven't missed a single day of\ntraining yet!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaRematchIntro
source: Every morning, before breakfast,\nI swim around this island…\lThree times!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughRematchIntro
source: Dress appropriately for battle!\nLose that frivolous outfit, I said!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceRematchIntro
source: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireRematchIntro
source: I ate too much again, so will you\nbattle us for some exercise?$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaRematchIntro
source: KIA: My big brother and I make\nan awesome combination!\pWe won't lose this time!$

label: OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikRematchIntro
source: MIK: Together with KIA, we're\nafraid of nothing!\pWe'll prove it to you this time!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiRematchIntro
source: Are we to battle again?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletRematchIntro
source: From where have you come, and\nwhere are you bound?$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraRematchIntro
source: I want to swim without my float\nring soon.$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisRematchIntro
source: Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaRematchIntro
source: Oh, no, didn't I tell you already?\nPlease, stay away from me!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyRematchIntro
source: JOY: We've gotten stronger!\nLots and lots!$

label: ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegRematchIntro
source: MEG: You can't beat us today!$

label: FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeRematchIntro
source: Oh, hello!\pAre you raising your POKéMON in a\ngood environment?$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyRematchIntro
source: With these hands, I will create\nmy victory today.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaRematchIntro
source: Must I repeat myself?\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaRematchIntro
source: I haven't made any progress…\nI still can't get the right angle…$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiRematchIntro
source: Oh, you will give me another\nopportunity to match wits with you?$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianRematchIntro
source: They're almost finished making the\npool for my POKéMON.\pYou must drop in for a visit.$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinRematchIntro
source: I'm a good runner.\nI've gotten even faster!$

label: FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyRematchIntro
source: I say, friend!\nLet us enjoy our time together!$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloRematchIntro
source: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS. Remember me?\pThat's right, I'm the one who loves\nbirds for their beaks!$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazRematchIntro
source: I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI'm the one that loves wings.\nLet's battle again!$

label: FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldRematchIntro
source: I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pI love birds for their down.\nI didn't think I'd see you again!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorRematchIntro
source: I'm still having no luck at all.\nA battle'd be a change of pace!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoRematchIntro
source: Gasp… Gasp…\pI swam here from SIX ISLAND's port\nin one go again.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleRematchIntro
source: You always come along while I'm\nswimming.$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaRematchIntro
source: AVA: Let's have another\ntwo-on-two marine battle today!$

label: SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebRematchIntro
source: GEB: My big sister and I are way\ntougher than before!$

label: SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynRematchIntro
source: …Huh?\pI envision my house, but TELEPORT\nalways brings me here!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseRematchIntro
source: Oh, hello.\nA pleasant breeze is blowing again.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardRematchIntro
source: Hehehe, I'm practicing in secret\nagain.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirRematchIntro
source: What, you're sick of seeing\nSWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!\nBattle with me again.$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseRematchIntro
source: Sigh…\nMy boyfriend's busy again…$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlRematchIntro
source: Come on, tell me, where are the\nmountains around these parts?$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuRematchIntro
source: MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play again!$

label: SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaRematchIntro
source: MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle again!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyRematchIntro
source: There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterRematchIntro
source: Hi, didn't we meet before?\nWhat compelled you to come back?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryRematchIntro
source: It's been said that there are\nmysterious stones on this island.\pHave you discovered anything since\nwe last met?$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylRematchIntro
source: A rematch with you, so high up!$

label: SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorRematchIntro
source: I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioRematchIntro
source: I sensed your approach.$

label: SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteRematchIntro
source: Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MiahRematchIntro
source: Kyahaha!\pComing back won't change a thing.\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MasonRematchIntro
source: Howdy! You're a member of my\nfan club, isn't that right?$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
source: This island is too spread out…\nPatrolling the place is a drag…$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
source: I don't forgive people who abuse\nPOKéMON!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_EveRematchIntro
source: EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together again.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_JonRematchIntro
source: JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose, not ever.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyRematchIntro
source: Let's have another battle.\nMy conditioning's in top form!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanRematchIntro
source: It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
source: I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
source: Every time we meet, you have those\nsnazzy shoes on.$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyRematchIntro
source: You must have gotten tougher.\nLet me battle you, please!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleRematchIntro
source: I was given the best possible\neducation to become this strong.\pI won't lose this time.\nAbsolutely not!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexRematchIntro
source: LEX: My darling NYA, together\nwe will win for certain!$

label: SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaRematchIntro
source: NYA: I won't drag down my mentor\nLEX! We're going to win!$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonRematchIntro
source: Have you discovered anything about\nthis stone chamber?$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
source: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaRematchIntro
source: My teacher is showing me how to\npaint some more.$

label: SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordRematchIntro
source: Today, in addition to our lesson,\nwe came to see the chamber again.$

label: BravoTrainerBattleTower_Text_Lost

The twosome finally succumbed to
{STR_VAR_1} in match number {STR_VAR_2}.\lNice try, TRAINER!\pBut, hey, it's just bad luck to run into

label: BravoTrainerBattleTower_Text_Response
source: “{STR_VAR_1}.”$

label: gTVRecentHappeningsText01
