label: gTV3CheersForPokeblocksText00
source:
MC: We hope you're in good cheer,
“3 CHEERS FOR {POKEBLOCK}S” is here!\pToday, we examine the {POKEBLOCK} blended
by {STR_VAR_1} and associates.\pWithout any delay, let me feed it
to my gourmet POKéMON GULPIN.\p… … … … … …
… … … … … …$

label: gTV3CheersForPokeblocksText02
source: {STR_VAR_1}'s blending performance\nleft something to be desired.\pIf this TRAINER could blend better,\nthe {POKEBLOCK} would be much tastier.$

label: gTV3CheersForPokeblocksText05
source: Tune in next time!\nOur slogan is “3 CHEERS FOR {POKEBLOCK}S!”$

label: SmartShopper_Text_OutroNormal
source:
INTERVIEWER: Hmm… {STR_VAR_1} sounds like
quite the shrewd bargain hunter!\pIn total, {STR_VAR_1}'s purchases came to…\p¥{STR_VAR_2}?!
What an amazing sum!\pOops! We're out of time!
See you on our next broadcast!$

label: TrendWatcher_Text_Intro
source:
DEWFORD TREND-WATCHER NETWORK!\pMC: Wassup?
We'll keep it real with the latest on\lwhat's hip and happening in DEWFORD.\pOur guest today is this old cat whose
claim to fame is being the authority\lon all things in DEWFORD.\pOld man: Glad to be here.\pMC: Let's cut to the chase, right on.\pWhat's your word on what's groovin'
the good folks of DEWFORD?\pOld man: {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}.\pMC: {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2},
you say?\pOld man: No.\p{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2} never
did get popular at all.\pWould you like to hear about it?\pMC: Uh, no. What we want to know is
what's the in thing of the moment…$

label: TrendWatcher_Text_PhraseWasHopeless
source:
But it was utterly hopeless.\p{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2} festival!\p{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2} contest!\pI tried teaching everyone the best
I could, but…\pPerhaps the {STR_VAR_1} part just
wasn't right…\pMC: Uh, excuse me, compadre, I need
to hear about what's in now…$

label: TrendWatcher_Text_Outro
source: MC: …Uh… So, there you have it,\nall you trendy, hep cats out there!\p{STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}…uh…\nDidn't get hip or happening in DEWFORD!\pMy time is up. Catch you on the fly!\pOld man: {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}!$

label: gTVPokemonNewsBattleFrontierText16
source: And to the four POKéMON: {STR_VAR_1}!\p{STR_VAR_2}!\p{STR_VAR_3}!$

label: gTVWhatsNo1InHoennTodayText01
source: In one day, {STR_VAR_1} spun the SLOTS\nat the GAME CORNER {STR_VAR_2} times.\pWhile playing, {STR_VAR_1} was heard\nmurmuring, “For me, the reels don't\leven move…”\lIsn't that interesting?$

label: gTVWhatsNo1InHoennTodayText02
source:
In one day, {STR_VAR_1} played
the ROULETTE game at the GAME\lCORNER {STR_VAR_2} times.\pWhile playing, {STR_VAR_1} shouted,
“Let the balls decide!”\pThe TRAINER's eyes were focused and
the face showed concentration.$

label: gTVWhatsNo1InHoennTodayText06
source: In just one day, {STR_VAR_1} picked\n{STR_VAR_2} BERRIES!\p{STR_VAR_1}'s BAG became so filled\nwith BERRIES, the TRAINER had trouble\lwalking afterward!$

label: TVSecretBaseSecrets_Text_UsedGlassOrnament
source: The visitor is examining\na GLASS ORNAMENT!\pOh, no!\pThe visitor is touching it!\pIt's getting covered with\nfingerprints…$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText02
source: The TRAINER is clever with {POKEBLOCK}S.\nUsed {STR_VAR_2} that time, I think.$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText03
source: The TRAINER didn't use a single\n{POKEBLOCK}! Not a one!\pThere's an expert for you.$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText07
source: The TRAINER does use {POKEBLOCK}S.\nUsed {STR_VAR_2} that time, I think.\pBut, boy, I wish the TRAINER would\nget a bit better at this.$

label: gTVSafariFanClubText08
source: I think the TRAINER would have better\nluck using {POKEBLOCK}S, which weren't\lused at all that time.$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_WonBothRounds
source: Spectator: The {STR_VAR_2} was tops in\nboth primary and secondary judging!\pThat {STR_VAR_2} will keep winning!$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_BetterRound2
source: Spectator: The {STR_VAR_2} didn't do\nwell in the primary judging, but it\lcleaned up in the secondary judging!\pIt was a miraculous comeback\nfor that {STR_VAR_2}. Yippee!$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_GotNervous
source: Spectator: When the {STR_VAR_2} got\nnervous, I couldn't stop myself from\lshouting encouragement.\pI'd like to say this to that\n{STR_VAR_2}, “Congratulations!”$

label: ContestLiveUpdates_Text_StartledFoes
source: Spectator: That {STR_VAR_2}'s appeal\nstartled even me!\p{STR_VAR_2}, you were awesome!$

label: HELP_DEMO_WINDOW.header
source: Information: Help Windows

label: HELP_DEMO_WINDOW.desc
source:
This is a help window. You can put
lots of text on the screen that
players won't read!

Isn't that great!

label: HELP_GAMESTART_WINDOW.header
source: Information: More Options

label: HELP_GAMESTART_WINDOW.desc
source:
The clock can be changed from any
POKéMON CENTER with no penalty.
Make sure to check your BAG's KEY ITEMS
and your OPTIONS MENU for even more
ways to customize your experience.
Enjoy!

label: HELP_TRADE_WINDOW.header
source: WARNING: COMPATIBILITY

label: HELP_TRADE_WINDOW.desc
source:
Attempting to link incorrectly may result
in permanent damage to your save file.
Only link with another player if:
You are both playing Heart & Soul.
You are both on the same version.
You both have the same challenge settings.
You are NOT using any randomizer settings.

label: HELP_TELEPORTER_WINDOW.header
source: OPTIONAL BONUS CONTENT: TELEPORTER

label: HELP_TELEPORTER_WINDOW.desc
source:
The TELEPORTER can PERMANENTLY change
POKéMON into their GALARIAN forms.
GALARIAN forms are NOT required
for story progression or
NATIONAL POKéDEX completion.

label: HELP_SINJOH_WINDOW.header
source: OPTIONAL BONUS CONTENT: SINJOH

label: HELP_SINJOH_WINDOW.desc
source:
This NPC grants access to optional
bonus content: SINJOH.
It is NOT required for story
or NATIONAL POKéDEX completion.

It's just a bonus. If you want it.

label: HELP_ALOLA_WINDOW.header
source: OPTIONAL BONUS CONTENT: ISLES

label: HELP_ALOLA_WINDOW.desc
source:
This NPC grants access to optional
bonus content: ISLES.
It is NOT required for story
or NATIONAL POKéDEX completion.

It's just a bonus. If you want it.

label: HELP_DAYCARE1_WINDOW.header
source: BABY POKéMON ABILITIES

label: HELP_DAYCARE1_WINDOW.desc
source:
PICHU's ability is STATIC.
CLEFFA's ability is CUTE CHARM.
IGGLYBUFF's ability is CUTE CHARM.
TYROGUE's ability is GUTS.
SMOOCHUM's ability is OBLIVIOUS.
ELEKID's ability is STATIC.
MAGBY's ability is FLAME BODY.

label: HELP_DAYCARE2_WINDOW.header
source: BABY POKéMON TYPES

label: HELP_DAYCARE2_WINDOW.desc
source:
PICHU is ELECTRIC type.
CLEFFA is NORMAL type.
IGGLYBUFF is NORMAL type.
TYROGUE is FIGHTING type.
SMOOCHUM is ICE type.
ELEKID is ELECTRIC type.
MAGBY is FIRE type.

label: HELP_DAYCARE3_WINDOW.header
source: BABY POKéMON CRIES

label: HELP_DAYCARE3_WINDOW.desc
source:
PICHU says WAAAH.
CLEFFA says EEK.
IGGLYBUFF says LALALA.
TYROGUE says HIYAH.
SMOOCHUM says EHEHE.
ELEKID says OI, OI, OI.
MAGBY says TCH.

label: HELP_DAYCARE4_WINDOW.header
source: BABY POKéMON ACTIONS

label: HELP_DAYCARE4_WINDOW.desc
source:
PICHU likes to PLAY all day.
CLEFFA LOOKS at the moon.
IGGLYBUFF puts them to SLEEP.
TYROGUE TRAINS constantly.
SMOOCHUM likes to SHOW off.
ELEKID STORES up charge.
MAGBY often ANGERS.

label: HELP_POKEBLOCK_WINDOW.header
source: FEEDERS: REGULAR POKéBLOCKS

label: HELP_POKEBLOCK_WINDOW.desc
source:
POKéBLOCK colors attract perfect IVs:
RED: HP,ATK,SPE   BLU: HP,SPA,SPE
PNK: ATK,SPA,SPE  GRN: HP,DEF,SPD
YEL: HP,ATK,DEF   PUR: ATK,DEF,SPD
IND: HP,SPA,SPD   BRN: DEF,SPE,SPD
LBL: SPA,SPE,SPD  OLV: ATK,DEF,SPE
GRY: HP,ATK,SPA
Every POKéBLOCK attracts HIDDEN ABILITY.

label: HELP_GOLD_POKEBLOCK_WINDOW.header
source: FEEDERS: GOLD POKéBLOCKS

label: HELP_GOLD_POKEBLOCK_WINDOW.desc
source:
GOLD POKéBLOCKS attract POKéMON with
5 perfect IVs. Flavor determines which
IV is not perfect.
SPICY: no SP.ATK    DRY:    no ATTACK
SWEET: no SP.DEF   BITTER: no SPEED
SOUR:  no HP
Every POKéBLOCK attracts HIDDEN ABILITY.
